We rarely agree on anything – I don’t have a lot in common with a self-proclaimed socialist.

**[But here’s one thing we DO agree on... ](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=474e652a60f1408990718cb3b26d5530&_e=b5ebeSzhsCpJ7V6h7NKEwgFv9jOWJlUM-_PO95gNHS7q0bVujBGIFLHFZ4GxpA9LMiIpHF6mhz_S8dnQgSxEOuIl2028cuxu4vezg-bmZhwhodu7vmYQRB7RBGTuMOyNWJLfX9tpxWwM3d3jzS8xA9j2m0anzH9jdjuZ8YxUSy4_raQL0IdWx_Jy7e0EGVrmW2xtc6h7vUPmCgajZraaiuWBQ-jKdu2-oQnHtTqOzaDIx4jZ-ubmt2Mtey6vLFIaF5FWHtrSQJIPE55TBBpVdWUZi2O51GRHvrHxRjM6hdlYHq2-BbIg71Q7hDM_uJ1Od1yHkV6OfiIQ3SniDMvEArWNtevno9r_i8co2UrCvHfA-8vuDkOU6qBUvL58VW_wzGeQiJqDL9xU0nhAxpmMZpGkEWiuJQMj1MAQwok7AjC2mkP2uIGizB6q60uxlpuWwaRcAHqeZmbtM35Vg9mLlZ1Sjc_AU18ohI3QboApuH2aKdkjjqou-gLfNViDCFLMEFhD9o_R5R3noz0YWzYW2efbYHxh_AYklT5oWIy5cVs%3D)**

Bernie said this recently and he’s 100% right. Texas is on the FRONT LINE in the fight for our great nation’s future. The Democrats are hell-bent on flipping the Lone Star State blue, and if they succeed there’s no way we’ll win the White House and control of the U.S. Senate.

Democrat victory here would reshare the political landscape for DECADES to come.

This is not hyperbole. Texas is the ultimate prize for the radical left. Hey there,
In October 2021, I had been an employee of Kellogg’s for almost 18 years.
I had dropped out of college and gone to work for the company after my wife got pregnant. Life’s easy when all you gotta do is take care of yourself – but we had diapers to buy and needed health insurance for our growing family.
When I applied in 2004, there were 6 positions and 600 applications. Working at Kellogg’s promised to be a lifelong career. A good-paying job that afforded me the opportunity to become a homeowner, let my wife stay home with the kids, live decently, retire some day, and hopefully live happily ever after.
But over the years, wages became a two-tier system. New workers were being paid less than workers had made decades earlier. Cost of living adjustments weren’t keeping up anywhere near inflation. Retirement and health insurance plans had been gutted. It just wasn’t right. They were making record profits – and doing it off the backs of workers.
**So in October 2021, we walked out. And as president of our local union, I led the strike.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95675933/507521340/92586991?refcode=em20241023pm3-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=024077e6-9a91-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMjQwNzdlNi05YTkxLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=a_S5XYfpH8flG-Y_yvt2NJlJKs4HTCw6_zCb_Ut7nt4=)
It was the first time many of us had ever walked a picket line. It was cold, but we were determined to hold our lines even through the dead of the winter if we had to. Every worker knew we were a part of something bigger than ourselves. We were in a fight for the future of the American middle class.
After 11 weeks, and the company threatening to permanently replace every union worker, we reached an agreement. More importantly, we saved 500 good-paying jobs here in Nebraska alone.
It was one of the proudest moments of my life.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95675936/507521341/92586991?refcode=em20241023pm3-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=024077e6-9a91-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMjQwNzdlNi05YTkxLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=a_S5XYfpH8flG-Y_yvt2NJlJKs4HTCw6_zCb_Ut7nt4=)
Following the strike, I was fired. The company has its version of events for why, but I believe it was because I was union president. Someone had to pay – and my head was on the chopping block.
It’s easy to let yourself get beaten down by life. To let big corporations and the politicians they own in Washington make all the decisions – and just accept that that’s how things will always be. But that’s not me.
**Instead, I’ve decided to run against one of the most corporate politicians – U.S. Senator Republican Deb Fischer – and with your help, we are going to defeat her.**
Five brand-new polls show me narrowly LEADING Republican Deb Fischer, and according to experts at FiveThirtyEight, Nebraska is now the CLOSEST Senate race in the entire country.
**I am taking on Republican Senator Deb Fischer just like I took on Kellogg’s. But I sure as hell am not taking money from corporate PACs, so I need grassroots donors like you to give now if we’re going to win this Senate seat.**

body:
Pennsylvania state lawmakers had four years to change the law and allow pre-canvassing, but they didn't. The Democratic-led Pennsylvania House of Representatives passed a bill to begin pre-canvassing mail ballots seven days before Election Day (as was recommended by a bipartisan panel). But the Republican-controlled State Senate never brought it for a vote, with some Republicans arguing that the change wasn’t needed.
They don't see a need for change because they want you scared and distrustful, Team. RUSH $25 or more to help educate voters and protect the faith in mail-in ballots and our elections >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=102324_3&amount=25]
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=102324_3&amount=25]
WaPo: Pennsylvania presidential election results could again take days to count [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=102324_3&amount=25]
Team: Do you remember all the cries to "Stop the count!"?
When the polls closed on election night in 2020, one candidate appeared to be winning Pennsylvania. But over the next several days, as officials counted mail-in ballots, his lead shrunk and then disappeared. By Saturday, the other candidate was the clear winner of Pennsylvania — and with it, the presidency.
The protracted counting process left a days-long vacuum that was filled with demands to stop counting the ballots while one candidate was still ahead, declaring premature victory in Pennsylvania and building the false narrative that the mail-in votes were fraudulent .
Even if it was done correctly in the end, the delay was just another partisan tactic by opponents of voting rights in the state legislature to sow mistrust in our elections and an attempt to make sure untold numbers of legally cast ballots didn't count.
Why bring this up again? Because -- unlike the 27 states that allowed for "pre-canvassing", or the counting of mail-in ballots prior to Election Day, in 2020 and unlike the 16 states who have changed their laws since 2020 to allow for counting to begin, Pennsylvania is still one of the seven states that bars counting mail-in ballots until Election Day . This delay will likely cause confusion, deteriorate trust in the process, and make election workers targets for harassment. Again .
The continuing danger to mail-in voting is obvious, Team. Help defend mail-in ballots with $25 or whatever you can right now and make every vote count in this crucial election >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=102324_3&amount=25]

# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=39213%2E3422442%2EpVIsq2)
Derek,
I live, work, and raise a family in Orange County, California, and apparently, so does Republican Wisconsin Senate candidate Eric Hovde. You read that right: Eric is a wealthy businessman and registered voter in my district, CA-47, but he’s running for Senate in... _Wisconsin?_ 🤔
An elected official is supposed to be a voice for the people we represent. Yet, Eric doesn’t even live in the state he’s running in, much less experience the same challenges of Wisconsin families trying to make ends meet. Washington has enough out-of-touch politicians without ultra-wealthy Eric Hovde in the Senate.
**Wisconsin is a must-win state for Democrats’ Senate majority,** so I also want to highlight the amazing candidate we have there.
Tammy Baldwin is Wisconsin's incumbent Democratic Senator, and she’s a champion in the fight against special interests. She’s been a leader in the push for banning members of Congress from trading stocks, overturning Citizens United, and stopping the revolving door between Washington and big corporations.
In Wisconsin, we don’t just have the chance to help Democrats hold the Senate; it’s also a key opportunity to re-elect an anti-corruption champion.
**[That’s why I’m asking: Will you split a donation between Tammy Baldwin’s campaign and Truth to Power? Your support will help send Eric Hovde back to Orange County and keep Tammy fighting for families in the Senate.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20241023?refcode=em20241023-39213&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39213_3422442_pVIsq2&akid=39213%2E3422442%2EpVIsq2)**

Katie Porter

name: Tamie Wilson
subject: Letter from a former Jim Jordan voter...you have to see this
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
I want to share something special with you today.
I just received a letter from a Republican voter, and it's truly something I think you should see. Here it is in its entirety:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241023_republican_letter_image [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241023_republican_letter_image]
Every word of that letter is true – and let me tell you, this is not a one-off thing .
Republicans are coming up to me every day saying they're voting for a Democrat f or the first time in decades, or the first time EVER.
They know, like we've been saying all along, that Jim Jordan is a dangerous, conspiracy-addled buffoon who’s done nothing but spread chaos and division.
We’ve got 14 days left to finish this race strong. Will you chip in $25, $50, or even $100 today to help us send Jim Jordan packing for good? Every dollar helps us reach more voters and expose the truth about his failures. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241023_republican_letter_link1]
Jordan has been in Congress for 17 years, and in all that time, he’s never authored or passed a single bill to help the people of Ohio.
Worse, he’s actively voted against legislation that would bring federal resources and jobs to our district.
He’s been so wrapped up in doing Trump’s bidding and trying to push a bizarre, antiquated Christian nationalist agenda that he’s completely forgotten who he’s supposed to represent.
The truth is, Republican voters are waking up to what a liability he’s become.
He’s not for small government – he’s for government being involved in EVERY part of your life, from deciding what books your kids can read to telling women what they can and can’t do with their bodies.
He’s gone completely off the deep end.
But with your help, we can offer something better.
I believe in bipartisan, common-sense solutions. We can bring jobs to our district, invest in small businesses, and ensure families have access to affordable healthcare.
These are the things that matter to everyday Americans, and that’s exactly what I’m fighting for.
This is the most important congressional race in the country. We have just 13 days left to send Jim Jordan packing. Contribute today to join the team that helps us close the gap and win this race. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241023_republican_letter_link2]
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson
PS: If you can join us making phone calls, knocking on doors, or a number of other things, please sign up ASAP here. [https://www.tamiewilson.com/volunteer/]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/Screenshot%202023-08-30%20at%2012.16.45%20PM.jpeg]
Donate to Tamie Today [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241023_republican_letter_button]
Tamie Wilson is the Democratic nominee ready to unseat ULTRA MAGA extremist Jim Jordan in OH-04. A single mom and survivor who knows what it’s like to endure and overcome challenges, Tamie's fighting for jobs, healthcare, and positive change for everyday Americans. Your donations will help Tamie turn out every voter we need to flip this seat and send Jordan packing.
DONATE >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=2024123_republican_letter_footer]

Tamie Wilson For US
273 Saratoga St
Delaware, OH 43015

body:
COOK POLITICAL REPORT: PA-SEN: "TOSS UP"
Donate now: Keep PA blue » [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-casey]
Derek, this is bad news at an even worse time.
The Cook Political Report just moved our Senate race to a toss-up , meaning my opponent, David McCormick, has a real chance of winning and flipping Pennsylvania red.

If you knew that $5 could change the course of history for future generations, would you make that donation?

If you knew that $5 could decide whether we **hold the Senate majority or hand it back to MAGA loyalists,** would you take that leap?

**[We're running behind today's $50,000 fundraising goal, and we need support from committed Democrats like you. Will you donate the $5 that could make all the difference and defend our Senate majority? name: Tammy Baldwin
subject: Too many reasons to count
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE
body:
[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1001&akid=4255%2E35263%2ERhPCBZ ]TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE

Peter — There are
lots of reasons these dark money Republican super PACs want me out of the
Senate.

They know that I wrote the Women’s Health Protection Act to restore the
simple principle that women should make their own health care decisions,
wherever they live. Not judges or politicians. And they know I won’t stop
fighting until we pass it and guarantee equal access to abortion care
nationwide.

They know that I’m fighting back to protect the right to contraception
before it’s too late.

They know that from defending Social Security and Medicare benefits to
protecting the right to vote, I'll always fight for Wisconsin seniors and
be their champion in the U.S. Senate.

They know that I wrote the law to make sure we’re rebuilding our nation’s
infrastructure using American iron, American steel, and American workers.

They know that when it came time to help our seniors, I stood up to Big
Pharma and fought to bring down insulin costs. Now, seniors on Medicare
can no longer be charged more than $35 a month for insulin and are finally
getting relief.

They know that I wrote the amendment allowing people to stay on their
parents’ health insurance until they turn 26 — a provision my opponent
calls “stupid” — because I know how important access to quality health
care is.

And they know that I’ll always be in your corner, ready to take on the
biggest fights and win — whether it’s working to create jobs, cut costs,
expand affordable health care, or stand up for our freedoms.

But they’re spending $80 million to defeat me, so we need a surge of
donations to avoid getting drowned out on the airwaves in the final weeks
of this toss-up race.

Eventually, I found a career path where I could give back to the communities and country that gave me so much. **Making doughnuts in the morning before homeroom brought me all the way to Congress. ****I've seen time and time again how small acts have the power to create big, transformative change._And that's exactly how we're going to win this campaign in November._**

name: Texas Organizing Project
subject: 🗳️ Have your voice heard and spread the word / Haz oír tu voz y difunde el mensaje 🗳️
body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
The Texas vote is surging
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/BlackTOP%20canvassers%202024.jpg]
Something remarkable is happening in Texas. Early voting is underway, and across the state, early voting records are being BROKEN [https://thehill.com/homenews/state-watch/4947150-texas-early-voting-turnout-record/] . Texas voters are turning out, and the collective we — the Texas Organizing Project and the communities we organize with — are driving this surge. From Bexar County to the DFW Metroplex, Texans are showing up, ready to take charge of our futures. Bexar County had more than 46,000 voters cast ballots on the first day. In the DFW Metroplex, counties like Tarrant, Collin, and Denton shattered records, proving the growing strength of suburban areas that are key battlegrounds this cycle. Harris County came close to its 2020 first-day turnout, despite legislative restrictions that ended 24-hour and drive-thru voting.
What we are seeing this week is proof that Texans are not backing down. We're defying expectations, and showing what’s possible when communities come together. In all parts of the state, the energy is real, and we're just a few days into early voting.
TOP knows that transforming Texas takes more than one election cycle, that’s why we’ve been on the ground 365 days a year, organizing, building infrastructure, and investing in the power of the people. This turnout reflects years of commitment and hard work across our Black and Latino communities.
We know what’s at stake this election, and through our TOP PAC, BlackTOP, and non-partisan voter outreach efforts we are stepping up to transform our state! We remain committed to supporting communities throughout the early voting period, providing the resources needed to sustain high turnout. Through phone-banking, door-knocking, and moving voters online, we are working together to make Texas a place where everyone can thrive. GO VOTE!
- Access a full list of TOP-endorsed candidates committed to building a #TXForAll. [https://organizetexas.org/about-top-pac/endorsements/]
- See what will be on your ballot at Vote411.org. [https://www.vote411.org/]
- Find early vote polling locations and hours in your county. [https://www.votetexas.gov/voting/where.html]
- Visit GoVoteTexas.org for acceptable forms of photo ID to bring with you to vote. [https://govotetexas.org/] (Don't forget it!)
JOIN THE CONVO:
BlackTOP and Florida Rising to team up on Instagram Live
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/BlackTOP%20and%20Florida%20Rising%20-%20Instagram%20Live%20graphic.png]
TUNE IN Thursday, October 24 at 11 a.m. CT on Instagram for a LIVE convo, as BlackTOP’s [https://www.instagram.com/blacktoptexas/] Brianna Brown and Florida Rising’s [https://www.instagram.com/flrising/] Andrea Mercado share all that’s at stake this election in our respective states .
Florida Rising is essentially a sister organization to TOP, doing in Florida what we are doing in Texas: organizing communities to challenge systems of oppression and change our democracy for the better. Just as Texas has radical ultra-conservative politicians, Florida is contending with far-right leaders who are determined to restrict freedoms, whether it’s attacking reproductive rights, undermining healthcare, or suppressing the right to vote.
Our work is deeply connected. We are building a multi-state movement to fight these injustices and create a future where everyone’s voice is heard and valued.
Drop into the Instagram Live conversation and say hello!
Recognized for our work to make Harris County's Enhanced Library Card a reality
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Harris%20County%20enhanced%20library%20card%20ceremony.jpg]
The Harris County Public Library won a national award for its Enhanced Library Card program TOP fought for and won! Houston TOP organizer Damaris Gonzalez and member Cecilia Reyes were on hand at a celebration luncheon hosted by the Harris County Public Library last week, where Executive Director Edward Melton recognized TOP as being a catalyst for the creation of the program, along with raising awareness about the program within the community.
Not having a form of photo ID presents challenges for vulnerable communities across Harris County -- especially for those who are experiencing homelessness, the formerly incarcerated, domestic abuse survivors who have lost their documentation, and more.
These enhanced library cards include a photo, name, date of birth, and address for the recipient, providing Harris County residents who lack access to a form of identification with a basic form of alternative, non-traditional photo ID. This was a home-grown TOP campaign win, started by TOP members who saw this alternate form of ID as an opportunity to fill a community need.
For more information about TOP’s enhanced library card work across the state, email Damaris Gonzalez at dgonzalez@organizetexas.org [dgonzalez@organizetexas.org] .
TOP Tip: Extend your phone battery life. Don't over-charge it.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Smartphone%20over-charge.jpeg]
Yes, it seems counter-intuitive, but you're likely doing more harm to your phone battery by keeping it plugged-in and fully charged all the time. Check out these easy steps on how to protect your battery life. [https://www.gearpatrol.com/tech/smartphone-lithium-ion-charging-tips/]

La votación en Texas está creciendo
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/BlackTOP%20canvassers%202024.jpg]
Algo notable está sucediendo en Texas. La votación anticipada está en marcha y, en todo el estado, se están ROMPIENDO los récords de votación anticipada. [http://thehill.com/homenews/state-watch/4947150-texas-early-voting-turnout-record/] Los votantes de Texas están saliendo a votar y nosotros — el Proyecto Organizador de Texas y las comunidades con las que nos organizamos — estamos ayudando este aumento. Desde el condado de Bexar hasta el DFW Metroplex, los tejanos se están presentando, listos para hacerse cargo de nuestro futuro. El condado de Bexar tuvo más de 46.000 votantes que emitieron su voto el primer día. En el DFW Metroplex, condados como Tarrant, Collin y Denton rompieron récords, lo que demuestra la creciente fuerza de las áreas suburbanas que son campos de batalla clave en este ciclo. El condado de Harris estuvo cerca de tener la misma participación electoral que en 2020, a pesar de las restricciones legislativas que pusieron fin a la votación desde el automóvil que estaba abierto 24 horas.
Lo que estamos viendo esta semana es una prueba de que los tejanos no se están echando atrás. Estamos desafiando las expectativas y mostrando lo que es posible cuando las comunidades se unen. En todas partes del estado, la energía es real y estamos a solo unos días desde cuando la votación empezó.
TOP sabe que transformar Texas requiere más de un ciclo electoral, por eso hemos estado en el terreno los 365 días del año, organizando, construyendo infraestructura e invirtiendo en el poder de la gente. Esta participación refleja años de compromiso y trabajo duro en nuestras comunidades negras y latinas. Sabemos lo que está en juego en esta elección y, a través de nuestro TOP PAC, BlackTOP y esfuerzos de divulgación no partidistas entre los votantes, estamos dando un paso adelante para transformar nuestro estado.
Seguimos comprometidos a apoyar a las comunidades durante el período de votación anticipada, brindando los recursos necesarios para mantener una alta participación. A través de la banca telefónica, las visitas puerta a puerta y el traslado de los votantes en línea, estamos trabajando juntos para hacer de Texas un lugar donde todos puedan prosperar. ¡VAYA A VOTAR!

- Vea lo que estará en su boleta en Vote411.org. [https://www.vote411.org/]
- Busque los lugares y horarios de votación anticipada en su condado. [https://www.votetexas.gov/voting/where.html]

BlackTOP y Florida Rising estarán en Instagram Live

Nuestro trabajo está profundamente conectado. Estamos construyendo un movimiento multiestatal para luchar contra estas injusticias y crear un futuro donde la voz de todos sea escuchada y valorada.
¡Únete a la conversación en vivo de Instagram y saluda!

[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Harris%20County%20enhanced%20library%20card%20ceremony.jpg]
La Biblioteca Pública del Condado de Harris recibió un premio nacional por su programa de Tarjeta de Biblioteca Mejorada, por el que TOP luchó y ganó. La organizadora de TOP en Houston, Damaris González, y la miembra Cecilia Reyes estuvieron presentes en un almuerzo de celebración organizado por la Biblioteca Pública del Condado de Harris la semana pasada, donde el Director Ejecutivo Edward Melton reconoció a TOP como un catalizador para la creación del programa, además de generar conciencia sobre el programa dentro de la comunidad.
No tener una forma de identificación con foto presenta desafíos para las comunidades vulnerables en todo el Condado de Harris, especialmente para aquellos que están experimentando la falta de vivienda, los ex encarcelados, los sobrevivientes de abuso doméstico que han perdido su documentación y más.

Esta fue una victoria de la campaña TOP de cosecha propia, iniciada por miembros de TOP que vieron esta forma alternativa de identificación como una oportunidad para cubrir una necesidad de la comunidad.
Para obtener más información sobre el trabajo de tarjetas de biblioteca mejoradas de TOP en todo el estado, envíe un correo electrónico a Damaris González a dgonzalez@organizetexas.org [dgonzalez@organizetexas.org] .

[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Smartphone%20over-charge.jpeg]

I’m doing everything in my power to save our Majority but now I’m asking you to do your part.

| |

| | | I wanted you to hear this straight from me:

**What happens in the Lone Star State could determine the ENTIRE ELECTION. I 'm dead serious.**

This one state has _40 ELECTORAL VOTES_ up for grabs, _ONE SENATE SEAT_ that could turn blue for the first time in 31 years, and _38 HOUSE SEATS_ that could determine control in the People's House.

That's why I was just on the ground campaigning for one of our best recruits in South Texas and getting out the vote for incumbent Republicans on the ballot. _**[But unfortunately, we're facing major headwinds in this must-win state:](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z0q7d47ql3dj1ijl0v8usbqobqvj4tuoq8cu18j8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4sthm4oj6c1h2bs "But unfortunately, we’re facing major headwinds in this must-win state:")**_
✘ Early voting just started in Texas and voters are turning out in RECORD NUMBERS in deep-blue Collin and Travis counties
✘ House Democrats just put a huge target on TX-15 and are investing millions to bury Conservative candidates all over the state ✘ Kamala Harris is jetting off to Houston and rallying Radical Democrats THIS FRIDAY to try to turn the tide in Texas
The Democrat Machine is flooding Texas with millions of dollars. The polls are too close for comfort. And our House Majority is already hanging on by a thread.

**I 'm doing everything in my power to save our Majority but now I'm asking you to do your part. Would you be willing to pitch in BEFORE KAMALA HARRIS LANDS IN TEXAS?**

Early voting in Texas JUST started and the General Election is in less than TWO WEEKS. This is crunch time. If we want to keep Texas red and save this country of ours, we MUST have the necessary resources to win.

_If we can raise 250,000 dollars between now and Friday (when Kamala heads to Houston), we 'll have the resources to go on offense in every battleground district in Texas!_

Remember - Texas hasn't elected Democrats statewide since 1994. But this is the Holy Grail for Democrats, and they're putting everything they have into it.

We'll need your help to make their plans completely BACKFIRE!!!

_**[Please: I'm not asking you to write a blank check. _Steve Scalise_

| | | I wanted you to hear this straight from me:

**What happens in the Lone Star State could determine the ENTIRE ELECTION. I 'm dead serious.**

This one state has _40 ELECTORAL VOTES_ up for grabs, _ONE SENATE SEAT_ that could turn blue for the first time in 31 years, and _38 HOUSE SEATS_ that could determine control in the People's House.

✘ Early voting just started in Texas and voters are turning out in RECORD NUMBERS in deep-blue Collin and Travis counties
✘ House Democrats just put a huge target on TX-15 and are investing millions to bury Conservative candidates all over the state ✘ Kamala Harris is jetting off to Houston and rallying Radical Democrats THIS FRIDAY to try to turn the tide in Texas
The Democrat Machine is flooding Texas with millions of dollars. The polls are too close for comfort. And our House Majority is already hanging on by a thread.

**I 'm doing everything in my power to save our Majority but now I'm asking you to do your part. Would you be willing to pitch in BEFORE KAMALA HARRIS LANDS IN TEXAS?**

Early voting in Texas JUST started and the General Election is in less than TWO WEEKS. This is crunch time. If we want to keep Texas red and save this country of ours, we MUST have the necessary resources to win.

_If we can raise 250,000 dollars between now and Friday (when Kamala heads to Houston), we 'll have the resources to go on offense in every battleground district in Texas!_

Remember - Texas hasn't elected Democrats statewide since 1994. But this is the Holy Grail for Democrats, and they're putting everything they have into it.

body:

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | Dear Friend,

I'm thrilled to introduce an extraordinary opportunity for you...

Perhaps you've wondered where the artwork accompanying the lectures in our free online courses comes from. We hear this especially for one of our most popular courses, "The Genesis Story."

The Book of Genesis has inspired some of Western Civilization's greatest artists to produce iconic works. You may be familiar with Michelangelo's "The Creation of Adam" and Rembrandt's "The Sacrifice of Issac."

I can still remember seeing "The Creation of Adam" right after I graduated from Hillsdale at the Sistine Chapel...

[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zrc83jdap5d3991g8bluovsq8l4s8e1h6huf4pso_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4sthm9ob0cjh2bs) **We 've compiled these paintings, along with many others featured in this course, into a brand-new coffee table book, "The Genesis Story: Course Companion." And I'd like you to receive a copy.**

With this exclusive book--available only from Hillsdale College--you can read the passages from the Book of Genesis that led Michelangelo, Rembrandt, Gustave Dore, and other masters to create these incredible works of art.

And with these works all in one place, you and your family can enjoy page after page of divinely inspired art.

**You can reserve your copy of "The Genesis Story: Course Companion," an exclusive hard-cover book from Hillsdale College, for a generous donation of $100 or more by clicking the secure link below: **

**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/genesis-story-course-companion-book](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zhtrffhnpv1mfoq03fn0pimd006odnjjuj67oei0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4sthm9ob0cjh2bs)**

Thanks again for your continued support and generosity. I hope you'll enjoy this beautiful book.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01

Hillsdale College

The Book of Genesis has inspired some of Western Civilization's greatest artists to produce iconic works. You may be familiar with Michelangelo's "The Creation of Adam" and Rembrandt's "The Sacrifice of Issac."

I can still remember seeing "The Creation of Adam" right after I graduated from Hillsdale at the Sistine Chapel...

[](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zgirqi5ubr43obrm6bhurl8bocebicorhi7r92co_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4stjmco32c5h2bs) **We 've compiled these paintings, along with many others featured in this course, into a brand-new coffee table book, "The Genesis Story: Course Companion." And I'd like you to receive a copy.**

With this exclusive book--available only from Hillsdale College--you can read the passages from the Book of Genesis that led Michelangelo, Rembrandt, Gustave Dore, and other masters to create these incredible works of art.

And with these works all in one place, you and your family can enjoy page after page of divinely inspired art.

**You can reserve your copy of "The Genesis Story: Course Companion," an exclusive hard-cover book from Hillsdale College, for a generous donation of $100 or more by clicking the secure link below: **

Thanks again for your continued support and generosity. I hope you'll enjoy this beautiful book.

Warm regards,

name: Sherrod Brown and Jon Tester
subject: This is the toughest reelection fight of our lives.
body:
| | | | | |
---

| | | | Hi folks, Jon Tester and Sherrod Brown here. We’re reaching out today because we’re in the middle of the two most competitive Senate campaigns in the country, and we need your help to win. We’re not the typical politicians you’d expect to see every day in the Senate. One of us is a seven-fingered dirt farmer. The other has been called disheveled, wrinkled, and rumpled. Neither of us are winning any best dressed awards anytime soon. **But the thing that really sets us apart? We’ll work with anyone to get the job done for our constituents.** And we’ll always stand up to the special interests in Washington to help folks back home. But right now, we’re in the toughest reelection fight of our lives. **FIRST,** election experts called us the most vulnerable Democratic senators up in 2024. **THEN,** Mitch McConnell and his cronies said they would spend over a hundred million dollars to try to defeat us. **NOW,** we’re officially up against two self-funding multimillionaires who are bankrolling their campaigns themselves. If you would like to attend the ceremony for my brother please reach out to me offline.

| | Dear Friend,

I'm thrilled to introduce an extraordinary opportunity for you...

Perhaps you've wondered where the artwork accompanying the lectures in our free online courses comes from. We hear this especially for one of our most popular courses, "The Genesis Story."

The Book of Genesis has inspired some of Western Civilization's greatest artists to produce iconic works. You may be familiar with Michelangelo's "The Creation of Adam" and Rembrandt's "The Sacrifice of Issac."

I can still remember seeing "The Creation of Adam" right after I graduated from Hillsdale at the Sistine Chapel...

[](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e7327d63080c4e3eba435721af4159cd&_e=NLL9MTHHguVTjIBSG6r_POTLaN_GXxmAh5Rw8TrkhFKubIkCZXpHUPHIl0smIUjD16Fb6aOXXY52Wo0DAExzzk6fmD_Sn8TMH7y-iK-4rECw67TtaPmm08PvqecGSycsg9BglmYeYT7tGeXQkRiVLnagax14oBLAenr0kBROVjdFhtoGePpqq08jVzAPEG7S1Nhdc8x3nKiszq7mI5kSPpvSyR0h9tlWBGG4vDG6GTVrJFkDAHE2gpVAsJxFOgdzgqYWf_LOcqxFrM9tQp8qm16sGUCz6gr8ql_mxqK9wGArTfe7OuV7JTpGXdUR6wA0h9EVTtWsnAVkdvoljIj-Rwh0vWGbc0xAzDDNvrSzmljoFYklvU3susE1Qo4XFjtz-GCfySco6x4tu6ekmmNQ6xthQNe27w8eA9Me-Ye_3WI%3D) **We 've compiled these paintings, along with many others featured in this course, into a brand-new coffee table book, "The Genesis Story: Course Companion." And I'd like you to receive a copy.**

With this exclusive book--available only from Hillsdale College--you can read the passages from the Book of Genesis that led Michelangelo, Rembrandt, Gustave Dore, and other masters to create these incredible works of art.

And with these works all in one place, you and your family can enjoy page after page of divinely inspired art.

**You can reserve your copy of "The Genesis Story: Course Companion," an exclusive hard-cover book from Hillsdale College, for a generous donation of $100 or more by clicking the secure link below: **

**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/genesis-story-course-companion-book](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e7327d63080c4e3eba435721af4159cd&_e=NLL9MTHHguVTjIBSG6r_POTLaN_GXxmAh5Rw8TrkhFKubIkCZXpHUPHIl0smIUjD16Fb6aOXXY52Wo0DAExzzk6fmD_Sn8TMH7y-iK-4rECw67TtaPmm08PvqecGSycsg9BglmYeYT7tGeXQkRiVLnagax14oBLAenr0kBROVjdFhtoGePpqq08jVzAPEG7S1Nhdc8x3nKiszq7mI5kSPpvSyR0h9tlWBGG4vDG6GTVrJFkDAHE2gpVAsJxFOgdzgqYWf_LOcqxFrM9tQp8qm2lc9IjCANcvn6k0h-vg9OBdCXlDTIrHVAtiiEioQI3bA8Pf55cvpmsPc71b8nwRhyq8um5eRZ8y7tOMdBXR3Ywua-95EPOfpS0vNHGJw4_2CmMKZ9KgNCNzJDDopfbXfDZjxkDXU4sgdcmLTzZozsw%3D)**

Thanks again for your continued support and generosity. I hope you'll enjoy this beautiful book.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

I can still remember seeing "The Creation of Adam" right after I graduated from Hillsdale at the Sistine Chapel... We 've compiled these paintings, along with many others featured in this course, into a brand-new coffee table book, "The Genesis Story: Course Companion." And I'd like you to receive a copy. With this exclusive book--available only from Hillsdale College--you can read the passages from the Book of Genesis that led Michelangelo, Rembrandt, Gustave Dore, and other masters to create these incredible works of art. And with these works all in one place, you and your family can enjoy page after page of divinely inspired art. You can reserve your copy of "The Genesis Story: Course Companion," an exclusive hard-cover book from Hillsdale College, for a generous donation of $100 or more by clicking the secure link below: Thanks again for your continued support and generosity. I hope you'll enjoy this beautiful book. Warm regards, Bill Gray, '01 Vice President Institutional Advancement Hillsdale College | | Full Mag News PO Box 1177 Fort Collins, CO 80522 | _

## Paxton Sues Feds Over Voter Citizenship Data
Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton [filed a lawsuit Tuesday](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2O6yAUhJ8Gd7bg8BcKitu4y223tA7mECPhOIvZOHn7VdxvMd03M9L3dZ2umEu-3_7jSr690jYBB9UL3oOaIubynlQXfeDRiY68sOCs0U6qbvE8CTQSZbLWpYu-EMdo5znYQFpZk7rsP2PijATBh6AsGs21MxqFlcQUp5jbVoe2UKMX7qm8tyfVYd7WrviltcfO5D8GI4PxOI4PN9O9Ud2_f7DSh2MwnlUGI9aW50ITmaAJQPVOSNULQal3QbreWJAhiOAuUQ5LW0tXfXwcuZS8G8sUv62Yy3ne_rTx9PAbAAD__5AhX7s) against the Department of Homeland Security for failing to respond to inquiries about the citizenship status of over 450,000 registered voters. Paxton acknowledged that, although most voters in question are likely citizens, the state [could not confirm their citizenship status](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGypCAQRb8Gs54CRBwCgk3MZtMNrVZa7VoES1l35n39K81f0FHXOffW_fPqX8iR0_wbV_LlPeVeS21ASdCmD8jx05sq-EEGpyryqtWutY2rTbX4CZ9O2onqtg3PJgyDck9LzprRuomMrthfMnVfrZV8DKZF28jG2QZVW5MwkgKXvD_KQoXeeEzxk0_aH2Neq-iXUrZD1L-E7oTulpxD5ETXU-jucgvdKSl0d7OAM_ylBBu-S05w_KMDBg6UAMPKiY-yY-Gc4EoAjJFmCpByGvO6RcY0EnCCMxfaYeTCX5SOhTc4aeeJxxsWuqt2H7b_HCMfthVGzityvBuXHyc8vf4OAAD__8sOdjY) because they registered without providing a Texas-issued driver’s license or identification card. After receiving the request, DHS [stated that an online tool](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLHO2yAURp8Gb0RwAQMDQxdv6drRIuYmIGFjmds46dNXyf4P3_RJ50jnz3W-xlLL9vgdVwz0urcZBGguBQc9p1jqe9ZDCjeRvBwwSAvejsYrPeQwCuvAgE0u3sUoF7-AMhqdQuWd9mYo4QOT3ymQ4nLTNo5GGD-aKK1CpgWmQu24UEbCV-z3-m5PPC5LW4caMtHemfrFYGIwUcZcav18DKbcVtzw7AymTpGQn5GWzGDSXjvnHN_ji9rGU-68xrP_LcSfjfDgS6HyD7eey85gGo6Q9rPUWvpomRaPNZavY6AfgzwD_A8AAP__MO9iNQ) called the Systematic Alien Verification for Entitlements program “is the most secure and efficient way to reliably verify an individual’s citizenship or immigration status.” The [lawsuit](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kEGPozAMhX9NuBUFQ6Acclh1hbSH7qVa7RG5xIClABHxlHZ-_aiZ8xws-9lPn6z3_9pfkT2v019cyMpz3HrQUJ0KfYKqd8j-1VeZs3ft2iIjWzTQNrVpyyqb7bkZ2rHQpdHuTmfAM5kaylGbehiSn-0bVqQqodD5vWqwNtq0tcGiKUlVmhzLtucyk9AT4-hf24P2fNiWzNtZJERV_lLQKeiO48iTCUW2faXXRCvt6PNpeyjoIgtFBZ2jET-8KOhG9mnDC05pCDvFd_93u_y5KTCgLyz8SWucOST9GwW_D9sSPPIqSXVvkuASyOXBjdluXTjYe451oyo9Lcg-_Sw_hviw8BUAAP__93dz4w), however, claims the program “is not an adequate tool” for this purpose.
## Battleship Texas in Limbo
The Port of Galveston [rejected a proposed deal](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LGOgzAQBNCvMZ2RvRiMCxfX0OXaK9FiL2DJiRHsheTvT6G_YqqRnkbzcxtvmHJ6LN94J8-vuYygwEitJJgxYsrv0VTRTyo6XZHXFpztWteYavUObOj6OShrph506A0pR11vnKKIE1XJfzB9pQGt6slY7FrVuq5FbRsSRlFMXPaaV2J64THnd3nSXodyr7JfmbdDNF8CBgHDeZ51WPfy-LQChuU3zzIUPFjAgDunkEnAMCFzpmNNm7xIuWB-0sHlIbeys4yEWWrXt62yfb2tW7X7uJ0p53R0Vhi13DHlawH_e8nTw18AAAD___SYY7s) to provide docking space for the refurbished Battleship Texas, despite a statement indicating they want to find a permanent home for the historic dreadnought. The Port's board cited concerns about the cost of moving the ship and the lack of a formal agreement between the foundation that manages it and Landry's, a busy restaurant next to the proposed location. In recent months, another restaurant, Katie's Seafood House, has [sought to halt the ship's relocation](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDHvpCAQxT8NdhgYEY6CYhuby157pRl1VskhGmB199tftP8Xk3nJL3nv5f199k_0wcf5D67kyue19SBAcSk4qH5CH769qiY3iMnKipw0YI1ubaOqxQGRtRqwRdMoayWRVeM4KP36BWYEWXl3mcn7GpCiHpRB3YrW6halaYgpQZMvW6rLQoU-mF_hux2U6nFbq-CWUvbMmgeDjkF3nme95ngxBh1F_s4Mukjn9W49Yzgoly3yc8F0UOYlvXMhyjz7-I9PhIGXjQ_Jx5kPWEqgvPid39kX2T0lLi2DDhN_PGT-_d51ldy0nz4En7VhSswr-nBXLD9udjj4HwAA___FNG-J) to a pier that would hinder its patrons' view of the harbor. Battleship Texas Foundation chairman Thomas Penich [expressed disappointment with the decision](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLHOozAQhJ_GdI7sxcZx4eIaulx7JVrwApYMRniPJG__K-n_YqrRjD59_x7DA1NO-_IXNwr8mssACozUSoIZIqb8HkwTw6ii1w0F7cC7zvrWNGsAjNF399bbEe6KJgfO0Wwn0NorO7smhc-Z_qYFrW6jcdhZZX1nUbuWhFEUE5fzxisxvbDO-V0uOm9T2ZocVuajivaPgF5Aj-Ok208joD9KZQH9iMyZ6poO-Z3L_0dEJrlgvqhy2eVzxfOiKseCZ5RM55Z2ZKpyp6VwQk5lr3JNlcuZJnlRrZSrPDLuAnptjfXKWQF9c4Z4PFPOqXZOGLVsmPKXk38VdwX4CQAA__8103G5) but insisted that "_the future of the Battleship remains bright, and we look forward to finding her forever home_."
## Texas Man Confesses Murder to Blind Date
A Texas man is [awaiting extradition to Houston](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFugzAQQL_GbIeMbSAMHipVbOnaEZ25I7ZqIMJunPx9RfYOJz3pSe9O932drhhi2G5fuLLNz2WflFQGGgnKTIQhviZTkXWShqZi2_Rq6Lt20Kby1umZ9HDBzmlahovTvGBHfOkGI1Xft1WwZ6x5j1aNrJ3psWtlO3QtNr1mYSRTyPtRZ8-Zn5iW-NoffNTzvlbR-pzvSegPoUahxlJK_TM7OqVQ49kWamzkyer0-4obJHwleINn8EjgYtgICDNDCdnDvG8Lp8QEnqFggoJbZoL19yA-ALc9ez4gZcx8LtZjdgcvQn_6e3VYupcQY0hdL4y8rRji-9j87_ceVv0FAAD__zgCcVI) after being apprehended by authorities in Iowa on an outstanding warrant for the 2022 murder of his brother. Kyle Coolack, 37, confessed to the murder Saturday in a conversation with his new girlfriend, Janey Voyek, who met him last week on a blind date arranged by her brother. Coolack is charged with [killing his brother Brad](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGu4yAURL8Gd1jmAsYUFNu4y7ZbWtdwHaPFJsI4Tv7-KelfMcVopKPR-XebbhhT3O9_cSNXX0ueoAPFRcdBTQFjek-qCW7ughUNOWHAml5bqZrVCVxmj4PHYG0gIa00AAJBhCClFLaJ7gMT30gQXTsrg73utO01CiOJqY5CrLm0daVKLzyW9M5PKq3PW5PcWuvjYPIPg5HBeF1X-3_N52dkMGKp0SdiMO50HQxGX-L2qV8Q384SqPDjPB7kK8dS6KgUuMe05nPnPp97ffOYL2QwwqD5bFFpHDz3Wmqu9GC5VXPPDRrjFc1GLbIpLjyumFI8esNUd98wpu_b-qu-p4OfAAAA__8qA3B-) in Houston in March 2022 after being confronted about an affair with Brad’s wife while he was deployed overseas.

## U.S. Lithium Find Could be Vast
Arkansas may hold up to [19 million tons of lithium](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO8yAQhJ8GdxvBgg0uKP7GXf72SouYtSEHJrJxTnn7k3PSdVestKsdzXyaj-t4dTHFdfnvMtk6lxE5KhAcUI3exfQaVePtTIQkG7JCY6-7TqJpgjWIQntsdYutd9KoTnStn4XpJRrTiyba0028RxqFF923k5mV5rPn2PeaKU4-1rJd7iWuNdCcXuVJ22UquUk21PrYmfzHcGA4uO2zxkz7-fw53bq7HW6pLAyHM4rhIPi5C4bDXo4a4Fc2lSN5CO5JQGs5lgAp1hCPDLVAJqrw2MqdpkoekEsOSyo3l8BTdqtvNusfXzGluHcn9pJdTG_M-ldtT4vfAQAA__-WNm2d), or "white gold," in the Smackover Formation, potentially meeting projected 2030 global demand nine times over. I'm thrilled to introduce an extraordinary opportunity for you...

Perhaps you've wondered where the artwork accompanying the lectures in our free online courses comes from. We hear this especially for one of our most popular courses, "The Genesis Story."

The Book of Genesis has inspired some of Western Civilization's greatest artists to produce iconic works. You may be familiar with Michelangelo's "The Creation of Adam" and Rembrandt's "The Sacrifice of Issac."

I can still remember seeing "The Creation of Adam" right after I graduated from Hillsdale at the Sistine Chapel...

[](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1603892550be4c809738773fe3f0c0b1&_e=eXycJz7zR6xntE_d3JPcMPMP2iRSs7UgZMPgMY9j_jTgRLbi_icpGnRGAnpp0b7A4-JBXD-TI60-FnS4gYtMypT3enulFHi6g014Z61FqRayuZ9tD8YDRpLEuusZYMQoqiYGqKCnetdqqszDl-uvlUTCImSDA93m_LsCOUx4BOyJR3bc-WOEDkUHNAmiqgPgxlfuMbtIhOqMNrBqQR9Bp25mHOkK1E8KY4FE19XSZVZ-OgaqKfDaoaH-2N2SxmTKAZVP-umt_TEVGVKDAQxS4GkzaJj9KDtemL0ilpFsEz9Qb93ElEHTZz2Y1EmUagE2fWxEiE1HSm71jipbBENzSKTs_iz8zpEE5cwDho2aZrQi0bWA8PQ076HlIdRdbjoXBeqJLlqRB8AMZHsVC8sRUDdCB_TOOC-Gvmzm-2IhbaY%3D) **We 've compiled these paintings, along with many others featured in this course, into a brand-new coffee table book, "The Genesis Story: Course Companion." And I'd like you to receive a copy.**

With this exclusive book--available only from Hillsdale College--you can read the passages from the Book of Genesis that led Michelangelo, Rembrandt, Gustave Dore, and other masters to create these incredible works of art.

And with these works all in one place, you and your family can enjoy page after page of divinely inspired art.

**You can reserve your copy of "The Genesis Story: Course Companion," an exclusive hard-cover book from Hillsdale College, for a generous donation of $100 or more by clicking the secure link below: **

**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/genesis-story-course-companion-book](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1603892550be4c809738773fe3f0c0b1&_e=eXycJz7zR6xntE_d3JPcMPMP2iRSs7UgZMPgMY9j_jTgRLbi_icpGnRGAnpp0b7A4-JBXD-TI60-FnS4gYtMypT3enulFHi6g014Z61FqRayuZ9tD8YDRpLEuusZYMQoqiYGqKCnetdqqszDl-uvlUTCImSDA93m_LsCOUx4BOyJR3bc-WOEDkUHNAmiqgPgxlfuMbtIhOqMNrBqQR9Bp25mHOkK1E8KY4FE19XSZVZ-OgaqKfDaoaH-2N2SxmTKAZVP-umt_TEVGVKDAQxS4K9ZL-rKJQCqw2MmihEWeQeQQ_b1Qt2CJ3Bj2xjfXuU6vZNYIPJJIvZEWTX7vbEDHwt8JjrjJXDsebftYGSXUNLwA3QWcslwv7w6tFPjKGn6Bh2XcHTLxnSigbjx_6iLEr_yiZbWjpHj1xsFmEZC9Ag%3D)**

body:
We’ve sent a ton of emails and texts your way about Ruben’s efforts to defend Arizona and how important your donations are to making sure we defeat Kari Lake.
Peter —
We’ve sent a ton of emails and texts your way about Ruben’s efforts to defend Arizona and how important your donations are to making sure we defeat Kari Lake.
But we wanted to make sure you saw these numbers specifically:
**2.4%.** That’s the amount Mark Kelly won by in 2020.
**0.3%.** That’s the amount Joe Biden beat Donald Trump by in 2020.
**0.67%.** That’s the amount Kari Lake lost by in 2022.
**$150 million.** That’s how much money is being spent on political television advertisements this fall in Arizona.
**$30.** That’s our average donation over the last week.
People have a way of forgetting just how competitive Arizona is. Forget the polls. This race is just as close as any of the last decade, and it’s just as expensive, too.
We have a little over a week until we close out October, the last full month before the election. $30, or anything you can afford, would go a long way towards helping us hit our goals between now and then.
What do you say?
**[Can you make a split donation of $30 today? Less than that is totally fine. More is also very welcome. If you have the time to keep reading, I hope that you'll take a moment to celebrate our recent wins.
Last year, we really got to work. I introduced legislation to create a national paid leave program — legislation that I first introduced 10 years ago and have continued to advocate for since then. You immediately rallied behind me, voicing your support for this long-overdue legislation. **And today, support for paid family leave is higher than ever before** — including 85% of all voters in battleground states! Thank you for making this possible.
I also**released my Strategic Plan on Aging to make sure that our seniors can retire with dignity and financial stability.** From expanding existing programs like Medicare to helping more seniors remain in their homes, these proposals would drastically improve the quality of life for millions of seniors. Thank you for supporting my work to make this happen.
I'm also incredibly grateful for the outpouring of support from this grassroots team after **I introduced a resolution to finally certify the Equal Rights Amendment.****** This amendment would establish protections against gender-based discrimination in our Constitution, once and for all, giving us a legal basis to restore reproductive rights. Activists have been fighting for the ERA for 100 years, and it is truly an honor to carry forward their work today. Thank you for standing beside me in the fight for gender equity and reproductive freedom.
Lastly, I fought tirelessly to make sure that the National Defense Authorization Act included a pay increase for service members, investments to clean up toxic PFAS contamination and funding for hundreds of spots in my cybersecurity academy at over 400 schools. Thank you for helping me ensure that our veterans and service members get the benefits they deserve.

There have been so many other moments when you've stood beside me, and I am grateful for every single one of them. But our fight for progress is far from over. And now, Democrats are in the most difficult election year in recent memory.
Here in New York, Republicans had their best election cycle in years in 2022. Now, they're directly targeting my seat. With a narrow 51-49 majority, we cannot afford to show any signs of weakness. **Missing my midnight goal would be sending a crystal-clear message to the GOP that this seat is up for grabs.** **[_So please, will you donate $10 or whatever you can spare before 11:59 p.m. tonight to help me continue our fight for progress this year? _**" Predictions are hard, especially about the future."** -Yogi Berra/unknown_
Predictions are fun because they test your mental models of the world. People with great mental models still get stuff wrong. But as a general matter, if you understand a particular domain (e.g. politics) you should be able to say what's going to happen and why. I learn a lot from doing this. If I'm wrong, I learn even more.
Most people in politics "predict" their side will win. This is not prediction; it is a wish.
The below is _not_ necessarily what I _want_ to happen. This is what I believe will happen and why -- regardless of what I want:

**1. White House** : Trump wins and becomes the 47th president of the United States.

**2. U.S. Senate** : Republicans take the majority by 1-2 seats, or it's a 50-50 tie, and Vice President Vance becomes the tie-breaking vote as president of the Senate.

**3. U.S. House** : Democrats take the majority by 2-3 seats. Speaker Jeffries takes the gavel.

_**Overall:** Divided government -- Trump presidency, narrowly Republican Senate, narrowly Democratic House._
--
**1\. White House:**_Trump wins_
For my analysis of the presidential race and prediction that Trump will eventually win the election on the economy, _see here_ - [The Occam's Razor Election.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/ab1ae3ad-d15c-4b27-a24d-9f1ba6525345?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**2\. U.S. Senate** : _51/52-seat Republican majority OR 50-50 tie with Vice President Vance as the tie-breaking vote._
* Tammy Baldwin, Bob Casey, and Elissa Slotkin -- all Democrats -- will win in Wisconsin, Pennsylvania, and Michigan, respectively, because they are (1) _very_ skilled candidates (2) deeply in touch with their voters, and (3) very well-funded.
* Baldwin and Casey are also incumbents, which helps.
* Slotkin is a sitting Congresswoman running for an open Senate seat, which is almost as good.
* I expected Midwestern Dems to increasingly break from the Biden-Harris record on the economy as we got closer to Election Day. And that's [precisely what they are doing now.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/c69f6763-fafe-4a75-86f3-6a0a3fec2b52?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) This will help them win, even if Harris loses.

[](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/d166c8e4-195b-4355-b9ed-7250c6afb3fb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* Senator Sherrod Brown will very, very narrowly win in Ohio. Brown is an economic [populist](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/3415ab31-01fe-4e52-8d26-d816f56e3759?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) who champions ["the dignity of work"](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/17a1f4ce-a8ed-44ed-81a1-06381ef970ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) -- not a typical, establishment Democrat. And he's a well-liked incumbent, while his challenger, Bernie Moreno, is relatively unknown and unimpressive.
* In Ohio, Wisconsin, and PA, Republicans have recruited independently wealthy millionaires to challenge incumbent Dems, because they can self-fund their campaigns. This is a mistake. They're mostly stiff on the campaign trail, have weak local ties, and might struggle to connect with voters.

[](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/ada4b14d-318e-4ede-8e67-3dc718e48272?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* Senator [Jon Tester](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/aebaf5c8-58a5-45eb-8409-94caebe3e27c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), as much personal affection and hope as I have for his brilliant career, will lose in Montana. It is a changed state with more Republicans today, partly due to in-migration and partly due to a polarized national environment post-Trump. And the Biden-Harris record on inflation and immigration is too big a cross to bear in Montana, even for a star politician.
* The Republican challenger, 38-year-old Tim Sheehy, is also an independently wealthy millionaire with weak ties to the state and an awkward campaign style. But he's a veteran, and his partisan advantage is probably too great.
* [Rep. Ruben Gallego will beat Kari Lake in Arizona](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/40faeaf1-64ef-4e9c-be59-e43deb7af867?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) because he is (1) a skilled candidate (2) deeply in touch with his electorate, including many moderate "John McCain Republicans" and (3) very well-funded.
* Gallego has outworked, outraised, and out-messaged his competition, including incumbent Sen. Krysten Sinema, who [dropped out in March.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/d9bde473-d95f-4102-b3a5-c74a60f5aae0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* Kari Lake is attractive and charismatic, but has [alienated moderate Republicans](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/a479dc04-1a39-4ddf-aa33-546ffda2c127?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and comes across like a kook.
* Trump copycats always struggle down ballot, because Diet Coke in a can is never as good as Mexican Coke in the glass bottle - i.e., the real thing.
* In Nevada, Democratic Sen. [Jackie Rosen](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/67d784c6-adb3-4d60-bc25-19b13fd0ecc8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) will narrowly beat Republican challenger Sam Brown, thanks to her fundraising advantage, incumbency, built-in union infrastructure, and cross-over appeal with Republicans.
* Former Republican Gov. Larry Hogan is a _very_ good and popular candidate for Senate in Maryland, but national politics is different, and Maryland is too blue for him to flip. Democrat Angela Alsobrooks will win here.
* Similarly, incumbent Republicans Ted Cruz (Texas) and Rick Scott (Florida) have real challengers, but will beat them back because these are still red states. Scott wins easily, Cruz barely.
* Sen. Joe Manchin (D-West Virginia) is retiring and will be replaced by [an obese, no-show, almost billionaire Republican governor, amazingly named Jim Justice.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/8d248c39-6815-45cc-b1be-56da324bd001?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* The tie comes from something that is still a longshot, but one I'm willing to bet on: [Dan Osborn - independent populist - will unseat Republican Deb Fischer in Nebraska.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/8d248c39-6815-45cc-b1be-56da324bd001?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* Fischer is what Zillenials like me, raised on the internet and video games, call an [NPC](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/e3f3dc07-674b-4206-bd7b-c5e0892f433b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) - a non-player character.
* She's fake as hell and just goes along with whatever is happening in DC and has no real ideas or backbone of her own. Stylistically, the opposite of Trump. In a place like Nebraska, that's incredibly unattractive. So she really might lose.
* [Again, this election isn't just about D vs. R; it's populism vs. the establishment.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/3415ab31-01fe-4e52-8d26-d816f56e3759?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Someday journalists and "experts" will realize this, and stop being surprised that a state like Nebraska might elect both Trump and Osborn. (Duh: they're both anti-establishment economic populists.)

[](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/65627e7b-22eb-48d3-9558-807676453a28?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* That means Dems lose two seats: West Virginia and Montana. And they gain one independent, Osborn, who will caucus with Democrats, like Sens. Bernie Sanders (Vermont) and Angus King (Maine) already do.
* The result is a 50-50 Senate with the next vice president as the tie-breaking vote. Dramatic, I know.
* But it's more likely that I am biased, and overestimating Senate Democrats' ability to win where I believe Trump will also win (e.g., Pennsylvania). So Republicans probably get a 1-2 seat majority outright.

**3\. U.S. House** : _Dems take the majority by 2-3 seats. Hakeem Jeffries becomes Speaker._
Perhaps more on this later, but here are my top line perceptions:
1. [Democrats have ](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/ab7d13d7-cdfb-4aa0-9c79-2b4301830856?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[a lot](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/ab7d13d7-cdfb-4aa0-9c79-2b4301830856?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[more money,](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/ab7d13d7-cdfb-4aa0-9c79-2b4301830856?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and fundraising and ad spend matter the most in down-ballot congressional races, where most voters don't know either candidate.
2. Hakeem Jeffries, the Democratic House leader, is a serious and formidable person. I've met him. He's a pro. Mike Johnson, the Republican Speaker, is performing admirably for a [noob](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/d69116a1-5d3f-42f5-95dd-050bea84561c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), but still looks to me like a deer in the headlights.
3. Republican House members have behaved like deranged cats for the past two years, and there will be a price to pay for their childishness and incompetence.
4. **[Candidate quality matters.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/6a66df86-71e7-418c-a8ae-1d9a3a1cdcb8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Democrats simply have better congressional candidates than Republicans along any objective rubric: _biography, resume, likability, message, and campaign skills_. All else equal, better candidates tend to win.
5. Many of the competitive House seats are in affluent suburbs, including in blue states like California and New York, and Democrats do well in suburbs for three reasons:
1. **Education** - the biggest predictor of voting Dem these days is holding at least a 4-year college degree.
2. **Assets** - if you own a home and a 401k, you think the Biden-Harris record on the economy is good; if you live paycheck-to-paycheck, you think it is horrible.
3. **Abortion bans** - when you invite the wrath of the suburban wine moms, as Republicans have done, God help you.

A final prediction within a prediction:
As time goes on, if Harris continues to lose momentum, expect Democratic House candidates in battleground districts to pitch themselves as a _" check and balance on a Trump presidency."_ Voters will like this. Many swing voters are reluctantly voting for a second Trump term, but still don't want to give him total control of Congress; they might split their ticket in a way we haven't recently seen.
Where I could be wrong: if Trump really is doing well, as I believe he is, he may have 'coattails' that deny Democrats even the House majority via California and New York. I don't think that will happen. But, again, it could be wishful thinking for me to think it won't.
See you in 13 days...

body:
So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil. | [](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=eaa480a7106749baae5d4df4b82ffa12&_e=WrXiHFKYH2A9zJYCKNtNqyjSYe0Osl1mDA8IK_5ahEHZPnQyE0EvVyWQlcha5e3_W5t-zR5SS90jQZvSEKVCA4FqiRVkKjVIHtNmW-AmmydJyPD915FdoPfXddYBpx9bDEnhjraTRF1fD2l4TPbt0yIuWj3oivMMaXI9StGuwnXS-YVeBCp7mT1mRow0fbD-6_ddWuudcvtaxE6Pn5CFf4SAi92uwFntw2Nx_XrtMwWdBZsw9Le34LolrLrnFsirwr9nqoS30REydI6d113CV5_Mhb-Kn_N3umxrsnOV1SxOjq3gG-DypKb5NQZfwLjsAa8bU48xcysViEHVThvxoez4ZmMxmWynmFxLb5mY7mjFoHg_b2cra4yjmLsKFVsQ8U2KqCIa-wbNPR5GHedDXpagHkMqFjobDhli205fYb4%3D)

---
Peter,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, **those are the traits that define me**. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to **[launch a campaign for the United States Senate last June.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=eaa480a7106749baae5d4df4b82ffa12&_e=WrXiHFKYH2A9zJYCKNtNqyjSYe0Osl1mDA8IK_5ahEHZPnQyE0EvVyWQlcha5e3_W5t-zR5SS90jQZvSEKVCA4FqiRVkKjVIHtNmW-AmmydJyPD915FdoPfXddYBpx9bDEnhjraTRF1fD2l4TPbt0yIuWj3oivMMaXI9StGuwnXS-YVeBCp7mT1mRow0fbD-6_ddWuudcvtaxE6Pn5CFf4SAi92uwFntw2Nx_XrtMwWdBZsw9Le34LolrLrnFsirwr9nqoS30REydI6d113CV7radmegtUsPZX4VbvHFhIGK2kwnY0SlXDgwH05qjBDjxnvDenxepEVoxq6f4W0NOLiFPpebI2oC1QHxPN3rojrC5YpkCNVErxhix7r8PV506Dj8jC8l_yoF_mC__8gbAz_9zob7s98i-a04V6QVvBU%3D)**

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [_**many veterans like me**_] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=eaa480a7106749baae5d4df4b82ffa12&_e=WrXiHFKYH2A9zJYCKNtNqyjSYe0Osl1mDA8IK_5ahEHZPnQyE0EvVyWQlcha5e3_W5t-zR5SS90jQZvSEKVCA4FqiRVkKjVIHtNmW-AmmydJyPD915FdoPfXddYBpx9bDEnhjraTRF1fD2l4TPbt0yIuWj3oivMMaXI9StGuwnXS-YVeBCp7mT1mRow0fbD-6_ddWuudcvtaxE6Pn5CFf4SAi92uwFntw2Nx_XrtMwWdBZsw9Le34LolrLrnFsirwr9nqoS30REydI6d113CVxQkXx08yKr8ucSABJpx6GgvPBLe3tkdAzRVnFrTTN9MU-YugrqcHWMZ1tZmlUPe8W1aEVjbe_fB18ZiTneKtSI-czQc_bg6VrINmLgaHz8SoCY5Vr8pLl9AbupraO4R71f74MGwFamzuWKGfZ54V7o%3D)
This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, _**“I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’”**_

Every day it got worse.
Every day it was a disaster.
The adult in the room never materialized.

**Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport.** Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden and Kamala Harris could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.”

I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. _**So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt**_ because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil.

**If you're thinking this email is on the longer side, you're right.** If you're short on time and unable to finish reading to the end right now, **[please do me a quick favor and confirm that I have the correct information on file for you](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=eaa480a7106749baae5d4df4b82ffa12&_e=WrXiHFKYH2A9zJYCKNtNqyjSYe0Osl1mDA8IK_5ahEHZPnQyE0EvVyWQlcha5e3_W5t-zR5SS90jQZvSEKVCA4FqiRVkKjVIHtNmW-AmmydJyPD915FdoPfXddYBpx9bDEnhjraTRF1fD2l4TPbt0yIuWj3oivMMaXI9StGuwnXS-YVeBCp7mT1mRow0fbD-6_ddWuudcvtaxE6Pn5CFf4SAi92uwFntw2Nx_XrtMwWdBZsw9Le34LolrLrnFsirwr9nqoS30REydI6d113CV_xVytnEDOUv7gJ72UdSOcjqB2NjWvCkqdkG-4soN1qTOaZwoBkc0SJjR2v8k5uFRoyH8AiOROhx-xADNIUbwIhHAU1pew3Go2D2NQFpxxf0hfxK3ESqwpBje5JlcxolSFClPEJIk66JAdX8Y4Vav5w%3D)** ; my opponent and his allies will not make winning this seat easy.

[**JOIN OUR FIGHT
ENLIST WITH TIM TODAY->** ](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=eaa480a7106749baae5d4df4b82ffa12&_e=WrXiHFKYH2A9zJYCKNtNqyjSYe0Osl1mDA8IK_5ahEHZPnQyE0EvVyWQlcha5e3_W5t-zR5SS90jQZvSEKVCA4FqiRVkKjVIHtNmW-AmmydJyPD915FdoPfXddYBpx9bDEnhjraTRF1fD2l4TPbt0yIuWj3oivMMaXI9StGuwnXS-YVeBCp7mT1mRow0fbD-6_ddWuudcvtaxE6Pn5CFf4SAi92uwFntw2Nx_XrtMwWdBZsw9Le34LolrLrnFsirwr9nqoS30REydI6d113CV9nVgRJmwFK6uAl2iQ2hETM4rJvDTHGNh-n6KtntepbdGahdMTZHRy9ehSnN0DypyntxA1OGQEE6HZFLq8kGzW-tN_SohlfI1EezqFZmLLFBaKyNm5HogSE877K3ttRCC0VYcdeDLxyvH6mlcA7uuJ4%3D)

It was in the aftermath of the fall of Afghanistan that I ever truly considered entering politics. Deciding to launch a campaign for the United States Senate wasn’t an easy decision; **but the United States needs leaders who understand the sacrifice it’s taken to build our country. When your country calls and needs you, you have to answer. **

[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=eaa480a7106749baae5d4df4b82ffa12&_e=WrXiHFKYH2A9zJYCKNtNqyjSYe0Osl1mDA8IK_5ahEHZPnQyE0EvVyWQlcha5e3_W5t-zR5SS90jQZvSEKVCA4FqiRVkKjVIHtNmW-AmmydJyPD915FdoPfXddYBpx9bDEnhjraTRF1fD2l4TPbt0yIuWj3oivMMaXI9StGuwnXS-YVeBCp7mT1mRow0fbD-6_ddWuudcvtaxE6Pn5CFf4SAi92uwFntw2Nx_XrtMwWdBZsw9Le34LolrLrnFsirwr9nqoS30REydI6d113CV-DIcvUeiGOpQGGrLzM6wGmyJ0c1S1tUapCHuzf0sx6bU4J6ktwvw2Mdfr7FqpFjUtn5M3jTneADSfXas42sIZirrOcBnke_Xv8cPcXhI0KtwXzrLfEfETF_vwxD7wx7Mx7dtTGJ-9MK44WPs3wOzNA%3D)
**Unlike Joe Biden and Kamala Harris, I understand what it is to serve our country. Not service in politics, but on the battlefield.** I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free.

[**ENLIST WITH TIM
CONFIRM YOUR SUPPORT TODAY->** ](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=eaa480a7106749baae5d4df4b82ffa12&_e=WrXiHFKYH2A9zJYCKNtNqyjSYe0Osl1mDA8IK_5ahEHZPnQyE0EvVyWQlcha5e3_W5t-zR5SS90jQZvSEKVCA4FqiRVkKjVIHtNmW-AmmydJyPD915FdoPfXddYBpx9bDEnhjraTRF1fD2l4TPbt0yIuWj3oivMMaXI9StGuwnXS-YVeBCp7mT1mRow0fbD-6_ddWuudcvtaxE6Pn5CFf4SAi92uwFntw2Nx_XrtMwWdBZsw9Le34LolrLrnFsirwr9nqoS30REydI6d113CVwZCuX2OFiZKLtuqWuvPTGvhYdCHd0XPAaf0yhftGQx7wcHrwvV8TewsmNmpTcvIHwzU6mdrLs1ZpBd6oLEZ8302CLHjcnhch8TcY0zAjyg_ycRZMDqukWbT68cl7-ZEUUqGw94FLtqafSTQ6nHc2XM%3D)

I’m reaching out to you today because if this campaign to flip Montana’s U.S. Senate seat is going to be successful, **[I’m going to need the help of every conservative donor who reads this letter.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=eaa480a7106749baae5d4df4b82ffa12&_e=WrXiHFKYH2A9zJYCKNtNqyjSYe0Osl1mDA8IK_5ahEHZPnQyE0EvVyWQlcha5e3_W5t-zR5SS90jQZvSEKVCA4FqiRVkKjVIHtNmW-AmmydJyPD915FdoPfXddYBpx9bDEnhjraTRF1fD2l4TPbt0yIuWj3oivMMaXI9StGuwnXS-YVeBCp7mT1mRow0fbD-6_ddWuudcvtaxE6Pn5CFf4SAi92uwFntw2Nx_XrtMwWdBZsw9Le34LolrLrnFsirwr9nqoS30REydI6d113CVx3CamOmrhanRBeob_suD7CFckWzIxQ4LON6ITy4XO7leUBnjl3iecWY0KQC8EndW5szVDiwh9UkYku36VCUf78hYioeT-BcRRbYBXS8VeOmAZCiNBhh6OJzKzlQTJWu1t5K8m2V3kka3mQkTlNSQrs%3D) **

Twice in a row, Joe Biden has pulled us out of two wars for political purposes.

We fought in Iraq, _**I was there.**_ We fought in Afghanistan, _**I was there.**_

And each time, for political purposes, Biden pulled out our forces and damaged our nation’s reputation in the process. And my opponent in the Senate race, Democrat Jon Tester, supported Biden both times.

I want to look at my children and tell them, _**“Yes, you should serve your country, as your mom and dad did. Your parents put on the uniform; you should do the same.”**_

[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=eaa480a7106749baae5d4df4b82ffa12&_e=WrXiHFKYH2A9zJYCKNtNqyjSYe0Osl1mDA8IK_5ahEHZPnQyE0EvVyWQlcha5e3_W5t-zR5SS90jQZvSEKVCA4FqiRVkKjVIHtNmW-AmmydJyPD915FdoPfXddYBpx9bDEnhjraTRF1fD2l4TPbt0yIuWj3oivMMaXI9StGuwnXS-YVeBCp7mT1mRow0fbD-6_ddWuudcvtaxE6Pn5CFf4SAi92uwFntw2Nx_XrtMwWdBZsw9Le34LolrLrnFsirwr9nqoS30REydI6d113CV9HSeySMjZ5EGwedeCNIHk4in4bMvBe99k1s2dhaJBKKIgurzJm67VsBVTI64W-RJNjRwM4xqj9dt2eb1KQrnDvAuHtDT_Oa16HKVJHeUGrmMsvhFeKioUiu9HcK8AZ0AMGpH7gflD22wUk1fW9pt8Q%3D)
**But when we have a president who is willing to pull the plug on a whim for political purposes, it’s hard to tell future generations the sacrifices in service of God and country will be worth it.**

So, Peter \- that’s what I’m fighting for. I’m fighting to restore faith in our American way of life. I entered the political arena to ensure the sacrifices my friends made weren’t made in vain.

[**HELP ME FLIP THIS SEAT
ELECT A FIGHTER TO THE U.S. SENATE->** ](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=eaa480a7106749baae5d4df4b82ffa12&_e=WrXiHFKYH2A9zJYCKNtNqyjSYe0Osl1mDA8IK_5ahEHZPnQyE0EvVyWQlcha5e3_W5t-zR5SS90jQZvSEKVCA4FqiRVkKjVIHtNmW-AmmydJyPD915FdoPfXddYBpx9bDEnhjraTRF1fD2l4TPbt0yIuWj3oivMMaXI9StGuwnXS-YVeBCp7mT1mRow0fbD-6_ddWuudcvtaxE6Pn5CFf4SAi92uwFntw2Nx_XrtMwWdBZsw9Le34LolrLrnFsirwr9nqoS30REydI6d113CV6M7xE-NIKigILL776PuRH0igmN9HnqwozbSgdp-pOYIytE5yQRHXjg8HvYo5fag5cCgyG26aFHfzWAQ__pAgOFlCxz5K40Ls128qZgQ7MmKJiUJgg16H90FnaCUgZJMKFzcx5Gkbx_J-CkcXMO6iwA%3D)

clean_body: So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil. | Peter, As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams. Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, those are the traits that define me. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [many veterans like me] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead. This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, “I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’” Every day it got worse. Every day it was a disaster. The adult in the room never materialized. Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport. Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden and Kamala Harris could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.” I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil. If you're thinking this email is on the longer side, you're right. If you're short on time and unable to finish reading to the end right now, ; my opponent and his allies will not make winning this seat easy. It was in the aftermath of the fall of Afghanistan that I ever truly considered entering politics. Deciding to launch a campaign for the United States Senate wasn’t an easy decision; but the United States needs leaders who understand the sacrifice it’s taken to build our country. When your country calls and needs you, you have to answer. Unlike Joe Biden and Kamala Harris, I understand what it is to serve our country. Not service in politics, but on the battlefield. I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free. I’m reaching out to you today because if this campaign to flip Montana’s U.S. Senate seat is going to be successful, Twice in a row, Joe Biden has pulled us out of two wars for political purposes. We fought in Iraq, I was there. We fought in Afghanistan, I was there. And each time, for political purposes, Biden pulled out our forces and damaged our nation’s reputation in the process. And my opponent in the Senate race, Democrat Jon Tester, supported Biden both times. I want to look at my children and tell them, “Yes, you should serve your country, as your mom and dad did. Your parents put on the uniform; you should do the same.” But when we have a president who is willing to pull the plug on a whim for political purposes, it’s hard to tell future generations the sacrifices in service of God and country will be worth it. So, Peter \- that’s what I’m fighting for. I’m fighting to restore faith in our American way of life. I entered the political arena to ensure the sacrifices my friends made weren’t made in vain. | **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

The Illinois State Rifle Association's gun range near Kankakee, Illinois.
By Illinois Review

On Wednesday, the Illinois State Rifle Association released a statement offering former U.S. Congressman Adam Kizinger (R-IL) and Missouri Senate candidate Lucas Kunce (D) complimentary firearm safety and training lessons after a Kansas City reporter was accidentally shot on Tuesday afternoon during a campaign event at a private residence.

“After learning about an incident yesterday in Missouri where TV Reporter Ryan Gamboa was accidentally shot during a campaign event in the backyard of a private residence due to U.S. Senate candidate Lucas Kunce (D-MO) and former Congressman Adam Kinzinger (R-IL) violating commonly known safety rules by firing at steel targets in close range with an AR-15 using inappropriate ammunition, the ISRA would like to offer a complimentary firearm and safety training class at our 5-star range in Kankakee, Illinois area – Kinzinger’s hometown.”

By Illinois Review
A local Kansas City reporter was accidentally shot on Tuesday afternoon during a campaign event at a private residence featuring Never Trumper and former Illinois Republican Congressman Rep. Adam Kizinger and Missouri U.S. Senate candidate Lucas Kunce – a Democrat who’s challenging Republican Sen. Josh Hawley.

Kunce and Kinzinger were shooting at targets during the staged photo op when reporter Ryan Gamboa was accidentally struck in the arm by shrapnel after the Democrat Senate candidate fired his AR-15 rifle. Although the injuries were minor, a photo shows Gamboa’s bloodied arm wrapped in a bandage. The reporter was sent to a local hospital and he was released a few hours later.
