name: Marjorie Taylor Greene
subject: I'm grateful for you, Friend
body:
| | | | |
---
Friend,
Sometimes I need to remind myself that no matter how bad things are in America right now, we must always remember to be grateful for what we do have.
**I’m grateful for supporters like you.**
It’s not just because you help me keep my job in Congress...
It’s not just because of how much it means to have Americans like you fighting alongside me all across our great nation...
It’s because _**you remind me that there are still millions of patriots out there who don’t want to see America crumble, who don’t want to see God replaced by government,**_ and _**who don’t want to see our freedom and our borders demolished and destroyed!**_
_**I’m writing you today primarily to say ‘Thank You.’**_
But I’m also writing you to see if you’ll make **_one last push_** with me to _**win this election**_.
[MAKE ONE LAST PUSH TO VICTORY](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9iHW/?__vbtrk=MjU1MjkxOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU1MjkxOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
Let me tell you why I feel like I need to ask, and let me tell you where we are in this stage of the race.
When our analysts look back at 2020, it’s clear **Georgia is going to be THE most important swing state in this election. **
The most important thing you need to know is that _**no matter how hard the Democrats try to cheat this election...**_
**No matter how hard the fake news media parrots the Harris Regime’s propaganda and _refuses_ to ask the tough questions...**
And **no matter how many millions the Democrats raise, or how many lawyers they’ve bought out and compromised...**
**With your help, Republicans like you and me can – and will – win this election!**
[GET REPUBLICANS OVER THE LINE](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9iHW/?__vbtrk=MjU1MjkxOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU1MjkxOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
In 2020, my district had **the lowest voter turnout in the entire state of Georgia** – leaving thousands and thousands of Republican votes on the board that would’ve gone to President Trump.
With your help, _**that won’t happen again.**_

In 2024, our Republican Governor and Secretary of State in Georgia are auditing and removing _thousands of illegal aliens_ from our statewide voter rolls...
_**Illegal votes that would’ve all gone Democrat**_**!**
Those two things – **increasing Republican turnout** and **removing illegal voters** – should mean a landslide victory for President Trump and our Republican leadership in Georgia.
But here’s the thing, Friend...
My campaign is quickly running out of funds as we fight off the Kamala Harris campaign’s relentless attacks.
And with election day almost here, we must be able to recuperate these funds right away so we can make this final push to register and rally voters.
**So please, if you want to finish this campaign strong with me and make a huge difference in winning this election.**
**__**
**_[RUSH AN URGENT CONTRIBUTION NOW TO GET US OVER THE LINE](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9iHW/?__vbtrk=MjU1MjkxOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU1MjkxOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_!**
[SECURE TOTAL GOP VICTORY](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9iHW/?__vbtrk=MjU1MjkxOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU1MjkxOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
Supporters like you make up 70% of my campaign’s total fundraising...
So it’s no exaggeration when I say **_I’m relying on you_** to help me lead and win this fight in Georgia...
**A fight that will have a direct impact on the entire election and the entire country.**
Regardless of the amount, Friend, I want you to know **how much supporters like you mean to me.**

**Together we will win this fight to save our country!**
**_[ARE YOU WITH ME](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9iHW/?__vbtrk=MjU1MjkxOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU1MjkxOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)?_**
_Never Surrender,_
[](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9iHW/?__vbtrk=MjU1MjkxOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU1MjkxOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
_Marjorie Taylor Greene_
[](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9iHW/?__vbtrk=MjU1MjkxOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU1MjkxOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)

---

Around 9:45pm on Tuesday night, Oct 22, 2024, I got word that the Westport Amtrak Station would have a ribbon-cutting ceremony the next day. This station had undergone a major renovation, complete with heated platforms so that the community can enjoy 12-month service. [The Depot Theatre](https://substack.com/redirect/0e6be8df-925b-48b7-bf9a-08d0c9a46c94?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is in the back, with staff on hand to make sure the waiting rooms and bathrooms are open, and to answer questions from arriving and departing passengers. Talk about community partnerships!
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8ef019bb-ab72-4f7d-b572-863691298bea?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Hearing this news about the ribbon-cutting, my team and I determined that we should attend. After all, this Westport Station will make a tremendous impact on the area for generations to come!
I had heard that my Republican opponent was going to make an appearance. This would be ideal: either I, or members of my campaign team, could finally ask Elise face-to-face about a debate or a town-hall-style meeting. The voters have been asking, and I feel an obligation to do absolutely everything in my power to make that come about.
Let me tell you about my team. Juno Ni is a recent graduate of NYU where they engaged in significant studies on internet hate speech. Jacques Manuel holds two masters degrees from London School of Economics, where they studied the intersection of politics, philosophy, and social media. Jacques travelled and wrote about the separatist movements in Scotland and in Spain: what is it that would make a group of people want to separate from their home countries, and what does that look like while it is in progress? I say this because, while you might see us arrive, with Juno and Jacques' brightly-colored hair (and apparent youth) and think, "How and why are they a part of a congressional campaign in upstate New York?". In many ways the combined expertise of my team members in internet hate speech and groups who want to ditch it all and form their own government make us ideally suited for our in-the-trenches work with MAGA opponents.
We were not able to speak directly with Elise Stefanik. She sent some other person in her place to offer a few words. I was attentive to the message, since the sign at the gate clearly stated that the funding for the Westport Amtrak renovation had come from Joe Biden's Infrastructure Law, which Stefanik had voted against. As it turned out, Stefanik's representative did not mention anything about the source of funds for the project.
Juno and Jacques went to the Westport event prepared with a written invitation to Elise Stefanik to debate.
We have reserved the meeting room downstairs at The Crandall Library at 251 Glen Street in Glens Falls on Monday, October 28, 2024, at 6:30pm. If Stefanik declines or simply does not RSVP, we will show the film, "From Russia with Lev" and have a discussion immediately afterwards.
I hope you can join us.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/463ac3ba-ead0-42bf-acf0-d6431e12cde2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
From Westport, we went canvassing in Plattsburgh. As before, we picked a street and knocked on doors. Even though it was mid-afternoon, a number of people were home. We got more than a few warm responses - "Oh, Paula! I am so glad to meet you! You've definitely got my vote!".
We got one tepid response from a household with Harris/Walz signs, but the guy who answered the door was unsure about what to do with the rest of their ballots. Hm.
I knock, I introduce myself, and ask if they vote. One family said they don't vote. They leave it up to God. OK.
After I ask if they vote, I ask, "What's important to you this election."
Overwhelmingly, on the street where we were yesterday, the response was, "the economy".
They want to pay less at the pump, less at the grocery store, and less in taxes. They want to make sure that whatever they pay in taxes goes to support things in their area, like parks, schools, roads.
Some of those are state and local issues, like the parks and school taxes.
Many people think that Joe Biden determines the price of eggs.
The professor in me wants to launch into a comparative study of our economy versus that of our peer nations. We are outperforming every other nation in the world. Granted - that doesn't go over well. Nobody wants to hear that their gas is high, but the guy in the UK is paying more.
We have seen more about Donald Trump's [cognitive decline in recent weeks](https://substack.com/redirect/d33716fc-f488-4dbb-ae07-a40a05ce37d6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) than the cameras previously have shown. We know that Republicans ranging from Dick Cheney to [John Kelly](https://substack.com/redirect/eac6ae66-b5da-4b80-9b41-709dcb3f0196?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) are not only endorsing Harris, they are sending up the red flags over Trump's embrace of fascism.
A second Trump presidency will not be a repeat of the first Trump presidency for the simple fact that numerous members of his team will simply not be in the White House to prevent Trump's childish, vengeful executive actions. The best and the brightest have decided that they just cannot support Trump any longer.
By the way, the economic plans of Donald Trump and Kamala Harris have been reviewed by economists from across the globe. Trump's plan costs the average middle-class taxpayer $4,000 more per year than that of Harris.
I can't truthfully say the economy doesn't matter to me, but what I need to convey to voters is this: sure - the price of gas is high, but what price will we pay if we lose our basic way of life?
_If we haven 't met yet, I am Paula Collins, the Democratic and Working Families Party Candidate for New York's 21st Congressional District. Your comments are invaluable to me. Please let me hear from you. Remember that you can always visit my website at www.paulacollinsforcongress.com or by sending me a text at 315-230-3920. _

Why does Kamala Harris keep talking about what she *will* do instead of owning up to what she has failed to deliver?

_**Honestly.**_

Kamala has had almost four years to make good on her promises to the middle class, and what has she accomplished? Hardworking families are worse off--higher prices on gas, groceries, and everything in between.

_(Reminder: under President Trump, the middle class and hardworking North Carolinians thrived)._

When it comes to her policy positions, Kamala Harris has earned quite the reputation as a "Flip-Flopper" in politics. She constantly changes her stance depending on political gain. This lack of conviction makes it impossible to trust where she truly stands on issues that affect hard working Americans. We need leaders with real principles, not ones who bend at every turn for political convenience.

For example - Kamala Harris has drastically failed Americans when it comes to illegal immigration. She hasn't and will never put Americans first when it comes to securing our border.

Kamala Harris is too radical to be our next President.

America desperately needs new leadership from the top down if we're going to get our country back on track. I'm ready, willing, and able to do my part - I'm ready to SERVE and LEAD as your next Congressman in this fight.

**[Are you ready to help me get the job done in the home stretch?](http://links.harriganfornc.com/u/click?_t=687026f8d8f7415aa539c5385c376b1f&_m=a5a864127d2e4076a080306283b28fc2&_e=g-ScFS2dYtqLt4133hWGneJmhV_L8QLiq6v1KFEX3tvn7sBMXHG6JlO9DCjJSoNIjb7OYp-nyTLZrqgXjTIZJV67Hu9yb9ODFz2W4safb-Jm_Bk-iLV3z3iukdaBCVBUKcc7aF46hJFVm_wytolV4sWCUI_5au7ACYx8rkX6r4R_nLuN8psDgftuzDxC2V4HwKTUvaQsRwvSMXNUNclT18b6CNgop2k5SLvwkA-R-Rzw5UGHd5Z37RR4zitPRyZgJLlhi3BS3nrxdxxnF4IClvd5cVt2LXUynOOV7XkMsguHX_OCTs_8wwa-skydC4zWbrUsYZYrBydpza3uQbGShAkX2VMkcPsAJqvUaQmYqEc%3D)**

If Vice President Harris truly cared about helping hardworking Americans, she would have taken action already. This is nothing more than political posturing.

_Pat Harrigan_

clean_body: Why does Kamala Harris keep talking about what she will do instead of owning up to what she has failed to deliver? | Why does Kamala Harris keep talking about what she will do instead of owning up to what she has failed to deliver? Honestly. Kamala has had almost four years to make good on her promises to the middle class, and what has she accomplished? Hardworking families are worse off--higher prices on gas, groceries, and everything in between. (Reminder: under President Trump, the middle class and hardworking North Carolinians thrived). When it comes to her policy positions, Kamala Harris has earned quite the reputation as a "Flip-Flopper" in politics. She constantly changes her stance depending on political gain. This lack of conviction makes it impossible to trust where she truly stands on issues that affect hard working Americans. We need leaders with real principles, not ones who bend at every turn for political convenience. For example - Kamala Harris has drastically failed Americans when it comes to illegal immigration. She hasn't and will never put Americans first when it comes to securing our border. Kamala Harris is too radical to be our next President. America desperately needs new leadership from the top down if we're going to get our country back on track. I'm ready, willing, and able to do my part - I'm ready to SERVE and LEAD as your next Congressman in this fight. If Vice President Harris truly cared about helping hardworking Americans, she would have taken action already. This is nothing more than political posturing. Derek,
I think the choice in front of us this November is pretty clear: Do we want our leaders to be about results, or about insults?
With Democrats in charge in Washington, we’re focused on solving problems and making progress. In the past few years, we’ve passed landmark legislation that has made a meaningful difference in Americans’ lives.
The American Rescue Plan sent direct relief to families and individuals in need, expanded the child tax credit, provided emergency grants to small businesses, and lowered health insurance premiums.
The Inflation Reduction Act lowered electricity bills, capped the price of insulin at $35/month for seniors, created more than 170,000 clean energy jobs in its first year alone, and made the largest investment in climate action ever.
The Bipartisan Safer Communities Act added protections for victims of domestic violence, created new funding for states to help keep deadly weapons out of the hands of dangerous individuals, and cracked down on criminals evading firearms licensing requirements.
The Bipartisan Infrastructure Law is closing the digital divide in rural America by delivering high-speed internet, repairing and rebuilding our roads, bridges, ports, and public transit options, and expanding access to clean drinking water for homes, businesses, schools, and child care centers around the country.
The Republicans on the ballot this November — from Donald Trump and JD Vance to my opponent Hung Cao to many of the GOP’s Congressional candidates — don’t have any meaningful plans to solve problems and get results.
Instead, they’re focused on insults... insulting their opponents and political adversaries, insulting our allies abroad, and insulting the American people .
That’s not what leadership is.
If you’re ready to move on from extremism and insults and get back to respect and results, I’m asking for your support today. With your help, we can secure decisive victories for Democrats up and down the ballot.

In the past few years, we’ve passed landmark legislation that has made a meaningful difference in Americans’ lives. The American Rescue Plan sent direct relief to families and individuals in need, expanded the child tax credit, provided emergency grants to small businesses, and lowered health insurance premiums. The Inflation Reduction Act lowered electricity bills, capped the price of insulin at $35/month for seniors, created more than 170,000 clean energy jobs in its first year alone, and made the largest investment in climate action ever. The Bipartisan Safer Communities Act added protections for victims of domestic violence, created new funding for states to help keep deadly weapons out of the hands of dangerous individuals, and cracked down on criminals evading firearms licensing requirements. The Bipartisan Infrastructure Law is closing the digital divide in rural America by delivering high-speed internet, repairing and rebuilding our roads, bridges, ports, and public transit options, and expanding access to clean drinking water for homes, businesses, schools, and child care centers around the country. The Republicans on the ballot this November — from Donald Trump and JD Vance to my opponent Hung Cao to many of the GOP’s Congressional candidates — don’t have any meaningful plans to solve problems and get results. Instead, they’re focused on insults... insulting their opponents and political adversaries, insulting our allies abroad, and insulting the American people . That’s not what leadership is. If you’re ready to move on from extremism and insults and get back to respect and results, I’m asking for your support today. With your help, we can secure decisive victories for Democrats up and down the ballot. Will you pitch in to my re-election campaign today to help us turn out a record number of voters between now and November 5th? name: National Day of the Deployed via USO
subject: Read this personal account from a former Army logistics officer
body:
Before National Day of the Deployed, will you support our heroes?
[](https://www.uso.org)
[DONATE NOW](https://links.e.uso.)
---
★ ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ ★
---
[**Support service members in honor
of National Day of the Deployed**](https://links.e.uso.)
[](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/zdb4h3k0G~cN/aE0zUE9NeDdXSWNaWGpLdkxwT1BoQ1dqRmdPazJRVTA5MHFHRHUrTHFvUWRnMEdFRmU1QWtPOU5HYlZDVFpYbmp2MnhYaTdDeU9jeDl3bTVHZnpidGNaMUhoellRNFdiLzhjSzZFeGhIWDA9S0/SS9HbThkelJlSnlscHE1V3NYa1JHNEtoUGFEYndjaytTZnplbVpSaU5HMVZIb0dISmgrVnZiSkRGa2dlRkY2V253enY1djAvVkpKUFo1SDQ0Zi9GREI3Sk9pT1crdHlaS0) [](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/zdb4h3k0G~cN/aE0zUE9NeDdXSWNaWGpLdkxwT1BoQ1dqRmdPazJRVTA5MHFHRHUrTHFvUWRnMEdFRmU1QWtPOU5HYlZDVFpYbmp2MnhYaTdDeU9jeDl3bTVHZnpidGNaMUhoellRNFdiLzhjSzZFeGhIWDA9S0/SS9HbThkelJlSnlscHE1V3NYa1JHNEtoUGFEYndjaytTZnplbVpSaU5HMVZIb0dISmgrVnZiSkRGa2dlRkY2V253enY1djAvVkpKUFo1SDQ0Zi9GREI3Sk9pT1crdHlaS0)
| ****[DONATE NOW](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/A-VKBbDNaAfL/aE0zUE9NeDdXSWNaWGpLdkxwT1BoQ1dqRmdPazJRVTA5MHFHRHUrTHFvUWRnMEdFRmU1QWtPOU5HYlZDVFpYbmp2MnhYaTdDeU9jeDl3bTVHZnpidGNaMUhoellRNFdiLzhjSzZFeGhIWDA9S0/SS9HbThkelJlSnlscHE1V3NYa1JHNEtoUGFEYndjaytTZnplbVpSaU5HMVZIb0dISmgrVnZiSkRGa2dlRkY2V253enY1djAvVkpKUFo1SDQ0Zi9GREI3Sk9pT1crdHlaS0)****
---
********
When you're deployed, it feels like your life stands still. But for your loved ones back home, life keeps going.
The friend who got engaged right before you left? She's now married with her first child on the way.
The smiling baby nephew you kissed goodbye? He'll be a walking, talking toddler by the time you see him again.
As much as you try to keep in touch with phone and video calls, there are so many missed moments you'll never get back. And you inevitably return to a world that is not quite the same as the one you left.
**These are the facts of military life and deployment, and to be honest, it 's incredibly difficult. But as a former Army logistics officer who served in Iraq and Syria, I want you to know that your support of the USO really does make a difference for service members deployed around the world.**
**[In honor of National Day of the Deployed this week, will you please donate $29 to help the USO continue supporting deployed service members and their families all over the world?](https://links.e.uso.)**
[SUPPORT OUR HEROES NOW](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/A-VKBbDNaAfL/aE0zUE9NeDdXSWNaWGpLdkxwT1BoQ1dqRmdPazJRVTA5MHFHRHUrTHFvUWRnMEdFRmU1QWtPOU5HYlZDVFpYbmp2MnhYaTdDeU9jeDl3bTVHZnpidGNaMUhoellRNFdiLzhjSzZFeGhIWDA9S0/SS9HbThkelJlSnlscHE1V3NYa1JHNEtoUGFEYndjaytTZnplbVpSaU5HMVZIb0dISmgrVnZiSkRGa2dlRkY2V253enY1djAvVkpKUFo1SDQ0Zi9GREI3Sk9pT1crdHlaS0)
---
When I was deployed, the USO was a huge source of comfort and support. It was a place we could go to forget about the stress of our everyday work. We could leave our rank and uniforms behind and just play a game, have a snack, talk and live like we were at home for a little while.
_Thank you, from the bottom of my heart, for supporting this meaningful work._
**I know there are so many deployed service members around the world right now who continue to rely on the USO for support. That 's why, ahead of National Day of the Deployed, I'm asking you to make a donation toward USO's $75,000 goal before the deadline on Saturday.**
**[Please, will you give $29 or more right now to make a life-changing difference for service members coping with the challenges of deployment? I promise, your support means the world.](https://links.e.uso.)**
Thank you,
Claudia W.

# You Can Make It Happen!
---
| Peter,

We’re on the verge of something extraordinary. Kamala Harris is poised to become the first woman of color president of the United States of America, and **YOU can be part of this historic moment**. Your vote doesn’t just flip Georgia blue—it changes the future for generations. **This is bigger than any one race—it’s about making history.**

When we elect **Kamala Harris AND Patti Hewitt** , we’re building a stronger, more inclusive future where healthcare, education, and economic fairness are protected. **Don’t miss your chance to be part of this game-changing moment!
**

* **🗳 Voter Info:**

**Early voting is happening NOW** until November 1, 2024. 👉 [**Check your polling location and sample ballot here**](https://pattiforgeorgia.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b4d0ba6402550309dbd7c06a&id=1abf7b748b&e=0f456155ff)**.

**

* **📣 Take Action:

** Don’t just vote—show up and bring your energy! Find out where Kamala and Patti are rallying in your area and attend a town hall with a neighbor or rally with a friend to get others fired up for Election Day.

* **💪 Let’s Power This Movement:**

Feeling the excitement? Help us keep the momentum going by reaching more voters. **Even a small donation today helps us** spread the word and drive voter turnout.

[**Donate $10 now**](https://pattiforgeorgia.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b4d0ba6402550309dbd7c06a&id=a13ad9eec0&e=0f456155ff) to make history with us!

This is the moment we’ve been waiting for. Be a part of history, vote, and let’s flip Georgia blue!
Let’s do this! 💙

** __Meet Dr. Prasanth Reddy:__** Dr. Reddy is a cancer physician and immigrant who's lived the American Dream. In the aftermath of 9/11, he answered his country's call. He became a citizen, joined the U.S. Air Force Reserve, and still serves as Lt. Colonel today. Dr. Reddy is running for Congress against a Democrat who votes with Joe Biden 100% of the time, in one of the most competitive House districts in the country. | Dear Fellow American,

Thanks to the support of hundreds of thousands of committed conservatives, our expert team of election law attorneys take a historic leadership role in successfully fighting for honest elections in this election year.
And now, our election law team needs to be ready _on a moment 's notice_ to investigate any _credible allegations_ of voter irregularities before, on or after Election Day, November 5th...and then, if necessary, to file lawsuits!
**[That's why I am asking you to make a special contribution to Judicial Watch today.](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70812&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)**
| [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70812&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

Hopefully, we will _not_ have to deploy our legal team this year, as we did during the post-election chaos four year ago!

But _we must be ready_ to stand tall for the rule of law and honest elections, which is why your support today, as votes are already being cast across the country, is so important.

And even if this election goes smoothly, and whatever the final results are, we will still be confronting the Radical Left in their non-stop efforts to undermine election integrity, including...

* "Extending" Election Day beyond the date set by federal law (we're in court now fighting **Illinois** and **Mississippi** on that front!)

body:
So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil. | [](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=7e0aee41025b457cad8776efa01cb5fc&_e=0nOQ3MjTKlfSGy6y50PGDuDm32tPJtOUI2MJAHVXXfAXkoFJiAgmnlsq-kJP1RWg754pqp4NqTaMchCia8u-foYxlW3xmvbvtpcSWg7RbSVTZm-Pw-WHFfti3lNmwFJsBWAWECmoiVxz0ZvyVDUcb5rMyWqspzYeVM8xeIq1hRjHOggNzEaw9jundoQgeY2P2ZZLOKVl-2tLFtZRg6thkya4yXr6xGiDwmY_IdsMkZLwFOXP6UzAjgFlm-bTiQdBBUN5xwPPny0POcqvFz1fGv9i3MvQTH_whdth7D8KRae4UEU1Q-2HnkFY_id5gjbt3vmmYl7ttcI5LAAdz76eWbaLdpRMB0lo9gjOf6HCYF1Qa-prtKvi2rsD42OralJmmLh7sfTUjBd-VAlQ9Jua7e9SV-23LrK2KLDtBUyzC7o%3D)

---
Fellow Conservative,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, **those are the traits that define me**. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to **[launch a campaign for the United States Senate last June.](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=7e0aee41025b457cad8776efa01cb5fc&_e=0nOQ3MjTKlfSGy6y50PGDuDm32tPJtOUI2MJAHVXXfAXkoFJiAgmnlsq-kJP1RWg754pqp4NqTaMchCia8u-foYxlW3xmvbvtpcSWg7RbSVTZm-Pw-WHFfti3lNmwFJsBWAWECmoiVxz0ZvyVDUcb5rMyWqspzYeVM8xeIq1hRjHOggNzEaw9jundoQgeY2P2ZZLOKVl-2tLFtZRg6thkya4yXr6xGiDwmY_IdsMkZLwFOXP6UzAjgFlm-bTiQdBBUN5xwPPny0POcqvFz1fGhxFt63lVWkuIE15_Rylgo3I-JNio9FeJhPJhLMjRR20JeXm-GsGFINOfwo71Y1M8eaFUTfLH6CAJ8twNqpanhuZpPmLSCGiGTHIC9vujPRVwRTRW1Zq1YL03h5Oe3RiwP3pqkcOzKLm-YeLaYcTjms%3D)**

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [_**many veterans like me**_] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

[](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=7e0aee41025b457cad8776efa01cb5fc&_e=0nOQ3MjTKlfSGy6y50PGDuDm32tPJtOUI2MJAHVXXfAXkoFJiAgmnlsq-kJP1RWg754pqp4NqTaMchCia8u-foYxlW3xmvbvtpcSWg7RbSVTZm-Pw-WHFfti3lNmwFJsBWAWECmoiVxz0ZvyVDUcb5rMyWqspzYeVM8xeIq1hRjHOggNzEaw9jundoQgeY2P2ZZLOKVl-2tLFtZRg6thkya4yXr6xGiDwmY_IdsMkZLwFOXP6UzAjgFlm-bTiQdBBUN5xwPPny0POcqvFz1fGm6ncyFtHA6W1st4vM78HKUAD-uA2RZL_MJ7U1Pl5gSANzpHPbJewUioDnPRQw6c6nezojRsE-AIGX0pZ_VLRMq0qsKvueEcLc5TIN28cwfpPA2H5cWoA-pb3OHgT1lOq3FW4ENN1oz6xvFakOXejhs%3D)
This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, _**“I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’”**_

Every day it got worse.
Every day it was a disaster.
The adult in the room never materialized.

**Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport.** Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden and Kamala Harris could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.”

I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. _**So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt**_ because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil.

**If you're thinking this email is on the longer side, you're right.** If you're short on time and unable to finish reading to the end right now, **[please do me a quick favor and confirm that I have the correct information on file for you](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=7e0aee41025b457cad8776efa01cb5fc&_e=0nOQ3MjTKlfSGy6y50PGDuDm32tPJtOUI2MJAHVXXfAXkoFJiAgmnlsq-kJP1RWg754pqp4NqTaMchCia8u-foYxlW3xmvbvtpcSWg7RbSVTZm-Pw-WHFfti3lNmwFJsBWAWECmoiVxz0ZvyVDUcb5rMyWqspzYeVM8xeIq1hRjHOggNzEaw9jundoQgeY2P2ZZLOKVl-2tLFtZRg6thkya4yXr6xGiDwmY_IdsMkZLwFOXP6UzAjgFlm-bTiQdBBUN5xwPPny0POcqvFz1fGnd5OQfj91Hv9X4eRk6vnQ_4D6nPyRA78saICUXXDhpPSmmnlOrTHOOPsHZ059BxY_J4lBc-oP0JZW9hx564GOWehIr_kfmyRVza6vfwkWSjCF7REX9i4B7yX84_2ahyf7qzq-JRNWA-JuqX6_1SXa4%3D)** ; my opponent and his allies will not make winning this seat easy.

[**JOIN OUR FIGHT
ENLIST WITH TIM TODAY->** ](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=7e0aee41025b457cad8776efa01cb5fc&_e=0nOQ3MjTKlfSGy6y50PGDuDm32tPJtOUI2MJAHVXXfAXkoFJiAgmnlsq-kJP1RWg754pqp4NqTaMchCia8u-foYxlW3xmvbvtpcSWg7RbSVTZm-Pw-WHFfti3lNmwFJsBWAWECmoiVxz0ZvyVDUcb5rMyWqspzYeVM8xeIq1hRjHOggNzEaw9jundoQgeY2P2ZZLOKVl-2tLFtZRg6thkya4yXr6xGiDwmY_IdsMkZLwFOXP6UzAjgFlm-bTiQdBBUN5xwPPny0POcqvFz1fGjVYfxVBcGWOkkiknCiYtNMq_y9VikIS64CsuxORQ-IX36mCp5ja9qh5-V_fOKiloakoGzWXiUMo8bp4BSVBm3ZdGrv_Ve-DXjWwLZbRCnEFFt0_oILz0K61_T8YITub3P9vJu8UamL69JkUI7NIcA4%3D)

It was in the aftermath of the fall of Afghanistan that I ever truly considered entering politics. Derek,

Over and over again for the last 10 days, Donald Trump has called me “the
enemy within.” It’s a dangerous new escalation of the attacks he’s made on
me ever since the time I first stood up to him as president.

He’s singling me out by name. Threatening to send the United States
military after people like me, who have held him to account.

Since then, two sides have emerged — those Republicans who have left
Trump’s cult of personality, and those who still live within it.

People like JD Vance, Mike Johnson, and other MAGA leaders have defended
Trump’s statements. Even VA Governor Glenn Youngkin lacked the character
to denounce such a dangerous gambit by the would-be dictator.

They are like many Republicans who have failed the test of courage to
stand up to him over the last decade — even when he threatens the power of
the United States military against its own citizens.

But there are many, including people like Donald Trump’s former military
chiefs and defense secretaries, who said we should take his comments
seriously, along with hundreds of officials from previous Republican
administrations.

Or Adam Kinzinger and Liz Cheney, who served with me on the January 6
Select Committee and have put country over party to support the only
pro-democracy candidate on the ballot, Kamala Harris.

Derek, I know
where I stand. I know the serious threat Donald Trump poses to the rule of
law, and I know that if we want our democracy to thrive, he must be
defeated on November 5.

body:
We’re now just 12 days away from Election Day, and this is the final stretch! | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/riverforcolorado/15daysremaining-8329958?e=3818d77efc)

# 12 Days Left—We Need Your Help to Turn Out Young Voters!
---
|
We’re now just 12 days away from Election Day, and this is the final stretch! Our campaign has the energy, the momentum, and the support we need to win—but we need your help to bring it home.
One of the most important groups we need to reach in these last days is young Democrats. Many of them have their ballots in hand, but we need to remind them to turn those ballots in and make their voices heard. The best way to reach them is through text reminders and targeted digital ads, but we need the resources to do that effectively.
Here’s how your donation can help:
* $25 will send text reminders to 700 young voters urging them to turn in their ballots.

* $100 will allow us to expand our digital ads to reach thousands of young Democrats who haven’t voted yet.

Every dollar you contribute will help us mobilize the voters we need to secure a win. Can you chip in $25, $50, or whatever you can today to fund this critical outreach?
Young voters are key to our victory, and we can’t afford to miss this opportunity. With your support, we can remind them to vote and push our campaign over the finish line.
Let’s keep the momentum going in these final 12 days—together, we can make history!
Thank you for standing with me.
In solidarity,
River Gassen
Democratic Candidate for U.S. Congress, Colorado - 5
P.S. Time is running out, but it’s not too late to make a difference. Your donation today will help us reach young Democrats and remind them to turn in their ballots. Please contribute now!

# **When we stand together,****we can overcome.**
---
Dear Peter, In this pivotal election, your vote has the power to bring about real change—and even in**PA** where Dr. Cornel West is not on the ballot, you can still make your voice heard by writing in his name! **Note: an official write-in vote in your state counts!** To support Dr. West’s campaign for justice, equality, and democracy, simply write "CORNEL WEST" in the write-in section of your ballot. Every vote counts in the fight to build a better future for all Americans, free from the grip of corporate interests and broken politics. Your vote for Cornel West is a vote for a future rooted in justice, equality, and true democracy. Together, we can disrupt the status quo and ensure that the voices of everyday people are heard over the noise of corporate interests.
---
| [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/dnc?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=pennsylvania_write_in&n=2 "Donate Now") [Donate Now](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/dnc?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=pennsylvania_write_in&n=2)
---
**Here's How You Can Help Now:**
1. **Make a plan to vote.** Whether you're voting early or on Election Day, ensure you're ready to write in “Cornel West” on your ballot.
2. **Donate.** Your contributions empower us to continue spreading our message and organizing voters. Every donation, no matter the size, makes a big difference.
3. **Shop merchandise.** We've launched our [online shop](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/r?u=810mQJoaZrS9jX-sfil2xK4KnLhdwcMVodGLCvMo7xQ&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=pennsylvania_write_in&n=3) with t-shirts, hoodies, yard signs, bumper stickers, and more! Show your support and spread the word by leading with love.

This election is a chance to stand up for what matters most—justice, dignity, and a future that works for everyone, not just the wealthy and powerful. By writing in Cornel West, you're joining a movement of people who believe in these principles. Make your voice heard. Write in Cornel West.

### Nashua and Statewide Republicans Condemn Democrats’ ‘Shadow Impeachment’ Scheme, Applaud Secretary of State’s Defense of Election Integrity
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** October 24, 2024
---
| | **CONTACT** Pete Silva, Nashua GOP ChairPsilvanrcc@gmail.com

---
| Nashua, NH – The Nashua Republican City Committee is raising the alarm over what it calls a blatant “shadow impeachment” orchestrated by Democrat officials in Nashua, aiming to strip Republican candidates of their authority as elected ward moderators for the upcoming election.
“This is nothing less than an underhanded attempt to remove our Republican election officials from their posts under false pretenses,” said **Peter Silva** , Chairman of the Nashua Republican City Committee. “How can this be understood as anything other than Democrats trying to undermine fair elections by sidelining those who would ensure transparency and accountability?”
Democrat officials claimed that Republican ward moderators on the ballot could not oversee elections in their wards. However, the Secretary of State’s office rejected this maneuver, affirming that these officials must retain their roles, with temporary moderators assigned only to handle specific ballot-counting tasks.
“The Secretary of State’s decision protects the integrity of our elections from these partisan attacks,” said**Bill O’Brien** , Republican National Committeeman for New Hampshire. “This was an outrageous effort to disqualify Republican officials and disrupt oversight at polling places.”
Nashua and Statewide Republicans pledge to remain vigilant against further attempts to disenfranchise Republican election officials and hide from voters what is going on at the polls.

I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’” | [](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=68543c3f608044ed83a5e920cfe7571b&_e=Si7XxSoNP8Tw8ZjpW4tc7e61ioUwTc20yxKmJOQHeL8Nn3La6v2TEWRfYBK3gbBjqrSXPIC5xzwfhVxHi-YEEHC5JYw_8G4DvOsBG3oGD7UhaqDyHr0pwuab_BlrkjXDwIB8JPhaDVVv-7x6559bvxGm4DAGXdIRIdG9PTe4zbGZULE4rM6IORxnoeUMXHcGCkSGutpuzCUO6SEtb12Z6xkQplmDaA3Y6hp6qYTzPA8quQa39gcTlpkr1aKmptCctzS-0qLyAbGMqtUdq92r4cVQrf7xi6Xr_5uwDIgy5RXwysKzdVwWegAMzfzY3yfLy1R64agG3iDi2tEmpv6TsXpSyfdU1xTMuSfmP4sal6-_RT_pCH5kZHBL_NcnbQ-TmFW7sPvozoRCikAuVrHGEU6ra8fdW39BAxrMWoxuNEI%3D)

---
Fellow Conservative,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, **those are the traits that define me**. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to **[launch a campaign for the United States Senate last June.](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=68543c3f608044ed83a5e920cfe7571b&_e=Si7XxSoNP8Tw8ZjpW4tc7e61ioUwTc20yxKmJOQHeL8Nn3La6v2TEWRfYBK3gbBjqrSXPIC5xzwfhVxHi-YEEHC5JYw_8G4DvOsBG3oGD7UhaqDyHr0pwuab_BlrkjXDwIB8JPhaDVVv-7x6559bvxGm4DAGXdIRIdG9PTe4zbGZULE4rM6IORxnoeUMXHcGCkSGutpuzCUO6SEtb12Z6xkQplmDaA3Y6hp6qYTzPA8quQa39gcTlpkr1aKmptCctzS-0qLyAbGMqtUdq92r4f2BlwQ3jFcmvRLtOEI0tke-GR5wAIA4ewjD-U88VwyecVW5i5ncBYvpAYFciP_rQpKlm8a_QRQ11PoodhH7eHZyxOzP2K2_wwHrxjKBOJqjYg2xyo5BVLfiPjGwf_NptkLG_WXEeA1oL-RIV7Oprtw%3D)**

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [_**many veterans like me**_] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

[](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=68543c3f608044ed83a5e920cfe7571b&_e=Si7XxSoNP8Tw8ZjpW4tc7e61ioUwTc20yxKmJOQHeL8Nn3La6v2TEWRfYBK3gbBjqrSXPIC5xzwfhVxHi-YEEHC5JYw_8G4DvOsBG3oGD7UhaqDyHr0pwuab_BlrkjXDwIB8JPhaDVVv-7x6559bvxGm4DAGXdIRIdG9PTe4zbGZULE4rM6IORxnoeUMXHcGCkSGutpuzCUO6SEtb12Z6xkQplmDaA3Y6hp6qYTzPA8quQa39gcTlpkr1aKmptCctzS-0qLyAbGMqtUdq92r4dPxUGd93NxHM_pZq2VxKa86yfAy42Q45Z5rOho0JzHBywixyy5P-DjLsenywjzQcqVaXNeq_r8kxtC6Ujnl6-8j7MYNDC0T4-MVdvROkfh4Ff3OKpTSqBYShLo3IKltGFh8mzneE2mgdy-zDPAFtvg%3D)
This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, _**“I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’”**_

Every day it got worse.
Every day it was a disaster.
The adult in the room never materialized.

**Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport.** Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden and Kamala Harris could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.”

I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. _**So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt**_ because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil.

**If you're thinking this email is on the longer side, you're right.** If you're short on time and unable to finish reading to the end right now, **[please do me a quick favor and confirm that I have the correct information on file for you](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=68543c3f608044ed83a5e920cfe7571b&_e=Si7XxSoNP8Tw8ZjpW4tc7e61ioUwTc20yxKmJOQHeL8Nn3La6v2TEWRfYBK3gbBjqrSXPIC5xzwfhVxHi-YEEHC5JYw_8G4DvOsBG3oGD7UhaqDyHr0pwuab_BlrkjXDwIB8JPhaDVVv-7x6559bvxGm4DAGXdIRIdG9PTe4zbGZULE4rM6IORxnoeUMXHcGCkSGutpuzCUO6SEtb12Z6xkQplmDaA3Y6hp6qYTzPA8quQa39gcTlpkr1aKmptCctzS-0qLyAbGMqtUdq92r4TPqC7BOiJKVuF3qs_SUYTrgzfITovNpnNC6ndzm40qdSm4psPrnTTmmDaRDHEWkM4vyis93rj9_lDijEFYjXvOdOqWBt3M8R6mNw6Dsi0_AhsoGOlZLgQfkgj-bw1aQ1wFRORdRMoks80RqVTyPmP4%3D)** ; my opponent and his allies will not make winning this seat easy.

| The MassGOP Mourns the Loss of Former Mayor Ken Gray
---
---
| Boston, MA- The MassGOP is deeply saddened by the passing of former Mayor of Amesbury, Ken Gray, a man whose visionary leadership and unwavering commitment to his community left a lasting impact on the city he loved.
Ken Gray's tenure as mayor was marked by his dedication to fostering economic growth while preserving Amesbury's unique charm. His thoughtful approach to development brought new businesses and jobs to the city without sacrificing the small-town appeal that so many residents cherish. Through his leadership, Amesbury thrived, balancing progress with tradition.
Mayor Gray was not only a forward-thinking leader, but he was also deeply community-focused. His open-door policy, approachable nature, and genuine concern for the needs of Amesbury's residents helped create a stronger, more connected city. Whether it was addressing the concerns of a single citizen or collaborating with city officials and local organizations, Ken always prioritized listening and responding to the community he served so diligently.
Amy Carnevale, Chair of the Massachusetts Republican Party, shared her condolences on behalf of the MassGOP:
"Ken Gray's leadership and dedication to Amesbury serve as an enduring example of what it means to be a public servant. He had a remarkable ability to balance growth with preserving the spirit of the community, all while ensuring the voices of residents were heard and respected. His loss is deeply felt by all who had the privilege of working with him, and his legacy will continue to inspire us for years to come. Our thoughts and prayers are with his family and the people of Amesbury during this difficult time."
Ken Gray's collaborative spirit, visionary leadership, and responsive governance have left an indelible mark on Amesbury. The MassGOP extends its deepest sympathies to his family, friends, and the Amesbury community as they mourn the loss of a true leader and public servant.

clean_body: I’m running for Congress to fight for YOU because Granite Staters deserve a leader who is dedicated to protecting our fundamental freedoms, defending our democracy, and lowering costs for hard-working families! | = | Peter, One of the most important lessons I learned while serving in the Navy is how to work with people who you may not see eye to eye with. In politics, we may not agree on everything, but we find common ground and get the job done because that is what it takes to deliver for our community. I’ve carried this lesson with me throughout my life, and I’ll bring that same type of common-sense leadership with me to Congress. The rise of right-wing extremism and the divisive politics ushered in by Donald Trump has stifled all of our progress and brought Congress to a standstill. I know that if we come together – even when we don’t agree – we can still make meaningful progress for Granite Staters. I’m running for Congress to fight for YOU because Granite Staters deserve a leader who is dedicated to protecting our fundamental freedoms, defending our democracy, and lowering costs for hard-working families! Peter,

We are less than two weeks from Election Day, and our chance to unseat Derrick Van Orden and bring some locally-focused representation to Congress.

But that hasn’t stopped our campaign from keeping our foot on the gas, meeting voters in towns and cities across our district. We’re listening, learning, and sharing our vision for WI-03 – because every last voter will matter here.

I wanted to share some highlights from recent events. But first and foremost, I want to thank you, Peter. Your support has gotten us to this point, and with every conversation we have I’m more confident than ever that we can flip this seat.

I hope to see you out on the trail,

Rebecca

* * *

**I waded through Wetherby's bogs in Warrens.** Wisconsin is the largest producer of cranberries in the US and a big part of the economy here in WI-03. Nodji Van Wychen's family has grown here for 120 years. It's family businesses like hers I'll fight to protect in Congress.I met up with old friends I used to show with from Juneau County at the state fair. Communities big and small, we show up to listen.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95719523/507669917/639146828?refcode=em-10.24.24-all-1-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzUwMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0OWIxNDdlOC0yMDkyLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hREZwu0oEMrXMqI26jy91PnCjE-KYbVTVaJqAMCu8B4=)
**I met with the International Association of Sheet Metal, Air, Rail and Transportation Workers, including General President Michael Coleman and Steve Dodd, here in Eau Claire.** I’m grateful to have their support. A top priority of mine in Congress is to get the PRO Act passed, undoing the work of Act 10 and bolstering worker power in Wisconsin.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95719524/507669919/639146828?refcode=em-10.24.24-all-1-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzUwMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0OWIxNDdlOC0yMDkyLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hREZwu0oEMrXMqI26jy91PnCjE-KYbVTVaJqAMCu8B4=)
**It was a beautiful day for the homecoming parade at UW-Platteville, where I got to talk with students and voters from WI-03’s most southern UW campus.** Our crew was out for UWEC's homecoming parade, too. Students will decide this election!
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95719525/507669920/639146828?refcode=em-10.24.24-all-1-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzUwMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0OWIxNDdlOC0yMDkyLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hREZwu0oEMrXMqI26jy91PnCjE-KYbVTVaJqAMCu8B4=)
**I had breakfast on a brisk morning with the Town of Howard Fire Department in Chippewa County - just down the road from where I grew up, in the Town of Wheaton.** Grateful for our first responders and law enforcement that keep our communities safe!
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95719527/507669921/639146828?refcode=em-10.24.24-all-1-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzUwMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0OWIxNDdlOC0yMDkyLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hREZwu0oEMrXMqI26jy91PnCjE-KYbVTVaJqAMCu8B4=)
**And every quarter I host a labor gathering bringing together union leaders from across WI-03. That tradition continues when I'm elected.** I was grateful to meet with these folks in Onalaska. My office will always have an open door for working families and organized labor.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95719530/507669922/639146828?refcode=em-10.24.24-all-1-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzUwMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0OWIxNDdlOC0yMDkyLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hREZwu0oEMrXMqI26jy91PnCjE-KYbVTVaJqAMCu8B4=)
I’m so grateful to everyone on the trail, and it’s been the highlight of this campaign to meet the voters of WI-03 where they are. With early voting underway, we need to hit another gear to win this race and flip WI-03.

| | Friend, I’m sure you’re getting a ton of emails about the upcoming election. If they’re like the emails I get, the emails go something like “the world is ending unless you donate $5 immediately.” And you get 30 of them every day. With all the hyperbole, it’s easy to forget about the actual policy ramifications of this election. I want to briefly go over what’s at stake during this election:
* Republicans are attempting to strip women of their reproductive freedoms across the country.
* Donald Trump is saying he will work with Republicans to overturn the result of the election if he loses.
* The GOP is hoping to undermine and even potentially overturn the Affordable Care Act, taking away millions of Americans’ healthcare.
* The right has promised to roll back the reduced carbon emissions that Democrats were able to achieve.

That’s just the beginning of Donald Trump and Cliff Bentz’s radical and anti-democratic agenda for America. I hate hyperbole, but this is one of the most important elections in our nation’s history. We can’t let them win. If Republicans win, the world won’t end. But it will be very bad. The climate will get worse, women’s rights will be further rolled back, many Americans will lose their healthcare, and our democracy might not ever recover. Unlike Cliff Bentz, I’m committed to protecting women’s rights, safeguarding democracy, reducing carbon emissions, and securing healthcare access for all Americans. body:
Aurora cover-up: Leaders downplayed Tren de Aragua gang threat while residents suffered
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
Yesterday was a HUGE news day over here at Rocky Mountain Voice! So much so that we couldn't fit it all into this newsletter. We've moved things around today so you don't miss out, but also make sure to head to our [website](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for more original pieces from around the state.

This is the Mountain Minute for Thursday, October 24, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Aurora cover-up: Leaders downplayed Tren de Aragua gang threat while residents suffered](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
In recent months, Aurora has become the focus of growing concerns regarding the infiltration of Tren de Aragua, a notorious Venezuelan criminal gang.
The gang’s alleged involvement in local criminal activity, including the takeover of certain apartment complexes and the intimidation of residents, has left law enforcement, property managers, and the community on high alert.
According to internal emails shared on Twitter/X from the Aurora Police Department, officers had knowledge of Tren de Aragua’s activities as early as September 2023. However, CBZ Management, overseeing some of the affected properties, alleges they were not informed. In a public statement on X, CBZ Management expressed frustration: “The police knew about the Tren de Aragua gangs taking over our properties as early as Sept 22, 2023, and didn’t warn us! Worse, they put the onus of security on our employees without us knowing the danger!”
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**ELECTION MUST-READS 🗳️**
[**Lundberg: The jungle primary and ranked-choice voting that Prop. 131 would create is a very bad idea for Colorado**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY KEVIN LUNDBERG | COMMENTARY | OCTOBER 23** _This year’s election is the most polarized political season we have ever seen. But there is one major issue that both parties agree on, Proposition 131 is a very bad idea. This proposition will create a jungle primary and establish a ranked-choice voting system for most general election choices._
[**Ganahl: Rinard the right choice for University of Colorado regent at-large**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY HEIDI GANAHL | COMMENTARY | OCTOBER 23** _The race for University of Colorado regent at-large in 2024 is shaping up to be a critical contest that will determine the future direction of the University of Colorado system._
[**Daniel: My fellow hunters, anglers and 2A advocates, won’t you join me and vote?**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY BOBBIE DANIEL | COMMENTARY | OCTOBER 23** _Dear fellow Colorado hunter, angler and 2A advocate, I am reaching out with a simple but important message: vote. If you are like us, you have probably spent more time planning a hunting trip or drawing a tag than it takes to register to vote and fill out a ballot._

|
---
**[Ganahl: Is the Pueblo mayor on a Republican revenge tour?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Pueblo, Colorado, has become the backdrop for a politically charged controversy involving Republican Mayor Heather Graham and Pueblo conservatives._
_Graham’s election to mayor over incumbent Democrat Nick Gradisar was a shock in 2023. After decades of Democratic rule, conservatives celebrated a new direction in their beloved city. The celebration didn’t last long._
_Mayor Graham’s relationship with the Republican Party has soured significantly since her primary election. Feeling betrayed by Republican leaders who supported other candidates in her primary election, Graham has taken several steps that suggest a personal vendetta against the party, and conservatives in her city. Her most striking move came yesterday when she endorsed Democrat Adam Frisch in the 3rd District congressional race, turning her back on her party’s nominee Jeff Hurd. This unusual endorsement raised questions about Graham’s loyalties and led many to believe she is now openly working against the GOP. But there's more._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Boebert sounds alarm on massive Biden-Harris Admin land grab in Western Colorado](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* U.S. Rep. Lauren Boebert opposes the Biden-Harris Administration’s Bureau of Land Management (BLM) plans, which prioritize conservation across 183 million acres of public lands, including protections for the Gunnison Sage-Grouse.
* Boebert, along with allies like Bruce Westerman and Chelsie Miera, argues that the new land management plans will negatively impact Colorado’s oil and gas industry, resulting in job losses and reduced education funding.
* Critics, including Boebert, argue that the plans restrict energy production and economic growth, framing the issue as part of a broader "war on American energy." The new BLM plans also create wilderness areas, which opponents claim could increase the risk of wildfires by limiting forest management practices like thinning.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Registered Republicans have returned about 28.3% of all ballots, Democrats about 31.9%](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The first daily ballot return report from Colorado shows Democrats leading Republicans by 3.6%, with Democrats returning 31.9% of ballots and Republicans 28.3%.
* The report also shows demographic trends: more Republican men and Democratic women have returned ballots, with Republicans leading in older age groups (55-64 and 75+), while Democrats lead in all other demographics.
* Jefferson, El Paso, and Arapahoe counties top the list in ballot returns, with 80,441, 78,085, and 61,830 ballots respectively.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Colorado is not a destination, report details, with only 0.9% moving to Colorado from other states](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COMMON SENSE INSTITUTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado has seen a significant decline in domestic migration, with only 0.8% of movers choosing the state in 2023, compared to much higher rates in the 2010s.
* In 2023, Colorado gained more residents from international migration (11,931) than domestic migration (7,236), a shift from previous years where domestic migration was a key factor in population growth.
* The state's population increased by 36,571 people in 2023, but this is less than half the average annual growth seen from 2011-2020.
* Colorado gained the most new residents from California, while losing the most to Nevada, followed by Oklahoma, Wyoming, and Arkansas.
* The state ranked 16th in the nation for population growth from domestic and natural increases in 2023, a drop from being in the top ten during the 2010s.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Denver’s homeless population grew, despite tens of millions in spending to solve it](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Denver Mayor Mike Johnston celebrated moving 2,000 homeless individuals into temporary shelters since taking office, achieving his goal of relocating 1,000 people off the streets before the end of 2024.
* The city's homeless population, however, has increased from 5,818 to 6,539 over the past year, raising concerns about the overall effectiveness of the homelessness response despite high spending.
* Johnston’s administration has closed 18 of Denver’s largest encampments and secured more than 350 blocks downtown, which his office touts as a significant success.
* Some councilmembers are concerned about the cost of the initiative, with the city on track to spend $155 million between July 2023 and December 2024, $65 million more than previously anticipated.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Harris rejects religious exemptions for abortion](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [NATIONAL REVIEW](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Kamala Harris stated she would reject religious exemptions for abortion, requiring healthcare providers to perform the procedure regardless of their beliefs.
* Harris is focused on codifying Roe v. Wade and refuses to compromise with Republicans on abortion legislation.
* Religious and pro-life groups condemned her stance, arguing it infringes on religious freedom. Critics claim Harris’s position forces participation in abortions against moral beliefs, raising concerns for faith-based healthcare providers.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Could illegal immigration sway elections in swing states?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [UNLEASH PROSPERITY](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Illegal immigration has surged under the Biden administration, with numbers reportedly quadrupling in key swing states, raising concerns about potential impacts on tight elections.
* Critics argue that even a small number of non-citizens voting could sway election outcomes in battleground states.
* There is ongoing debate about the need for proof of citizenship in voter registration, with opponents claiming it could help prevent illegal voting.
* Proponents of stricter voting laws express concern that the growing number of illegal immigrants could influence crucial election results without proper voter verification.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Spakovsky: DOJ is wrong, federal law doesn’t prevent states from removing aliens from voter rolls](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY HANS VON SPAKOVSKY, [THE DAILY SIGNAL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_The Biden-Harris Justice Department is wrong in claiming that federal law bars Virginia and other states from removing aliens from their voter rolls. And if the law DOJ cites is misinterpreted by a court to agree with the agency’s erroneous claim, then the law likely would be unconstitutional._
_The Justice Department sued Virginia after it removed. The names of 6,303 aliens and Alabama after it moved 3,251 aliens to an “inactive” list._
_Keep in mind that it’s a felony under several federal statutes for an alien to claim fraudulently to be a citizen so he or she may register to vote or vote in U.S. elections, including 18 U.S.C. §§ 611, 911, and 1015(f). The Justice Department has a duty to enforce these statutes, something the agency apparently has no interest in doing under President Joe Biden and Vice President Kamala Harris._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[Walcher: A new national sacrifice zone in effort to move beyond oil& gas?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY GREG WALCHER | COMMENTARY | OCTOBER 23** _A couple years ago a little-noticed report called, “Beyond Carbon-Free: A Framework for Purpose-Led Renewable Energy Procurement and Development” was published by an energy company in Seattle, together with the Nature Conservancy and the National Audubon Society._
__
[**Rally in Fountain to feature ‘Mayor of MAGAville’, candidates for U.S, state seats**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY BRIAN PORTER | LOCAL | OCTOBER 23** _Candidates in three U.S. House races and two Colorado House races will be among those speaking during the Never Surrender/America First Rally and Concert in Fountain, Colo._
[**Gabe Evans’ ad attacks the laws Yadira Caraveo supported to ‘Defund the Police’**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | OCTOBER 23** _Inside the final two weeks before Election Day, Republican nominee Gabe Evans is launching an ad in the critical 8th District race for the U.S. House seat attacking his opponent’s “Defund the Police” stance._

name: Mark Kelly
subject: My story can only happen in the United States of America
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
#

Team, it’s Mark.
Take a look: This kid is the son of working parents. Two cops from New Jersey.
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-oct24.iolxfT&refcode=em241024-1-120&t=1&akid=5905%2E6688874%2ETLVx8o)
He grew up to become a pilot in the U.S. Navy. He flew 39 combat missions in Desert Storm.
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-oct24.iolxfT&refcode=em241024-1-120&t=2&akid=5905%2E6688874%2ETLVx8o)
He and his twin brother were selected as astronauts. He flew four missions in space and commanded the space shuttle twice.
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-oct24.iolxfT&refcode=em241024-1-120&t=3&akid=5905%2E6688874%2ETLVx8o)
In 2011, his wife, Congresswoman Gabby Giffords, was shot in Tucson.
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-oct24.iolxfT&refcode=em241024-1-120&t=4&akid=5905%2E6688874%2ETLVx8o)
He retired from the Navy and NASA, and his mission turned from service to our country to caring for his wife.
But Gabby’s example stuck with him. And in 2019, he took on a new mission. He ran for Senate, and won. In 2022, he ran for a full term. And again, he won.
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-oct24.iolxfT&refcode=em241024-1-120&t=5&akid=5905%2E6688874%2ETLVx8o)
That’s my story. My American Dream. It’s a story that can only happen in the United States of America.
This November, we find ourselves at a crossroads. Our country could fall back to Trump, which puts our democracy itself in incredible peril.
Ultimately, our democracy is what enables us to pursue the American Dream. It allows us to worship freely, to find a job without fear of discrimination, to start a business and know that you’ve got an equal shot at success as anyone else if you’re willing to work hard at it. In a democracy, the government works on behalf of the people, not in service to just one man. It protects us, it supports us when we need help, and it provides the kind of opportunities required to chase dreams.
That’s what I believe. And to me, that’s worth fighting for. I swore an oath to defend our Constitution when I joined the Navy. That is an oath I honor, even today.
We’ve got less than two weeks until the election. I’ll be working nonstop to elect Kamala Harris and Ruben Gallego in Arizona, as well as a whole slate of pro-democracy candidates up and down the ballot.
To make sure that our democracy endures for our kids and our grandkids, I’m asking for your help.
[**Please, make a donation to my campaign. I’ll do this on my own if I have to, but we can accomplish far more if we work together.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-oct24.iolxfT&refcode=em241024-1-120&t=6&akid=5905%2E6688874%2ETLVx8o)

Can we tell you a quick story, Derek? In 2022, Democrat Kris Mayes won the Arizona attorney general’s race by just _280 votes_. Months later, she vowed to not enforce a sweeping abortion ban in the state -- defending reproductive care for millions of Arizonans. Just 280 votes made that possible. **Elections matter -- not just presidential elections, but elections all the way down the ballot.** In your state, multiple races could very well be decided by a handful of votes. With such close margins, every conversation with an undecided voter could impact the outcome of elections all over Pennsylvania. **We all have a role to play in helping elect Kamala Harris, Tim Walz, and Democrats running for office at all levels. clean_body: ~ | | Peter, We are less than two weeks from Election Day, and I’m fired up. Our campaign is hard at work crisscrossing the district to hear what’s on people’s minds, and make sure everyone knows they have a trusted neighbor to call on. Below are some highlights from recent events that I wanted to share. But first and foremost, I want to thank you, friend. Your support has put us in our strongest position yet, and together I believe we can hold this seat in November and help flip the House. I hope to see you out there. -Eric | ** I took a moment to speak with reporters in our community over ensuring the town of Silvis has clean drinking water. I’m never going to stop my work until all the lead pipes are gone and every community has clean water coming from the tap. I stood alongside our local chapter of the Laborers' International Union of North America. I am proud to have a 100% pro-labor record in Congress. You can’t just say you support working men and women, you have to show it. Speaking of organized labor, I enjoyed meeting up with Local 50 in Peoria to hear about what they need to keep us safe. I’m proud to be endorsed by the International Association of Firefighters, and I’ll work with anyone to make sure all our hometown firefighters have the support they deserve. I met with retired teachers in Mount Carroll to talk about protecting Social Security and repealing unfair demands. Educators in small towns shape future leaders, and I get to have their backs in Congress. I'll stand for those who spent their lives caring for others! And I was honored to accept the Illinois Farm Bureau endorsement at the Deppert’s family farm in Tazewell County! Our farming roots run deep and I’m proud to stand up for the next generation of agriculture. I’ll keep working so IL- 17 remains THE Ag Capital of the world. My community has given me so much, and I will always put each of you first. But as the election gets closer by the minute, and with votes already being cast, I need all of us to come together to ensure we have the support so I can keep supporting IL-17. I am no fan of having to send out these emails and text messages. Sometimes I have a hard time wrapping my head around the idea that people actually give to them.
And while I wish to my core I did not have to send another email asking you to donate, that is what I have to do today. Here’s why:
A look at the recent polls show everything is definitely tightening here in Michigan. What was once a small lead for Kamala Harris has shrunk.

I know that there are so many campaigns asking and so many demands on your attention and your wallet — but if you are in a position to do so and are looking for a place your donation can have an outsized impact on this election, my race is the place.

body:
That's the scoop, according to The Hill

| | |
---
|
---
Is Mitch McConnell secretly stabbing conservative senators in the back this November? That's the scoop, according to _The Hill: "**Cruz and Scott, both McConnell critics, get cold shoulder amid tough races."**_
---
|
---
---
|
---
Recent polls in Texas and Florida show incumbent Senators **Ted Cruz** and **Rick Scott** in neck-and-neck races against leftwing Democrat challengers with control of the Senate hanging in the balance. Yet, while McConnell’s money machine is pouring cash into some Senate races, it’s conspicuously ignoring these two key states. Everyone knows why. Ted Cruz and Rick Scott are conservative patriots, not leadership lapdogs. They fight for the American people and for the Constitution, which means they often challenge the Beltway Establishment. **[**Please don't sleep on these Senate races. Support Ted Cruz and Rick Scott with a split contribution today.**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=67759f452bd2485483ac49dae0d7c7a1&_e=xllQzZV7NbUyvrN1QmCEm-fDP2Xo0EP30QGO5hp8dFXt3GDXwF8NyCHH-4Vwi6UwXfz2qSpx7wzXHTZYSNoS3DmLTFTHqDCQ6AB-2hSx5XwSQ3MjsZ_BKo2NIzswtA9220uc-V0QrUERQOXZ8rFiktSbrSjuoClQy_JeVmu5_9F4fkmEbphopYdtB0BHn9pAhcdsup2_9zNhUSwACBIxORAlr0Jkbd1_jPNJPSP61VZ5JCw_pJrkhEhl7QieS-9o)** **_"Mitch McConnell runs the largest Republican super PAC in the country," said Senator Cruz. "It has $400 million, but that super PAC is used to reward the Republican Senators who obey him and to punish those who dare to stand up to him_."** So while Democrats pump millions into Texas and Florida to turn them blue, Washington Republicans are slow-walking their support — even as these races tighten. subject: Your chance to get to know me a little better

body:
| | |
---
Friend — by now, with just 12 days until Election Day, I hope you have a good sense of who I am and the issues I believe are so important.
But I thought a little reminder would be helpful, especially contrasted with who Rick Scott is 🤢. Maybe it will even motivate you to **[make a split donation between my campaign and Jeanne Shaheen's](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95729865/507700310/-1996205471?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3016-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDQvMS84ODk1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2OWMzZmYxYi0yYTkyLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AbRUx8DtbGnM57ZdAxrzGmAYigUhPhnOhBLT9_lDJG0=)** before tonight's fundraising deadline to ensure I can defeat Rick Scott!
First and foremost, I'm everything I am today because of my mother. She brought my sisters and me to America when I was just 14. Mom knew we had to get out of Ecuador, which was transitioning to democracy after suffering under a military dictatorship. She knew America was the key to a better life.
Well, with a whole lot of hard work (including working in a doughnut shop to help my family get by), long hours, and a ton of hope, we were able to win our American dream. My story is what inspires me to give back to this incredible country and state that gave me so much.
After putting myself through college, I worked for several nonprofit organizations across Florida, helping to **protect our wildlife and preserve our coral reefs.**
Rick Scott, on the other hand, banned saying the words "climate change" when he was governor of Florida, and the League of Conservation Voters gave him a whopping 0% score last year.
During my time working at Florida International University, I spearheaded a new program to **expand affordable health care access** to more Floridians. But Rick Scott has voted to repeal the Affordable Care Act more times than I care to count. And who can forget he committed one of the largest Medicare frauds in the history of our country.
Eventually, I had the honor of serving my community in the U.S. House of Representatives, where I became the first South American immigrant to be elected to Congress! In the House, I wrote the bill to **expand seniors’ Medicare Advantage coverage** , worked with Republicans to provide **economic relief** to families and small businesses, and secured $200 million for **Everglades restoration.**
I'm proud of my record — but can Rick Scott say the same, friend? He has used his time in office writing the plan to end Social Security and Medicare, attempting to undermine our elections, attacking our rights, and making it harder for working families to get ahead.
**As a result, Rick Scott's approval ratings with Floridians are underwater. Even a large percentage of Republicans don't approve of him! Now, polling shows me statistically tied with Scott, and in just 12 days, we can defeat him and protect our Democratic Senate majority in the process.**
**[But with Rick Scott outspending me 3-1 on the airwaves, it's going to take a surge in grassroots support from people like you to truly defeat him. So please, split a donation of $5 or whatever you can to my campaign and Jeanne Shaheen's to send me to the U.S. Senate and give Floridians the true leader and public servant we deserve!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95729866/507700311/-2074190737?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3016-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDQvMS84ODk1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2OWMzZmYxYi0yYTkyLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AbRUx8DtbGnM57ZdAxrzGmAYigUhPhnOhBLT9_lDJG0=)**

clean_body: | | | Friend — by now, with just 12 days until Election Day, I hope you have a good sense of who I am and the issues I believe are so important. But I thought a little reminder would be helpful, especially contrasted with who Rick Scott is 🤢. Maybe it will even motivate you to = before tonight's fundraising deadline to ensure I can defeat Rick Scott! First and foremost, I'm everything I am today because of my mother. She brought my sisters and me to America when I was just 14. Mom knew we had to get out of Ecuador, which was transitioning to democracy after suffering under a military dictatorship. She knew America was the key to a better life. Well, with a whole lot of hard work (including working in a doughnut shop to help my family get by), long hours, and a ton of hope, we were able to win our American dream. My story is what inspires me to give back to this incredible country and state that gave me so much. After putting myself through college, I worked for several nonprofit organizations across Florida, helping to protect our wildlife and preserve our coral reefs. Rick Scott, on the other hand, banned saying the words "climate change" when he was governor of Florida, and the League of Conservation Voters gave him a whopping 0% score last year. During my time working at Florida International University, I spearheaded a new program to expand affordable health care access to more Floridians. But Rick Scott has voted to repeal the Affordable Care Act more times than I care to count. And who can forget he committed one of the largest Medicare frauds in the history of our country. Eventually, I had the honor of serving my community in the U.S. House of Representatives, where I became the first South American immigrant to be elected to Congress! In the House, I wrote the bill to expand seniors’ Medicare Advantage coverage , worked with Republicans to provide economic relief to families and small businesses, and secured $200 million for Everglades restoration. I'm proud of my record — but can Rick Scott say the same, friend? He has used his time in office writing the plan to end Social Security and Medicare, attempting to undermine our elections, attacking our rights, and making it harder for working families to get ahead. Peter,
You may have recently seen photos of Donald Trump “working” at a McDonald’s in Pennsylvania. The stunt came after Trump repeatedly (and without evidence) claimed that Vice President Harris had lied about her experience working at McDonald’s during college.
While all political photo ops are staged, this one was taken to an entirely new level. The Pennsylvania McDonald’s was closed for the day, meaning the “customers” and employees seen in the photos and video clips were nothing more than actors in an elaborate performance staged by the Trump campaign.
**Here’s the photo to prove it:**
[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95730079/507700669/-593472309?refcode=20241024-EM-TrumpMcDonalds&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiY2U4NjBmOGQtMmE5Mi1lZjExLTg0NzQtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=8mWCFl_QJYNYIE0qv18p81Zf3qzFWmSfSkSncBP-vsE=)
