**[We’ll talk about how this kind of fawning coverage helps Trump in a second, but if you support COURIER’s unbiased reporting of the 2024 election, can you chip in $25 now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95730081/507700671/-593472309?refcode=20241024-EM-TrumpMcDonalds&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiY2U4NjBmOGQtMmE5Mi1lZjExLTg0NzQtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=8mWCFl_QJYNYIE0qv18p81Zf3qzFWmSfSkSncBP-vsE=)**
During the stunt, Trump declared, “now I’ve worked for 15 minutes more than Kamala,” calling her “lyin’ Kamala.” He ignored reporter questions about raising the minimum wage and once again dodged fully committing to accepting the election results if he loses.
The real story behind Trump’s McDonald’s photo op should have been a slam dunk for the legacy media. This isn’t about campaign tactics or Trump’s supposed love for fast food. It’s about calling out Trump’s latest attempt to spread baseless lies about a political opponent.
**It was childish, obvious propaganda. Yet, some legacy media outlets terrifyingly ignored that, choosing instead to cover the stunt as if it were a wholesome moment of Americana.**
_The Washington Post_ wrote:
**_“Trump has long been a fan of McDonald’s, and once filmed an ad for the fast-food chain. During a 2016 CNN town hall, Trump told Anderson Cooper that his McDonald’s meal of choice was the fish delight...”_**
On _CNN This Morning_ , host Kasie Hunt and guest Kristen Soltis Anderson gushed over the staged political theatrics. Soltis Anderson said:
**_“Like he has always sort of portrayed himself as I’m the rich guy who doesn’t really like the other rich guys. I’m one of you, and this is part of this. I think this was insanely smart!”_**
And America’s newspaper of record, _The New York Times_ , opened its coverage of the photo-op with this charming line about Trump, a man who has repeatedly threatened to use the military on his political opponents:
**_“Donald J. Trump walked into one of his favorite restaurants on Sunday and declared he was “looking for a job.”_**

| | The opioid epidemic is devastating Northwest Washington. That is why I have dedicated time and resources to tackling this crisis in our communities. **First, I released a report that analyzes the ongoing opioid epidemic.** Here are some of the topline findings:
* From February 2022 - February 2023, Washington state had the largest percentage increase of drug overdose deaths in the United States.
* In the five counties in our district – Island, San Juan, Skagit, Snohomish, and Whatcom – most overdose deaths can be attributed to synthetic opioids like fentanyl.

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

clean_body: You have an opportunity to make history by flipping New Mexico red. | Peter, I have had the privilege of working behind the scenes in some of the most pivotal political campaigns in recent history. Today, I am reaching out to you on behalf of Nella Domenici , who is running for the United States Senate to represent New Mexico. Nella is a leader with a vision for a better America. As a former business executive and the daughter of a long-term former U.S. Senator, Pete Domenici, she brings unparalleled experience and a deep commitment to serving the people of New Mexico. A few months ago, I wrote in the Wall Street Journal that New Mexico could be a “sleeper” race for Republicans, thanks to Joe Biden’s and Martin Heinrich’s restrictive approach to energy, inflation-increasing economic policies, and dangerous move to keep the border wide open. And that’s exactly what we’re seeing - New Mexico is in play. Now, let’s talk strategy. According to the latest polling, Nella and her far-left opponent are neck and neck. Importantly, many voters remain undecided. This means this race is up for grabs, and every single vote– every single dollar –counts. That’s also why Nella and Pat recently personally matched up to $1 MILLION toward their campaign. You have an opportunity to make history by flipping New Mexico red. We need your help to ensure Nella’s campaign has the resources to close the gap, defeat Martin Heinrich, and give Republicans a strong majority in the Senate. With this race as close as it is, every single contribution makes a significant difference. Your support is not only appreciated, it’s essential. Sincerely, Karl Rove | ABOUT NELLA New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years. Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant. Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans. body:
Trump’s back in Arizona today.
And if I had to guess, he’ll be back again after that.
Trump’s been talking a lot about our fellow Americans as the “enemy from within” lately and about using the Military to crack down on them when he’s president. He’s said they’re “radical left lunatics.”
Well, he called me a “lunatic” the other day, and he called me a “maniac” before that, so I guess when he’s talking about the “enemy from within,” he means me. He’s attacked me every time he’s come to Arizona over the past few months, and I’m sure he will again today.
Donnie, I’m shaking in my boots.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-gallego [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-gallego]
I don’t scare easily, but there’s one thing about all this that I’ve noticed. Trump knows he’s got to attack me and tear me down to have any shot at winning. I’m pulling voters away from him right and left, and that makes his path to victory all the more difficult.
He’s going to keep coming back here and keep trying to turn voters he is depending on against me because he’s got to defeat me to get back into the White House.
But if we defeat Trump here, that’s it. He’s done. So, look. I need your help to put Trump on his heels. We’ve got to beat this guy.
Make a split donation to my campaign and Tim Kaine to help me win in Arizona. If I pull enough folks away from Trump we not only defeat Kari Lake, but we can stop Trump, too. Win-win. Please. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-gallego]

# [Kamala is right -- Trump is a fascist](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8e6b2e87-a054-42d9-ae99-9eaedc79ebab/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

---
| | | At a CNN town hall, Kamala Harris was asked whether she thinks Donald Trump is a fascist, and without hesitation, she [responded](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc74a336a-8d61-4718-a913-aa3dda4fc00d/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), "Yes, I do." And then she clearly explained why. And just like that, Republicans started freaking out, including Trump himself. **Tough. Because Kamala is right -- Trump is a fascist. [Add your name if you agree. ](https://default.salsalabs.org/T9c337eaf-928c-45fb-a3e2-780a19db433d/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** Republicans can't handle the truth. Not from Kamala, and not from multiple other officials -- including Trump's own former chief of staff. Trump is a fascist. He has said he would rule as a dictator. He has dined with and endorsed self-professed Nazis. He has has consistently defended white supremacists and fascist extremists, even calling them "very fine people." He's more than earned the monicker, and we think VP Harris is 100% right on using it. [**Add your name if you agree. Kamala is right -- Trump is a fascist. **](https://default.salsalabs.org/T83080eca-3516-4ffc-a7ad-91571d079d6c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

name: Laura Friedman
subject: My promise to constituents
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Laura Friedman for Congress
body:
| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95733181/507709252/158001685?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM1MzYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMzc0NDc1ZGQtMmU5Mi1lZjExLTg0NzQtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=CPywQ_Abgpu3uAZntNSdBNBxkG5M4BCTBdO-CL5rUTo=) Hi friend, When I was elected to the Assembly, I promised to work every day to change our district for the better. Even while running for Congress, I made sure to keep that promise to my constituents. This past year, I passed several laws that help create affordable housing, protect California’s wildlife, support families facing medical debt, and much more. Here are a few I’m especially proud of:
* **The Room to Roam Act (AB 1889)** helps protect wildlife by requiring local governments to plan with nature in mind. California is one of the richest biodiversity hotspots in the world and the most populous state in the nation. Animals need space to move freely between habitats, and this bill requires local governments to consider and minimize impacts to wildlife movement and habitat connectivity in their land use planning.

* **Making Homeownership Easier for Low-Income Families (AB 1868)** makes sure that affordable homes bought by low-income families are taxed fairly. There has been confusion about how to assess property taxes on affordable housing that is offered for sale to low and moderate income individuals. We partnered with Habitat for Humanity on AB 1868 to establish clear and consistent statewide rules, ensuring first-time, low-income homebuyers don’t pay more than they should.

* **Protecting Families from Medical Debt (AB2297)** corrects a loophole in state law that allows debt collectors to place liens on patients’ homes to collect unpaid medical bills. AB 2297 stops this from happening and makes sure low- and moderate-income families are protected from losing their homes over medical debt. The bill also improves patient access to financial assistance.

I’m proud to have passed these bills and more this year. I’ll keep fighting to improve the lives of families, protect our environment, and ensure fairness for all. clean_body: | = Hi friend, When I was elected to the Assembly, I promised to work every day to change our district for the better. Even while running for Congress, I made sure to keep that promise to my constituents. This past year, I passed several laws that help create affordable housing, protect California’s wildlife, support families facing medical debt, and much more. Here are a few I’m especially proud of: The Room to Roam Act (AB 1889) helps protect wildlife by requiring local governments to plan with nature in mind. California is one of the richest biodiversity hotspots in the world and the most populous state in the nation. Animals need space to move freely between habitats, and this bill requires local governments to consider and minimize impacts to wildlife movement and habitat connectivity in their land use planning. Making Homeownership Easier for Low-Income Families (AB 1868) makes sure that affordable homes bought by low-income families are taxed fairly. There has been confusion about how to assess property taxes on affordable housing that is offered for sale to low and moderate income individuals. We partnered with Habitat for Humanity on AB 1868 to establish clear and consistent statewide rules, ensuring first-time, low-income homebuyers don’t pay more than they should. Protecting Families from Medical Debt (AB2297) corrects a loophole in state law that allows debt collectors to place liens on patients’ homes to collect unpaid medical bills. AB 2297 stops this from happening and makes sure low- and moderate-income families are protected from losing their homes over medical debt. The bill also improves patient access to financial assistance. I’m proud to have passed these bills and more this year. I’ll keep fighting to improve the lives of families, protect our environment, and ensure fairness for all. | **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Chuck Schumer and the Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee are now jumping into this race to rescue endangered career politician Martin Heinrich. They’re funneling out-of-state dollars into New Mexico to buy up precious advertising time during the final weeks and days before Election Day. They know they were completely caught off guard when I entered this race and have been watching nervously as we’ve gradually caught up to Heinrich in the polls. Now, they can’t stand to sit by any longer and are frantically trying to stop our upward momentum. With New Mexico being one of the smallest states and cheapest media markets in the 2024 fight for the Senate, the money they’ve raised from West and East Coast liberal elites stretches much further here, which means they can do A LOT more damage with much less. Let’s keep up the fight! Nella Domenici Republican for Senate | ABOUT NELLA New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years. Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant. Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans. Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. When Lauren Boebert suddenly announced that she was packing up her bags and leaving Western Colorado, we were all shocked. But maybe we shouldn’t have been.
My husband Adam Frisch ran against Boebert in 2022 and came just 546 votes short of defeating her. Our family, campaign team, and all of our volunteers had worked hard – very hard. Adam drove over 24,000 miles with our son Felix meeting with voters across the entire district. But ultimately, we were out-spent and came up short.
This past year, we decided to give it another go, and we’ve been working even harder than the last campaign. With support from grassroots donors like you, we were out-raising Boebert – and Adam had already driven _another_ 24,000 miles to listen to voters. It looked like we were heading for a win... so Lauren Boebert ran off scared.
**But with Boebert now out of the race, things are a lot harder.** We’ve got a new Republican opponent who is trying to hide his extremism, and the Republican Super PACs are already circling to try to stop us from winning.

Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=102424_2&amount=25]
CBS: Georgia judge invalidates controversial new state election rules, calling them "illegal, unconstitutional and void" [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=102424_2&amount=25]
Great news out of Georgia, Team: After the MAGA-run Georgia State Election Board passed a bunch of last-minute rules -- like requiring ballots to be hand-counted -- over the objections of Georgia elected officials, even including Republican state AG Chris Car and Republican Georgia Secretary of State Brad Raffensperger, a Georgia judge has declared that seven new election rules recently passed by the Board are " illegal, unconstitutional and void ."
This ruling is huge, and goes a long way to restoring faith in our elections, not just in Georgia, but across the country. This ruling sends a message to opponents of voting rights everywhere that we won't let them change the rules and tilt the playing field in their direction. We won't let them use their partisan conspiracy theories to silence our voices. It shows them that we're going to fight to make every last vote count.
Now what do we do? if you live in Georgia, we still urge you to vote early or by mail ahead of Election Day to make sure your ballot gets counted or you have time to "cure" (fix) your mail-in ballot if you missed a required field, like a date or a hidden signature field. If you don't live in Georgia but have friends or family who do, encourage them to vote early however they can. And everyone everywhere can support our work in Georgia and beyond to protect our elections and our right to vote.
Voters deserve better than these transparent attempts to harm our elections and predetermine the outcome, Team. Help us restore faith in our elections and defend voting rights by kicking in $25 or whatever you can right now to fight back against election deniers everywhere >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=102424_2&amount=25]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

And while we have you reading --
Listen, there are just a handful of days left before this election. The polls are super close. So close, honestly, that we can ignore them at this point, because the message for WEEKS has been clear: This election is going to be determined by who actually shows up.
We need as many pro-democracy, pro-voting, pro-participation voters to turn out as possible. The only answer to the years and years of voting suppression and restrictive policy is to flood the polls with enough voters to change things and stand up with one voice to declare that we won't let these partisan activists pick and choose who gets to vote and who doesn't.
Help us spread the word in Georgia and inform voters of their voting rights nationwide with $25 or however much you can today before it's too late >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=102424_2&amount=25]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.

It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

Hey guys. This is Taylor, Bob Casey’s Finance Director.
I’m really worried about what I’m seeing right now. The Cook Political Report just rated our race a toss up, and a brand new poll shows our Republican opponent, David McCormick, in the lead for the FIRST time. Our fundamental freedoms are at stake in this race, and now Republicans are only a coin toss away from winning.
The reason this happened is because national Republicans have spent over $150 million to flip this seat. That’s so much money! It’s more than they’ve spent in Michigan, Wisconsin, and Arizona _combined._
As the Senator’s Finance Director, I’m doing everything possible to give us the resources to win, and a huge part of that is reaching out to folks like you, Peter.
[**That’s why I’m asking you to donate $5 or more to our campaign. Our opponent may have out-of-state billionaires pouring millions into this race, but I know that we can win if enough people like you step up and give $5 today.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241024-4?refcode=em20241024-4&recurring=1&refcode2=4656_552475_gaCAQQ&akid=4656%2E552475%2EgaCAQQ)

Peter, if you’ve been waiting for the perfect time to make your first donation to my campaign, I’m here to tell you:
This is it. Right now, this moment, today.
In a few hours, Trump’s going to take the stage in Tempe.
When he’s up there he is almost certain to attack me and rally his supporters behind Kari Lake. There’s a reason he’s doing that.
It might be hard to believe, but I’m pulling a good number of Republican voters to our side right now. If we do our job, we can turn those folks against Trump. And if that happens, we can beat Trump here. And if we beat him here, we beat him for good.
That’s what the pollsters are telling us. Nate Silver’s saying it. Trump himself said it when he was here before: “If we win in Arizona, we win the presidency.”
Voting is underway. We’re running out of time to reach these folks before they turn in their ballots.
So this is it. All hands on deck for a final push.
I’ll do my part, but I need you to do what you can, too.
[**Please, make your first donation of $5 and help me put together a massive day of fundraising before Trump takes the stage. Fellow Conservative,

Dear Friends,After our recent debate, it's clear that the choice in this election couldn’t be more stark. While my opponent [left many of us confused](https://engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=671a9315740ac30591f48646&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fwatch%3Fab_channel%3DGloriaWittforCongress%26v%3DYVNschFPgAI&w=65b51d9b10fa0e6aff8d6145&c=b_671a8886ea63894dc2650700&l=en-US&s=kPlFyawunA0X5jhujE24No2j2DY%3D) with his statements, I want to focus on real solutions for Virginia’s 5th District. It’s critical that candidates clearly share their values and vision so voters can make informed decisions.I’m running to lift people up with policies that prioritize affordable healthcare, quality education, and protecting our freedoms. **As you can see from** [**this supercut**](https://engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=671a9315740ac30591f48646&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fwatch%3Fab_channel%3DGloriaWittforCongress%26v%3DYVNschFPgAI&w=65b51d9b10fa0e6aff8d6145&c=b_671a8886ea63894dc2650700&l=en-US&s=kPlFyawunA0X5jhujE24No2j2DY%3D)**,** **my opponent seems more interested in conspiracy theories and confusion.** You can watch the [**full debate here**](https://engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=671a9315740ac30591f48646&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fwatch%3Fab_channel%3DWSETABC13%26t%3D650s%26v%3DraBczeZ4t9Q&w=65b51d9b10fa0e6aff8d6145&c=b_671a8886ea63894dc2650700&l=en-US&s=D5byE0h4N8EoAhOR5LBgLWzRgSo%3D) and see for yourself. I’m confident that when you compare our positions, the choice will be clear.**We just outraised our opponent, again** by more than $28,000 thanks to your [continued support](https://engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=671a9315740ac30591f48646&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fwitt4congress%3Frefcode%3Dab_qr_code%26utm_source%3Dqr_code&w=65b51d9b10fa0e6aff8d6145&c=b_671a8886ea63894dc2650700&l=en-US&s=02azZSr-TD0UmqfRfcwjgVjGU9U%3D)! Thanks to you, we are headed into the election in a winning position!
---
With determination,Gloria Witt
Democratic Nominee

I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’” | [](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=d7c9bf9386bd46c4be3635166d921d43&_e=cBWcinVU4o0xHJDmNHTZMAxt3v2o0BFu1VKKnQjIFBRPthv78gA5EclIuhGRmPRzCGkI8iqV4PTW4uLsOco6bBuQk3OzaFILrnjdT5TCFIT9NlpQiUJMH6_RPRpVy9dQipLCYOZvxo9HV-rBn5QomYik1UfAXOb9TjdeEyeF-cxJRfDHyEX9bbAXBTt2g727MmezcnZNjD_66bg3ie2oqnWnHbGMXZTxEHGwPoy7oIMM7sVI0TA74CP_H4lFuMOPgLcKmFfuFdz7mn8IaxnxEfd4-QsLVAnJfO2a6HyrZk45IYWKralht8XYp91jfpupa0d7jEnckHL02frKW4I-FrvA2lT8BMkssAuDe8B5uzZKN42oGCVrDY65zxecS_2eUXDSjC50bKtP1E7u0EohI7J5W7cgtWvluJh0cJqEgcw%3D)

Peter,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, **those are the traits that define me**. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to **[launch a campaign for the United States Senate last June.](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=d7c9bf9386bd46c4be3635166d921d43&_e=cBWcinVU4o0xHJDmNHTZMAxt3v2o0BFu1VKKnQjIFBRPthv78gA5EclIuhGRmPRzCGkI8iqV4PTW4uLsOco6bBuQk3OzaFILrnjdT5TCFIT9NlpQiUJMH6_RPRpVy9dQipLCYOZvxo9HV-rBn5QomYik1UfAXOb9TjdeEyeF-cxJRfDHyEX9bbAXBTt2g727MmezcnZNjD_66bg3ie2oqnWnHbGMXZTxEHGwPoy7oIMM7sVI0TA74CP_H4lFuMOPgLcKmFfuFdz7mn8IaxnxEUZx6ZsLl1gzcXFxAxkkvuYK2LQxQPoZr27JdAW3orYZg_z8Mh8fzH0GSli4QWZcEBY1XLeHP3vJyZj2Cklrv10tYVf6Yw5zXCFku4QGzuRSqrYWDqiCinoc1nD__QcbwUaBrF32RgVf0jdHiC1CITw%3D)**

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [_**many veterans like me**_] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

[](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=d7c9bf9386bd46c4be3635166d921d43&_e=cBWcinVU4o0xHJDmNHTZMAxt3v2o0BFu1VKKnQjIFBRPthv78gA5EclIuhGRmPRzCGkI8iqV4PTW4uLsOco6bBuQk3OzaFILrnjdT5TCFIT9NlpQiUJMH6_RPRpVy9dQipLCYOZvxo9HV-rBn5QomYik1UfAXOb9TjdeEyeF-cxJRfDHyEX9bbAXBTt2g727MmezcnZNjD_66bg3ie2oqnWnHbGMXZTxEHGwPoy7oIMM7sVI0TA74CP_H4lFuMOPgLcKmFfuFdz7mn8IaxnxET1DZ_XmsKEWmo1J_hWjSXzRgb9GwQLfWA8k8GevDwwiX3Q8d3mFljXhLtt2-8Yqpr5sTzKMvkL0zeLIxwcrY-vA7YiuSvKqZKaPVsE1J3vaHRlSQKDnw3N4Pp8KZhZr21X8kLVXKEwllfVLCmTmmSY%3D)
This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, _**“I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’”**_

Every day it got worse.
Every day it was a disaster.
The adult in the room never materialized.

**Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport.** Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden and Kamala Harris could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.”

I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. _**So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt**_ because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil.

**If you're thinking this email is on the longer side, you're right.** If you're short on time and unable to finish reading to the end right now, **[please do me a quick favor and confirm that I have the correct information on file for you](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=d7c9bf9386bd46c4be3635166d921d43&_e=cBWcinVU4o0xHJDmNHTZMAxt3v2o0BFu1VKKnQjIFBRPthv78gA5EclIuhGRmPRzCGkI8iqV4PTW4uLsOco6bBuQk3OzaFILrnjdT5TCFIT9NlpQiUJMH6_RPRpVy9dQipLCYOZvxo9HV-rBn5QomYik1UfAXOb9TjdeEyeF-cxJRfDHyEX9bbAXBTt2g727MmezcnZNjD_66bg3ie2oqnWnHbGMXZTxEHGwPoy7oIMM7sVI0TA74CP_H4lFuMOPgLcKmFfuFdz7mn8IaxnxEX0bu6TV_07CtqLLmbR8J-kMD60gKm2E_v-a5i1mNFRoK2JNpEZORwkajx4lZvQgX_4U-g6jWmH6FzV38edgB4nxnsqz_1v_wwADPw7gqJqOG-JngD5EHTKpMB3Y3-LSrJ7FpGglczGCVmo3kkmpDKY%3D)** ; my opponent and his allies will not make winning this seat easy.

[**JOIN OUR FIGHT
ENLIST WITH TIM TODAY->** ](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=d7c9bf9386bd46c4be3635166d921d43&_e=cBWcinVU4o0xHJDmNHTZMAxt3v2o0BFu1VKKnQjIFBRPthv78gA5EclIuhGRmPRzCGkI8iqV4PTW4uLsOco6bBuQk3OzaFILrnjdT5TCFIT9NlpQiUJMH6_RPRpVy9dQipLCYOZvxo9HV-rBn5QomYik1UfAXOb9TjdeEyeF-cxJRfDHyEX9bbAXBTt2g727MmezcnZNjD_66bg3ie2oqnWnHbGMXZTxEHGwPoy7oIMM7sVI0TA74CP_H4lFuMOPgLcKmFfuFdz7mn8IaxnxETiUJi5UZJuvOqDPK0FPtdJM_-FaE0bECGj25Zcx3Gd-M9hkRtVchwOj-sT7nELTY7fBuL83_vSVFj_013r2SxWrX_dDerp6w32QA2_CpRdm6QDK4_5rtlR5vI-6gWcZRQ6pwkjSrwUX9aFw-TP1Ees%3D)

It was in the aftermath of the fall of Afghanistan that I ever truly considered entering politics. Deciding to launch a campaign for the United States Senate wasn’t an easy decision; **but the United States needs leaders who understand the sacrifice it’s taken to build our country. When your country calls and needs you, you have to answer. **

[](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=d7c9bf9386bd46c4be3635166d921d43&_e=cBWcinVU4o0xHJDmNHTZMAxt3v2o0BFu1VKKnQjIFBRPthv78gA5EclIuhGRmPRzCGkI8iqV4PTW4uLsOco6bBuQk3OzaFILrnjdT5TCFIT9NlpQiUJMH6_RPRpVy9dQipLCYOZvxo9HV-rBn5QomYik1UfAXOb9TjdeEyeF-cxJRfDHyEX9bbAXBTt2g727MmezcnZNjD_66bg3ie2oqnWnHbGMXZTxEHGwPoy7oIMM7sVI0TA74CP_H4lFuMOPgLcKmFfuFdz7mn8IaxnxEbvRTGgYBwIL4CHkPFJrLCMt3vTYZ-EKoTGVs9-ffd6dK9mWZiITngu_-_8H0hVgp1mncsLqi9xt1n8WlCUKzDDNkSjLrFNKnr81eB9hdzVRt-CTWUoj2PcHbfTdm658Kaaut09z3__CCkShiqehskQ%3D)
**Unlike Joe Biden and Kamala Harris, I understand what it is to serve our country. Not service in politics, but on the battlefield.** I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free.

[**ENLIST WITH TIM
CONFIRM YOUR SUPPORT TODAY->** ](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=d7c9bf9386bd46c4be3635166d921d43&_e=cBWcinVU4o0xHJDmNHTZMAxt3v2o0BFu1VKKnQjIFBRPthv78gA5EclIuhGRmPRzCGkI8iqV4PTW4uLsOco6bBuQk3OzaFILrnjdT5TCFIT9NlpQiUJMH6_RPRpVy9dQipLCYOZvxo9HV-rBn5QomYik1UfAXOb9TjdeEyeF-cxJRfDHyEX9bbAXBTt2g727MmezcnZNjD_66bg3ie2oqnWnHbGMXZTxEHGwPoy7oIMM7sVI0TA74CP_H4lFuMOPgLcKmFfuFdz7mn8IaxnxEb-t6ElhxEBJ6QI1ECC3HUkqhqQMaUJkXohbHyGh-AOqJcczdJTxfZLTsQsQSs19foAjrR7rx9vBbLuoaozC0VsWR5ZwZq-JGthHEuQKdTzdehOVFeia_cF3sBUeEs5XoXzXZ0cmerK4RtpfqPduEHI%3D)

I’m reaching out to you today because if this campaign to flip Montana’s U.S. Senate seat is going to be successful, **[I’m going to need the help of every conservative donor who reads this letter.](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=d7c9bf9386bd46c4be3635166d921d43&_e=cBWcinVU4o0xHJDmNHTZMAxt3v2o0BFu1VKKnQjIFBRPthv78gA5EclIuhGRmPRzCGkI8iqV4PTW4uLsOco6bBuQk3OzaFILrnjdT5TCFIT9NlpQiUJMH6_RPRpVy9dQipLCYOZvxo9HV-rBn5QomYik1UfAXOb9TjdeEyeF-cxJRfDHyEX9bbAXBTt2g727MmezcnZNjD_66bg3ie2oqnWnHbGMXZTxEHGwPoy7oIMM7sVI0TA74CP_H4lFuMOPgLcKmFfuFdz7mn8IaxnxEbA0LfaYT933HDhh4BJkK9dAF-03fH4SjWGxJaOKMohbA_wtDP6kehr7L2RmHNIWsAZD6tnCIKNvePm0rCiFUdHWR-9MCu-RSgfH9N6n20341EL89188lMMZuIYDrLE7lrrCLYSpQSWyXq3SaCu4mjU%3D) **

Twice in a row, Joe Biden has pulled us out of two wars for political purposes.

We fought in Iraq, _**I was there.**_ We fought in Afghanistan, _**I was there.**_

And each time, for political purposes, Biden pulled out our forces and damaged our nation’s reputation in the process. And my opponent in the Senate race, Democrat Jon Tester, supported Biden both times.

I want to look at my children and tell them, _**“Yes, you should serve your country, as your mom and dad did. Your parents put on the uniform; you should do the same.”**_

[](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=d7c9bf9386bd46c4be3635166d921d43&_e=cBWcinVU4o0xHJDmNHTZMAxt3v2o0BFu1VKKnQjIFBRPthv78gA5EclIuhGRmPRzCGkI8iqV4PTW4uLsOco6bBuQk3OzaFILrnjdT5TCFIT9NlpQiUJMH6_RPRpVy9dQipLCYOZvxo9HV-rBn5QomYik1UfAXOb9TjdeEyeF-cxJRfDHyEX9bbAXBTt2g727MmezcnZNjD_66bg3ie2oqnWnHbGMXZTxEHGwPoy7oIMM7sVI0TA74CP_H4lFuMOPgLcKmFfuFdz7mn8IaxnxEZ6ZxzbzNl692xScS8dmAzOxg1MoudjeQFVSauJG9vIBGuNsCnoy3KsfGn2L3X_97AkwWAhxF-9DAKXH_h4nl_5rF8p53ZtEUkOgmGcLO5l61v_HECLG5TXj-72HuOYGLWuqbybaPHrORuR5U8ChhrU%3D)
**But when we have a president who is willing to pull the plug on a whim for political purposes, it’s hard to tell future generations the sacrifices in service of God and country will be worth it.**

clean_body: I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’” | Peter, As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams. Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, those are the traits that define me. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [many veterans like me] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead. This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, “I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’” Every day it got worse. Every day it was a disaster. The adult in the room never materialized. Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport. Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden and Kamala Harris could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.” I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil. If you're thinking this email is on the longer side, you're right. If you're short on time and unable to finish reading to the end right now, ; my opponent and his allies will not make winning this seat easy. It was in the aftermath of the fall of Afghanistan that I ever truly considered entering politics. Deciding to launch a campaign for the United States Senate wasn’t an easy decision; but the United States needs leaders who understand the sacrifice it’s taken to build our country. When your country calls and needs you, you have to answer. Unlike Joe Biden and Kamala Harris, I understand what it is to serve our country. Not service in politics, but on the battlefield. I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free. I’m reaching out to you today because if this campaign to flip Montana’s U.S. Senate seat is going to be successful, Twice in a row, Joe Biden has pulled us out of two wars for political purposes. We fought in Iraq, I was there. We fought in Afghanistan, I was there. And each time, for political purposes, Biden pulled out our forces and damaged our nation’s reputation in the process. And my opponent in the Senate race, Democrat Jon Tester, supported Biden both times. I want to look at my children and tell them, “Yes, you should serve your country, as your mom and dad did. Your parents put on the uniform; you should do the same.” But when we have a president who is willing to pull the plug on a whim for political purposes, it’s hard to tell future generations the sacrifices in service of God and country will be worth it. So, Peter \- that’s what I’m fighting for. I’m fighting to restore faith in our American way of life. I entered the political arena to ensure the sacrifices my friends made weren’t made in vain. name: Ted Cruz
subject: We Might Lose Texas
body:
| | | | [](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9iHj/?__vbtrk=MjU1Mjg1OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU1Mjg1OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
---
Friend --

Senator Ted Cruz here.
Desperate times call for desperate measures, and I'm afraid **we're in some desperate times.**
[](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9iHj/?__vbtrk=MjU1Mjg1OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU1Mjg1OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
_Texas is in danger of flipping blue for the first time in generations!_

We are in danger of losing the great state of Texas...

_**If that happens, even if President Trump wins the election, he won't be able to push his agenda through Congress...**_
_****_
_**And if we lose Texas as a Republican stronghold, regardless of who wins in 2024, we might never had another Republican President again...**_

| | [KEEP TEXAS RED](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9iHj/?__vbtrk=MjU1Mjg1OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU1Mjg1OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
---
Today, I am reaching out to you, about an _**extremely important issue...**_****

Not on my own behalf, but on behalf of a good friend of mine,**Brandon Gill** , who is running for Congress to represent __**YOU**__ _****_****in D.C., and help**me** in stopping the Left from taking control of the Lone Star State.

Brandon Gill is a proud husband, a proud father, a long-time **supporter** and **fighter** for President Trump, and a _**warrior**_****for our Conservative causes!

[](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9iHj/?__vbtrk=MjU1Mjg1OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU1Mjg1OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
_My friend, Brandon Gill, and his wife._
Brandon Gill has **my personal endorsement**... He has **President Trump's personal endorsement**...
_**[And now, I'm asking for YOU to join me and join President Trump in supporting Brandon Gill's fight to KEEP TEXAS RED, and HELP SAVE AMERICA](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9iHj/?__vbtrk=MjU1Mjg1OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU1Mjg1OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)**_**[!!](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9iHk/?__vbtrk=MjU1Mjg1OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU1Mjg1OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)**

I've been in Congress for a while now-- I know what it means to fight against the left, to face their relentless attacks, **and _I know what it takes to win..._**
I can tell you, _without a shadow of a doubt_ , _**Brandon Gill is a killer who will take the fight to them, and _never back down_.**_
Listen-- Politicians come and go, and believe me, I know how it feels to be disappointed by people who campaign on _one thing_ , and then once they get to D.C., _they do another_...
_**But there is not a doubt in my mind about Brandon Gill...**_
_**HE WILL NOT LET YOU DOWN!**_
[JOIN TED CRUZ & PRESIDENT TRUMP IN SUPPORTING BRANDON GILL](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9iHj/?__vbtrk=MjU1Mjg1OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU1Mjg1OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
Believe me, _**keeping Texas red might be one of the most consequential fights the Republican Party will face for decades to come.**_
_**We can't afford to let a Democrat take TX-26:
WE NEED BRANDON GILL!**_

There is so much to do...
**We must secure our Southern Border!**
Brandon Gill and I have talked about how we've seen Texas transform as its become infested with illegals, and _**he is ready to fight for deportation!**_
**We must defend the 1st Amendment!**
Brandon Gill is ready to join me in Congress and take the fight to the _bureaucrats_ , and _tyrants_ who think they can _**curtail your God-given rights!**_
**We must protect women's bathrooms, locker rooms, and sports!**
Brandon Gill is a proud husband and father to a beautiful daughter, and I know _**he won't put up with men invading women's spaces!**_
**We must secure our elections, and DEMAND Voter ID nationwide!**
Brandon Gill knows how important this issue is, and I know _**he will never back down on keeping illegals OFF our voter rolls, and OUT of our voting booths.**_
**We need the largest deportation force in the history of the world!**
I know Brandon Gill is especially passionate about this issue... _**And I can't wait to see him fight alongside me and President Trump _to get it done_.**_
[JOIN TED CRUZ & PRESIDENT TRUMP IN SUPPORTING BRANDON GILL](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9iHj/?__vbtrk=MjU1Mjg1OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU1Mjg1OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
If these are **ideas you can get behind...**
If you think Congress needs a family man, a member of the younger generation, who will _**bring the fight to Capitol Hill...**_
If you know _(like I do)_ that _**keeping Texas red**_ is one of the most important fights of this election...
**_[Then join the fight, and help me get Brandon Gill to Congress to help me fight, to support President Trump,a nd to stop the violent and radical left!](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9iHj/?__vbtrk=MjU1Mjg1OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU1Mjg1OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_**
When President Trump and I come together to endorse a candidate, I know you know-- _**That's a candidate that's going to go far!**_
If we don't get Brandon Gill across the finishing line, _**Texas will be in a _very, very bad position and 2024 and beyond..._**_
_**_[It's all hands on deck... We need YOU NOW! ARE YOU WITH ME?](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9iHj/?__vbtrk=MjU1Mjg1OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU1Mjg1OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_**_

[JOIN TED CRUZ & PRESIDENT TRUMP IN SUPPORTING BRANDON GILL](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9iHj/?__vbtrk=MjU1Mjg1OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU1Mjg1OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
I wouldn't be asking if it wasn't serious... But when President Trump and I both rally behind a candidate, you can bet _**that's a candidate that deserves your support!**_
_****_
_****_**__**_Yours Sincerely,_
[](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9iHj/?__vbtrk=MjU1Mjg1OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU1Mjg1OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
_Ted Cruz_

subject: Feeling whiplash? Us too.

body:
There is no silver bullet for winning this election. There’s no single poll or Twitter post that will tell us anything particularly new over these next 12 days. | | | Peter, With just 12 days until Election Day, the news cycle is in overdrive. Every time you watch or read the news, chances are you hear about another BRAND NEW or BREAKING poll. Every time you check social media, you probably see another armchair pundit confidently predicting who will win. And every time you open your email or texts, you likely come across a flood of messages from campaigns and groups trying to scare or guilt you. name: No Dem Left Behind
subject: Across the Country: October 24th, 2024
body:
Parents in Texas are worried about public education.
| | | | | |
---
**_Across the Country_**
---
|
---
Hello, folks! Welcome back to Across the Country, our weekly series dedicated to amplifying the voices of our communities as we approach the pivotal 2024 election. These are the stories that actually matter to our communities. Let’s stay informed, together! –Daniela Rodriguez
---
| | | | **Texas**
---
|
---
In 2024, Texas ranked dead last in health and education compared to all 50 states. Instead of addressing the alarming underperformance in these areas, Lieutenant Governor Dan Patrick threatens to mimic Louisiana’s bill to implement the Ten Commandments on public school grounds, regardless of a student’s religious affiliation. Trump shared his support on Truth Social, writing, **“I LOVE THE TEN COMMANDMENTS IN PUBLIC SCHOOLS, PRIVATE SCHOOLS, AND MANY OTHER PLACES, FOR THAT MATTER.”** This wave of Christian nationalism is also sweeping through Utah and Oklahoma, where lawmakers are plotting similar legislation. Moreover, Texas ranks 43rd in child well-being. Statistics show that 19% of children currently live in poverty, 70% of fourth graders lack reading proficiency, and 74% of eighth graders are behind in math. Not to mention, Texas has the highest rate of uninsured children in the nation, and limited access to mental health care. Poverty and a lack of secure employment burden Texans daily. The insufficient free lunch programs and school funding—particularly for vulnerable communities— additionally restricts families from accessing immediate support that could alleviate some of their economic hardships. The lack of funding, care, and action from conservative extremists adds up. We must prioritize the interests of everyday Texans. With one of the lowest rates of political participation and civic engagement in the country, it’s time to take action for our working-class families. Let’s turn the page together and make our voices heard in the upcoming election! **Join us next week with Sabrina for the latest updates on nationwide breaking news. Make sure to stay informed with NDLB!**

-Daniela Rodriguez

# Poised to Win
---
| | | | | Granite Staters and Americans across the country are making final decisions on how to vote and the trends are encouraging. Polls are tightening in favor of Republicans - in both New Hampshire and all Battleground states. Voters are realizing that Democrat policies are crippling our economy, damaging National Security, destroying our border, and contributing to crime and homelessness.
Republicans, however, are showing that our policies strengthen the economic well-being and security of all Americans. This is no time to rest. The final week is critical to closing the deal. Some good news to share is that: National Republican organizations are investing in New Hampshire; the NHGOP has launched our final phase of Get Out The Vote (GOTV) outreach; and over 500 Poll workers and Challengers have been Trained and Assigned to polling locations across the state.
**A few ways you can help:**
1\. Vote and encourage your family friends and neighbors to Vote Republican from TOP to BOTTOM of the ticket.
2\. Make GOTV calls. Sign up by Monday night - email [staff@nhrsc.com](mailto:staff@nhrsc.com "mailto:staff@nhrsc.com").
3\. Become an official Poll Challenger on election day. Sign up no later than Monday night by emailing [staff@nhrsc.com](mailto:staff@nhrsc.com "mailto:staff@nhrsc.com").
4\. Attend the final Governor's Debate Sign Wave to show support.[https://secure.winred.com/kelly-for-new-hampshire/signwave-wmur-oct30](https://gop.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6abc8216f2c93cdbede56dda3&id=73d7c26948&e=f3aa6419cd)
**WMUR Debate**
* Wednesday, October 30th, show up to sign-wave outside by 6:30pm
* Where: WMUR Studios, 100 S. Commercial St. Manchester, NH

Volunteers have been AMAZING this cycle! I thank you on behalf of the Party and Candidates for a job well done. Let's finish strong and get this done!!
Chris AgerChairman, NHGOP

Throughout the 2024 presidential election, Vice President Kamala Harris has attacked former president Donald Trump with dire, misleading warnings about how his policies would devastate America's health care system. However, Trump has a proven track record that indicates otherwise: His administration implemented policies that delivered better care at lower costs for Americans.

When Trump entered office in January 2017, his administration faced a health care system that was becoming increasingly unaffordable for everyday Americans. Between 2010 and 2017, the annual cost of premiums for families receiving coverage from their employer increased by 36 percent—almost three times the rate of inflation during the same time period.

To tackle this affordability crisis, the Trump administration took major steps to provide small businesses and workers more tools to lower the cost of coverage. It removed regulatory roadblocks that prevented employers from banding together to jointly buy health insurance for employees through association health plans. These group plans give small businesses, freelancers, and the self-employed the ability to negotiate lower prices for themselves and their families with buying power similar to that of large corporations. The Congressional Budget Office estimated that association health plans charge premiums 30 percent lower than those of the plans small employers typically offer. It also forecast that 3.7 million individuals would receive coverage through these group plans by 2028. However, the Biden-Harris administration restored the roadblocks for employers, preventing small businesses from utilizing these plans and providing health care at lower prices to their employees. **[Finish reading on Newsweek.com](http://links.americanxt.com/u/click?_t=45ea7b9dcedb45198104e7ca02a78270&_m=5c141225df7b444da3e326609990cb9c&_e=nREBIqN_d918-nL57ZMDge6LekbZ_Yf1eQCEAnk-uuZQY50ggNYZUXbrE2ihR_wGs4HXZR1oCpjB7gbcZMZT7GoH9Ipte9eQdEfrxBjtlMBU0tvlpFcS2Ca3y3snaxZU3qsYadXi5jJh3M5eeki2tWotuEN1UIGOYDad8zejah2A2-pHu9BdJLun0skJbXpadxAjAJtymPMiqST0Xj-bfN0T9yM6Zgi0W3SuVwr2b7DE-6MqRkUFn5x4YzpwSSeEp4yNl726B3qvxsDm1oXUWfKtNUprXaXvoQOlxiyN3uU%3D)**

---
**1.**
Here's a common thing you will see in political media that annoys the hell out of me: presenting _normative_ claims as _descriptive_ reality. That is, dressing up what you _hope to be true_ as what you actually believe is happening in fact.
Politely, speaking the future into existence or "manifesting" reality.
Less politely, LYING.
Yet most of the legacy media and party leaders are lying to each other, and to you. Expect that to get worse in the coming weeks on both sides.
Don't fall for it.
**Demand data, arguments, and analysis. And then, make up your own mind.**
[](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/829bd6e2-efbe-4cfd-aa85-7e1025b1feab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**2.**
This is a Substack for my friends, community, mentors, and any curious souls out there who have clicked 'subscribe.'
**I can 't promise you will always agree with me, or that I will always get it right.**
**I promise only that: (1) I won 't be boring (2) I won't lie to you.**
I am a Democrat and I want Democrats to do well - that is my inherent bias. I also make it clear - _especially_ to fellow Democrats - that this political commitment doesn't mean I am willing to live in a fantasy land, renounce logic, or stop observing reality.
For example, I think the president's brain is cooked and he has dementia or something very much like it - so I say so. I also think the vice president is the worst candidate we could have nominated in his stead, and partly as a consequence, I predicted she will lose.
That does not mean there isn't sexism and racism. I've seen enough [YouTube clips](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/00c78f30-cf54-471d-bc5e-a9c1035472ca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of (especially [young men](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/f0a711d6-852d-4391-9f4f-fc1e4622263d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)) saying Harris can't be president because she is a woman. Misogyny is real. But I also don't think calling out suspected bigots is a strategy. If you're complaining and scolding? You're losing. Or worse, you already lost.
**3.**
I dislike the phrase "people of color" because it sounds too urban, coastal, and Ivy League. This loses Democrats votes in the heartland. It generalizes far too much. Also, white is a color.
But ask any woman or minority who has achieved in this country and they will tell you this:**it was never enough for me to be** _**above average**_**; to get to where I am, I had to be** _**exceptional.**_
Barack Obama was exceptional and popular.
Hillary Clinton was exceptional and _un_ popular.
Harris is _un_ exceptional and _un_ popular.
Any honest Democrat sees this.
Were Harris not a woman of 2 colors, she would still would be a United States Senator. But she would have never become vice president.
**4.**
That does _not_ mean she "didn't earn it" (DEI). It was Biden's prerogative as the Democratic nominee to select a VP on any criteria or no fucking criteria at all, and that's who he chose. So, deal with it.
**Politics is not merit-based.**
It is based on, well, _politics_ - [a societal calculation about who gets what, when, and how.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/828aac36-192b-4156-a862-084b17aeee98?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) I voted for the Biden-Harris ticket in 2020 along with 81 million Americans, so Harris gets to be vice president whether she is "qualified" for that job or not.
Put another way, what makes Harris qualified for her job is that she _has it_. Same goes for Trump when he was elected, and if he is elected again.
**That 's how democracy works: the only qualification for elected office is that you get elected. And then we all get the government we damn well deserve.**
That's why calling Harris a "DEI hire" is stupid. The moniker assumes there is some other objective qualification that has been illegitimately usurped by race and gender. But she's a politician. And in politics, there _are_ no objective qualifications. You don't have to know how to change a light bulb, like electricians do, or like software engineers, how to code.
The qualifications are whatever the voters, donors, and party leaders decide they are - i.e., they are 100% _subjective_. You have to meet legal/constitutional requirements, of course. Beyond that, anything goes.
It's not like JD Vance isn't a diversity hire by Republicans' definition. Being from Appalachia undoubtedly helped him get into law school - Yale likes geographic diversity. And coming from a single-parent household marked by poverty, domestic violence, and substance abuse undoubtedly helped him become Trump's VP. Indeed, Vance's [bestselling book](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/191680a8-e330-4512-8295-f210b3073a05?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and entire career is based on the conceit that [he is a disadvantaged hillbilly worthy of special attention.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/ec630804-70a9-4c03-b7d2-394a2064c0d8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Similarly, Harris's race and gender has _helped_ her _tremendously_ , starting with her college and law school admissions and culminating in her rise to the vice presidency, because, affirmative action. It is also _hurting_ her now, because, sexism and racism.
Reality is always complicated and inconvenient in these sorts of ways.
But I much prefer painful truths to comforting lies. Don't you?
**5.**
Democrats like Pelosi and Obama were brave enough to oust Biden in the end, but not brave enough to do it in 2023 when they should have or to block Harris in July.
**Democrats like winning. But, apparently, we like identity politics more.**
**Biography and diversity are** _**always**_**relevant in politics. But ultimately, you do need a baseline competence, or at least the appearance of it, that the vice president seems to lack.**
I believe Kamala Harris is about as capable as George W. Bush - that is, good enough to become president if she were white, male, her daddy was president, and the Supreme Court were controlled by her party. Unfortunately for Democrats, Harris is non-white, female, her daddy was _not_ president, and the Supreme Court is controlled by Republicans.
Trump is also a _much_ more gifted politician than W. Bush or Al Gore. So more likely than not, Trump wins. If you are a pro-reality Democrat, as I am, that means Democratic House and Senate candidates should run their races accordingly. And the next time we have a shot at the White House, let's improve our chances by having a real primary to nominate someone voters seem to like.

| | | | | Here's a way to keep yourself protected and illuminate your path on night walks.

We made a stun tool that harnesses the absolute maximum voltage we were allowed to put into one civilian-approved product.

Introducing the 250 MILLION VOLT Stun Baton and Flashlight, we call it [**THE MUTILATOR**](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/18891/6374453/748965ede7aacd47f50eea8ab9cb60565eb8d483/d58d3ae3af91ae2374911120f6969f6ecc88d5a2).

**We certainly hope you never encounter a situation where you will need to use this on another person...

...although if you're on a night walk, and you sense a threat coming in the distance, let the thunderous CRACK of The Mutilator send a message for those within ear shot to be very cautious when approaching. **

This is not a toy, or a gimmicky product that will only produce a sound of 250 million volts, IT IS A **[ELECTROCUTION SELF-DEFENSE WEAPON](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/18891/6374453/748965ede7aacd47f50eea8ab9cb60565eb8d483/d58d3ae3af91ae2374911120f6969f6ecc88d5a2)** and will absolutely take an attacker down.

We can probably both agree you'll want to carry your concealed firearm for ultimate protection, but most of us aren't going to walk around the neighborhood holding your firearm open carry every single time you leave the house to walk the dog (even if your state permits).

Carrying the mutilator, acts as a, essential high-lumen flashlight, but has that next level of convenient electrocution threat defense at a moment's notice.

Today we are are running a special discount that comes with an industry leading lifetime warranty.

Not much to lose, but 250M volts of defense to gain with this one.

**Knock, knock, knock.**

_It’s the scariest sound you’ll hear when you live in a communist country._

_It’s the last sound my parents heard when their fathers were taken away._

_It’s the sound of always living in fear, and it’s my family’s real-life story._

We escaped from Vietnam just days before Saigon fell to the communists, and we were given a new life in the most generous country on Earth.

**America saved my life, and I dedicated my life to paying her back.**

I graduated from the United States Naval Academy and served for 25 years in Navy Special Operations in Iraq, Afghanistan, Somalia, and Pakistan and 40 other countries around the world.

I love this country - but right now, it’s taken a dark turn.

Now, the knocks are coming from Joe Biden’s Department of Justice. Sending two dozen armed agents to arrest a pro-life activist in front of his family. Raiding gun shops and seizing records from law-abiding gun owners. Arresting his challenger in the next election.

_And he’s doing it all while real criminals are free to roam our streets._

We are losing our country. You know it. But you also know we can save it.

I’ve been all over the world. Believe me when I tell you, if America fails, there is nowhere else to go.

**It’s time to save America while we still have a chance.**

**I’m Hung Cao, retired Navy Captain, and I’m running for the United States Senate.**

**[If you’re all-in to defend the greatest country on Earth, join our team today.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=c6619f20b8574f7fb3424887c418ebc4&_e=hF_S-tfPnWXmjvqXbjiPHARb4on4Y4LoBcCX26RHTs0mg6Z4dWWxY8A81h1khR98FN1TDdvIcE3b9WttN8M627KdFezvqTRY_uqRzaP_pD3c7K3MGBo-K7Inl2bhG6QYWrSRYEf5UXjIdXV9l3Hozi1UtzxFw0ekHp4tfr0q44k5_z4cblEPhliEZ08N6YcnoER7zOBV07XqSAMF_yVmcZ3JEj6g35UcakA64n3TAuwbshqhuJbwzr2HbOF9JpWAHf6R35i1pxNxMq-d2lutv7ceL3BU12QaYLHiVHwZ1aILEjPC_6yVjZPiCYqehxL_bK11DgK-xOGdjvd4bMh4PLUXPblQc3PMYvcjyZLXys04ZNJ3OlowIB5tlPcLoIRs)**

clean_body: | | | Knock, knock, knock. It’s the scariest sound you’ll hear when you live in a communist country. It’s the last sound my parents heard when their fathers were taken away. It’s the sound of always living in fear, and it’s my family’s real-life story. We escaped from Vietnam just days before Saigon fell to the communists, and we were given a new life in the most generous country on Earth. America saved my life, and I dedicated my life to paying her back. I graduated from the United States Naval Academy and served for 25 years in Navy Special Operations in Iraq, Afghanistan, Somalia, and Pakistan and 40 other countries around the world. I love this country - but right now, it’s taken a dark turn. Now, the knocks are coming from Joe Biden’s Department of Justice. Sending two dozen armed agents to arrest a pro-life activist in front of his family. Raiding gun shops and seizing records from law-abiding gun owners. Arresting his challenger in the next election. And he’s doing it all while real criminals are free to roam our streets. We are losing our country. You know it. But you also know we can save it. I’ve been all over the world. Believe me when I tell you, if America fails, there is nowhere else to go. It’s time to save America while we still have a chance. I’m Hung Cao, retired Navy Captain, and I’m running for the United States Senate. I still believe America can be the land of opportunity, Fellow Patriot. And as someone who owes their life to the American Dream, I have an obligation to fight back against those who have trampled on it. We need REAL fighters. Not politicians, not bureaucrats, and not keyboard warriors acting tough in custom made suits. If we’re going to preserve our freedoms, we can’t be intimidated. We must be fearless. Let’s win this. Rape, torture, beatings, bombings, starvation, kidnappings, and indefinite detention of Palestinians summarize [the third report by the Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel](https://substack.com/redirect/639d50e8-ec9a-408b-a016-443467300584?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The UN backed Commission submitted its third report to the General Assembly weeks ago, and yet legacy media has continued to pretend it does not exist.
The UN Commission also documents and condemns war crimes committed by Hamas--including taking of Israeli hostages. It does not make excuses for, or defend those war crimes. In doing so, the UN Commission demonstrates its objectivity, reemphasizing the fact that war crimes do not justify more war crimes.
I launched _Let 's Address This with Qasim Rashid_ to particularly cover the human rights issues legacy media continues to ignore. Below is a concise overview of this devastating UN report, and a reminder of why we must not relent in our demands for justice and enforcement of International Human Rights Law. **Let 's Address This.**

Chained Israeli protesters hold placards in a call for an end to the war in Gaza, during Britain's Foreign Secretary David David Lammy's visit, in Jerusalem, 16 August (Reuters/Latifeh Abdellatif)
While I encourage everyone to read the full report linked above, I want to focus on three key findings from this report, that of course, legacy media is underreporting.
1. The Israeli military attacks on healthcare facilities and the impact that has on reproductive healthcare for women and pediatric care for children.
2. The allegation from the Israeli military that Hamas is using hospitals as military bases.
3. The treatment of Palestinians in Israeli prisons.

[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..WRCGdbf0_orknwwwFG873FU9Rz3X8Ksn3FjM9iss4jE?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=150146174)
### 1\. Israeli military attacks on healthcare
The UN Commission cites the World Health Organization to detail Israel's extensive attacks on healthcare facilities--which are war crimes. The data is daunting. Between 7 October 2023 and 30 July 2024, the Israeli military:
* Carried out **498 attacks on healthcare** facilities in the Gaza Strip.
* **747 persons were killed directly** in those attacks, **969 others were injured** , and **110 facilities were affected**.
* 78% of the attacks between 7 October 2023 and 12 February 2024 were carried out through military force, 35% involved obstruction of access, and 9% involved militarized search and detention operations.

The impact on women and reproductive healthcare has been nothing short of utterly devastating. The UN Commission reports:
* Direct attacks on health-care facilities, including those offering sexual and reproductive health care and services, **have affected about 540,000 women and girls who are of reproductive age in Gaza**.
* The Basmah in vitro fertilization centre, the largest fertility clinic in Gaza, was the direct target of air strikes in December 2023 that reportedly **resulted in the destruction of approximately 3,000 embryos**.
* **Women have increasingly been forced to give birth in unsafe conditions** at home or in shelters or camps, with little or no medical support, increasing the risk of complications resulting in life-long injuries and death.
* Obstetric emergencies and premature births have reportedly surged because of stress and trauma. **An increase in miscarriages of up to 300% has been reported**. Experts told the Commission that the long-term psychological and physical effects of such precarious conditions for women, newborns and the family remain unknown.

Similarly, the Israeli military attacks on hospitals has left the most vulnerable among us--our children--to suffer unimaginable horrors. Yet, these horrors unfold right before our eyes. The UN Commission reports about the impact of Israel's siege on children:
* Medical professionals told the Commission that they have treated children with direct gunshot wounds, **indicating direct targeting of children**.
* In June, the United Nations Children's Fund estimated that almost **3,000 malnourished children were at risk of dying** owing to the lack of food in southern Gaza.
* Hospitals in Gaza can no longer offer mental health treatment and have few specialized staff to treat children suffering psychological conditions, **including those exhibiting suicidal and self-harming thoughts**.
* Doctors told the Commission that, as a result of attacks on medical facilities and the limited treatment options available, **infants and children in Gaza would likely suffer well into their adulthood**.

Now, the Israeli government claims all of this suffering is justified, and their attacks on hospitals are justified. Why? Because, [as Netanyahu continues to claim, Hamas is using these hospitals for military purposes](https://substack.com/redirect/a93d9406-025b-46b3-8ef0-79dcc5bb9b0c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), including as "command-and-control" centers. The independent UN Commission directly rebukes this claim.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e211244a-2beb-47da-a7c9-73f23c160d5d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..WRCGdbf0_orknwwwFG873FU9Rz3X8Ksn3FjM9iss4jE?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=150146174)
### Allegation that Hamas uses hospitals as a military base
Did Hamas use hospitals in Gaza as their secret military bases? The UN report tackled this important question in detail. International Human Rights Law [makes it explicitly clear that hospitals and medical institutions are protected from attack](https://substack.com/redirect/07526b69-5a89-4bdc-b139-d69c0c6942e7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The _exception_ that IHL recognizes is when a hospital or medical facility is used:
> Outside their humanitarian functions [and] "act harmful to the enemy". In case of doubt as to whether medical units of establishments are used to commit an "act harmful to the enemy", they should be presumed not to be so used.
And though IHL does not explicitly define the scope of "an act harmful to the enemy," IHL clarifies that _when in doubt_ --hospitals and medical institutions must remain protected. This means that in bombing 110 healthcare facilities, the Israeli military should have had explicitly clear knowledge that Hamas was using these facilities as "command-and-control" centers in violation of IHL. And if the Israeli government had explicitly clear knowledge, then they should have zero trouble providing ample evidence, example after example, that Hamas is using hospitals in violation of IHL.
On the contrary, the detailed UN Commission concluded the following:
> **Israeli security forces asserted that over 85% of major medical facilities in Gaza were used by Hamas for terror operations, but did not provide evidence to substantiate that claim**. Israeli security forces alleged that there were tunnels underneath or connected to hospitals, and that Hamas stored weapons, hid personnel and operated headquarters from within and underneath hospitals. The Commission interviewed senior medical personnel at hospitals and they denied that there was any military activity, emphasizing that the hospitals' only role was to treat patients.
Let's unpack this. The Israeli military first claims that only 85% of the 110 medical facilities it targeted were used for "Hamas terror operations." That means that it admits 15% of the medical facilities it targeted had no Hamas terror operations, but the Israeli military targeted them anyway. That in and of itself is a clear admission of war crimes. And that is all that should be necessary for the US Government, indeed the global West, to stop arming Netanyahu.
But adding to these war crimes is that even in the "85% (allegedly) legitimate targets," the Israeli government could provide no evidence to substantiate its claims. The UN Commission found zero evidence from the Israeli government, or from a single senior medical personnel at the hospitals that any military activity occurred at the hospitals that the Israeli military bombed. Yet, the bombings continue, in complete violation of IHL. And given that these bombings are deliberate and intentional, I argue this satisfies the "intent" element of proving genocide. Indeed, beyond war crimes, the Israeli military bombing 110 hospitals and medical centers in Gaza, while knowing full well they are _not_ Hamas military command centers, proves they are intentionally killing Palestinian civilians. That is genocide.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b8739932-120c-41f9-b7a9-00c3e2e67183?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
