### Treatment of Palestinians in Israeli prisons
Finally, the UN Commission reports a ghastly scene on how the Israeli military is treating the tens of thousands of Palestinians it has arbitrarily arrested. Of the 14,000 Palestinians arbitrarily arrested from Gaza and the West Bank since October 7 of last year, at least 11,000 remain in Israeli custody--most without charge, due process, or access to counsel. They are hostages by any other name. And their mistreatment amounts to more war crimes. The UN Commission found that even after the Israeli military admits a detained Palestinian is of no threat, he or she remains arbitrarily detained without cause. The report additionally concludes these horrifying facts:
* As at 15 July, **at least 53 Palestinian detainees had died in Israeli detention** facilities since 7 October 2023. Of that number, 44 persons were from Gaza, including 36 who died in Sde Teiman, and 9 were from the West Bank. **Deceased detainees ' bodies have largely not been returned to their families for burial.**
* Israel provided **no evidence that investigations into deaths in custody were being conducted** , with a view to ensuring accountability.
* **Hundreds of children from Gaza and the West Bank were arrested** and then transferred and detained in Israel and the West Bank. Detained children were subjected to extreme violence during arrest, detention, interrogation and release.
* Detainees, including older individuals, taken to Sde Teiman for interrogation were tied in painful positions or bound to a screw placed high on a wall for hours, while **blindfolded and suspended** with their feet touching or barely touching the ground ("shabah"). **The Commission also received reports of electric shock devices being used against detainees.**
* The Commission documented **more than 20 cases of sexual and gender-based violence against male and female detainees in more than 10 military and Israel Prison Service facilities** , in particular in Negev prison and Sde Teiman camp for male detainees and in Damon and Hasharon prisons for female detainees.
* The Commission found that **forced nudity, with the aim of degrading and humiliating victims in front of both soldiers and other detainees, was frequently used against male victims.** Several male detainees reported that Israeli security forces personnel had beaten, kicked, pulled or squeezed their genitals.
* One detainee who had been held in the Israeli security forces personnel Negev prison stated that, in November 2023, he was forced to strip and then ordered to kiss the Israeli flag. When he refused, **he was beaten and his genitals were kicked so severely that he vomited and lost consciousness**.
* The Israeli authorities **have not disclosed the names and whereabouts of the thousands of Palestinians from Gaza** arrested since 7 October, including in response to several habeas corpus petitions to the High Court of Justice.

[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..WRCGdbf0_orknwwwFG873FU9Rz3X8Ksn3FjM9iss4jE?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=150146174)
### Conclusion
The above is a mere snapshot of the full report--[which I again encourage everyone to read](https://substack.com/redirect/639d50e8-ec9a-408b-a016-443467300584?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). A reminder that The Lancet estimated last June that [Israel's siege on Gaza has killed at least 186,000 Palestinians](https://substack.com/redirect/62db221e-d29a-4240-ac73-699c6e23428c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The Israeli government has faced zero accountability for these clear violations of international human rights law. Nor has President Biden enforced the U.S. Leahy Laws to stop funding and arming these war crimes.
This is what intentional genocide looks like, and it is absolutely indefensible. The UN Commission details a thorough investigation, and concludes that virtually every, if not every, justification cited by Netanyahu to perpetuate his siege on Gaza is based on misinformation and disinformation. Meanwhile, legacy media remains largely silent on this ongoing US funded atrocity. The US Government must stop being complicit Netanyahu's war crimes and genocide. And we must keep raising our voices to demand justice and accountability.
For my part, you have my commitment to continue to demand justice in all matters by placing human rights and human dignity above all else. Thank you for support in elevating this work and advocacy.

Folks are already filling up the arena. Trump will take the stage in Tempe in just a little while.
Trump’s gone completely off the rails lately. He calls us all “the enemy from within,” and he’s attacked Ruben directly multiple times over the past few months. He’s called him a “radical,” a “lunatic,” and worse.

[](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=8743485292554690a77734a14b4c4dd2&_e=BxCXErRRGGdLsCKH4ODuVg92NawmOC00C8OeYjEZCLH_JlDfPIa75EyUqOogccHXcTV5THa49j77eLAtjE0tB33UweuRyrm2MlVmi6DIZFGmjO1o4NRseZHMNB66b-l6avRc3qBUiWH36J_iZy7IBpmvh3Dk6fhmkuk8xjZaHiB6kxTbEh0eo-872Q5x3N_O9wJ65WhPUiI8H9RibfIk5qGe9yRP7PqFGWZCTYaUtPd4Q9N2DWsIjfBPNiGwM4RD6w0Ey76jG3-8Q3PY1rXrVQzIqNS1r4o23WFZilI8TQWRwDw9An7bbf4NqTb67y9GCJl_d2EtIqxFGcUMWKhFE_YdNd6L9uMLjl2Kido_rE6V-CfSTGjp2u2I84AsRti8lAM7_mFI_PnasoZ49q7korZG2DtAmmtTi1cm5HL0xiEmiTwIygdRUzZoKa_rd5b1fsYwfm7kc706mI3FnRNX0kpmVS4dqJU7h9A4XFBg9nc%3D)
Fellow Patriot,

My opponent let a man who was charged with grooming and sexual assault walk free. He had the power to hold a rapist accountable, but instead, he gave him no prison time, and he didn’t even have him register as a sex offender.
That’s not the kind of leader we need as our next Attorney General.
This is an important issue to me. When I took office as Pennsylvania’s Auditor General in 2013, there were 3,000 untested rape kits sitting in evidence rooms and crime labs across Pennsylvania.
In that number, I saw 3,000 victims of rape who had the courage to willingly subject themselves to an invasive and uncomfortable medical examination in the pursuit of justice and to protect others from their assailants. Instead, the justice system failed them.
Those rape kits should have been tested right away, but instead, thousands of them sat for months, even years—untouched and untested—meaning the attackers were never caught and the survivors never got justice.
**I wasn’t about to let this injustice stand—not on my watch.**
So I brought the full force and resources of my office to bear and we worked to reduce the backlog of untested rape kits. We fought for more resources and held law enforcement agencies accountable. And in three years, the backlog dropped by 90 percent. And the work didn’t stop there.
My investigation led to action in Harrisburg. A bipartisan coalition passed a law creating the sexual assault evidence tracking system. That law will help ensure the backlog of untested rape kits never happens again.
I’m proud of many accomplishments during my tenure as Auditor General, but getting justice for nearly 3,000 victims of sexual assault is the one I’m most proud of.
That’s why knowing that my opponent let an abuser walk free makes my blood boil. We can’t let him become Pennsylvania’s next Attorney General.

Peter, The Stein/Ware 2024 campaign is humbled and honored by the endorsements of so many distinguished activists, coming from all walks of life, united in their support of this historic campaign. Jill and Butch’s diverse array of endorsers include, to name just a few:
* **Abandon Harris** , who have been at the forefront of the righteous demand that the Muslim and Arab American community reject the candidate who has aided and abetted Israel’s genocide of the Palestinian people and instead cast their votes for Jill Stein, the only choice who will stop the carnage on day one.

* **Kshama Sawant** , former socialist Seattle City Council member who fought for and won a $15 an hour minimum wage. Along with her newly formed organization **Workers Strike Back** , who are leading the battle to break labor’s abusive relationship with the anti-Democratic Party and put power back in the hands of the working classes.

* **Briahna Joy Gray** , the host of Bad Faith podcast and former Press Secretary for Bernie Sanders whose unwavering commitment to telling the truth about the genocide in Gaza cost her a co-hosting spot on The Hill’s Rising.

* **Lady Bunny** , the legendary drag performer and pioneering queer icon who knows that the path to real LGBTQIA+ liberation will never be realized by accepting the crumbs of the neoliberal establishment.

To be honest, we have far too many incredible endorsements to list in a single email, so [please click here](https://www.jillstein2024.com/endorsed?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fe_10_24_pm&n=2) to see the complete list of Stein/Ware's amazing and inspirational endorsers. [_**Peter, these diverse and inspirational endorsers know that the time is now to break with the corrupt duopoly of war and Wall Street. We have less than two weeks to make sure that voters everywhere know that they have the choice to vote for people, planet and peace. We need to get our ads and digital billboards seen everywhere. Can you dig deep today to help get the word out at this critical moment?**_](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fe_10_24_pm&n=3)

In the Maryland Senate, she passed laws to increase the oyster population, invest in clean energy jobs, protect our communities from flooding and rising sea levels, and encourage private sector investment in restoring the Bay. We need Sarah in Congress to continue that work. Sarah understands that protecting the Bay isn’t just the right thing to do for our environment. It’s the right thing to do for our economy and the thousands of Marylanders who earn their living on the Chesapeake Bay. That’s how she’s been able to bring people together to win bipartisan support for restoring and protecting the Bay. In Congress, she will continue her fight for climate justice, speed up our transition to clean energy, help communities become more resilient to climate change, and protect the Bay and its watershed. = | = | = | = | = | = Onwards! Chris Van Hollen P.S. Early Voting starts today and goes through Thursday, October 31st. subject: We know this man has never punched a clock in his life.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
Halloween came early for Donald Trump.
#
Halloween came early for Donald Trump. He’s been running around in a McDonald’s costume, and Tuesday night he attacked Alexandria at a rally:
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20241024.2gnZNU&refcode=em20241024-7443-P_FND_CTR_GND&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7443%2E2526796%2EQV9_4R)
**We know this man has never punched a clock in his life**.
He’s never wiped down a table. He’s never had to fix his own car. He’s never struggled to make ends meet.
He doesn't know what it means to check your paycheck every week to see what you’ve got left.
Unlike Donald Trump, Alexandria comes from a low income background and is one of just a few working-class people elected to Congress. **That makes a lot of classist, ageist, misogynist, and racist people — just like Donald Trump — mad**.
But together, we’ve built a movement fighting for transformative change — from Medicare for All to democratizing fundraising power in politics.
[Trump is doing all he can to slow our movement down, but he will not win. Will you make a $5 contribution, or anything you can, today to keep this movement strong and fight back against Trump and the MAGA movement?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20241024.2gnZNU&refcode=em20241024-7443-P_FND_CTR_GND&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=7443%2E2526796%2EQV9_4R)

Thank you so much for standing with us.
In solidarity,
Team AOC

name: Eric Sorensen
subject: My job is all about service.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Eric Sorensen for Illinois
body:
[|
---](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/srhpVdnvUVOD5MGvNtAJUw~~/AAUS1gA~/RgRo_UrPP0QgaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZXJpY2ZvcmlsbGlub2lzLmNvbS9XA3NwY0IKZxLixRpn4SQW11IUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAABs~)
| | Peter, It may seem obvious, but it’s worth a reminder: Members of Congress are elected to serve each and every person they represent. **Service is what this job is all about.** That’s why my team and I jumped at a recent opportunity to serve a resident of IL-17 who served our country valiantly in World War II. Roald Zvonik, a 98-year-old-Navy veteran, had never received he coveted medals he earned during the war. Your contributions help fund our efforts to mobilize thousands of volunteers and staff who are actively knocking on doors, making phone calls, and engaging with voters. _Dr. Asif Mahmood_

Friends,
It should be the lowest bar in American politics: condemn anyone who praises Adolf Hitler.
But failed, far-right Congressman Nick LaLota couldn’t bring himself to do even that.
He’s too much of a follower to even take that minor risk of offending his political boss. So in last night’s News 12 debate blowout - Lalota refused to criticize Trump’s infatuation with Adolf Hitler.
You’ve probably seen that Trump’s longest serving Chief of Staff, Four Star Marine General John Kelly, went on the record to confirm that Trump repeatedly praised Hitler in his presence - and even said that he wanted to have the kind of Nazi Generals that Hitler had.
Nick LaLota’s reaction should be pretty straightforward, right? “Hitler was evil and this rhetoric has no place in our politics.”
But no, that’s of course not what he said. He deflected, attacked, and tried to turn it around. He couldn’t bring himself to criticize Donald Trump.

**Knock, knock, knock.**

_It’s the scariest sound you’ll hear when you live in a communist country._

_It’s the last sound my parents heard when their fathers were taken away._

_It’s the sound of always living in fear, and it’s my family’s real-life story._

Politicians love to talk about how they are "defending our Democracy" or "protecting our freedom."

_Yet it 's ironic: the majority of them have never done anything for anyone besides themselves._

Please take James Carville's FINAL strategy survey before midnight.
Hi there, it's Diana, the DSCC Research Director.

With just 12 days until Election Day and the battle for Senate control at a fever pitch, we need to stay on top of our strategy. That’s why James Carville reached out and requested your input for his LAST strategy interview this cycle.

**But he didn’t get an answer from you -- and now he's 42 responses short of what he needed in Pennsylvania!**

**[Did you see the survey James sent over?](http://go.dscc.org/go/20174?ask=5&t=7&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-ND-20241024-Diana-DianaBumpCarvilleLastStrategySurvey24-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-ND-20241024-Diana-DianaBumpCarvilleLastStrategySurvey24-Pros-sl1&akid=18491%2E9716520%2E5nNQuT)** You're one of our top supporters, so I thought I'd reach out to ask if you'll take another look. His original email is below, and if you need it again, here's a direct link: **[www.dscc.org/CarvilleFinalSurvey#9716520](http://go.dscc.org/go/20174?ask=5&t=8&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-ND-20241024-Diana-DianaBumpCarvilleLastStrategySurvey24-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-ND-20241024-Diana-DianaBumpCarvilleLastStrategySurvey24-Pros-sl1&akid=18491%2E9716520%2E5nNQuT)**

| | | Folks, it's James Carville. I really need your full attention on this, so listen up:

We're in the final lap of the election -- just 14 more days. **And I've gotta tell you, I'm sweatin' like a sinner in church thinking about what's on the line.**

If we're gonna win this thing and stop Trump's MAGA fantasy from becoming a living nightmare, we need to make sure our candidates have the intel they need to crush his allies at the ballot box. **[And to help 'em get it, I'm opening up my FINAL strategy survey of this election. Will you take it before midnight?](http://go.dscc.org/go/20174?ask=5&t=10&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-ND-20241024-Diana-DianaBumpCarvilleLastStrategySurvey24-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-ND-20241024-Diana-DianaBumpCarvilleLastStrategySurvey24-Pros-sl1&akid=18491%2E9716520%2E5nNQuT)**

| | [Enter Survey](http://go.dscc.org/go/20174?ask=5&t=11&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-ND-20241024-Diana-DianaBumpCarvilleLastStrategySurvey24-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-ND-20241024-Diana-DianaBumpCarvilleLastStrategySurvey24-Pros-sl1&akid=18491%2E9716520%2E5nNQuT)
---

Look, I'm not screwin' around when I say **what you do today could swing the whole dang thing.**

It's put up or shut up time in these _must-win_ races. If our candidates aren't equipped to face EVERY attack, knock on EVERY door, reach EVERY voter they can...well, the consequences could read like a page out of that Project 2025 handbook Trump and Vance love so much. **Because a Senate Republican majority could actually PASS all that gobbledygook!**

**_You_ are what's standing between us and that catastrophe. _**

You can give campaigns VITAL insight into what voters from Pennsylvania are thinking. Hearing from YOU can help them finalize their winning strategy. **I know that's not an opportunity a Democrat like you would pass up.**

**Once you fill out this survey, we'll know how best to reach voters and finish strong**. But if you just leave it blank, if you ignore this opportunity, if you decide to kick back and relax as Republicans spend MILLIONS...heck we might actually lose this thing. _There's no chance in hell I'll stay silent and let that happen._

**14 more days. We've gotta leave it all on the field, and this could be the last chance you get before Election Day.**[My FINAL survey should only take a couple minutes, so there's no reason not to do it.](http://go.dscc.org/go/20174?ask=5&t=12&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-ND-20241024-Diana-DianaBumpCarvilleLastStrategySurvey24-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-ND-20241024-Diana-DianaBumpCarvilleLastStrategySurvey24-Pros-sl1&akid=18491%2E9716520%2E5nNQuT)****

body:
Join me in calling upon Generals Mattis, Milley, and any other leaders who have served in close proximity to Trump to speak out, in public, directly to the American people. There is no time to waste.
#
Peter, Paul Eaton here. Retired Major General, U.S. Army, now with VoteVets.
In my estimation, we have one opportunity to break the hold that Donald Trump still has on millions of Americans; on Active Duty members of the Military, Veterans, members of Military Families, and more.
I believe that we need leaders of political courage to speak out in order to do it.
What I mean by that is the political courage shown by former Congresswoman Liz Cheney, who stood up to her own party in the face of Trump’s lawlessness and dictatorial aims.
The courage shown by General Kelly, Trump’s former Chief of Staff, who went forward publicly with his deep concerns about Trump — his belief that Trump meets the definition of a fascist, Trump’s fascination with and admiration of Hitler, Trump’s desire to be served by generals with absolute loyalty “like Hitler’s Generals,” and his continuous attacks on the dignity of the fallen, the wounded, the captured, and all who serve.
**Now is the time for Generals Milley, Mattis, and so many others who served under Trump to speak directly to the American people. Now is the time to say publicly what they have been reported as saying in private.**
Each of them swore the same oath I did: To support and defend the Constitution of the United States against all enemies, foreign and domestic. It is their duty to speak out now.
Donald Trump is a grave domestic threat to our Constitution, and we desperately need leaders of character, conscience, and courage to do whatever they can to ensure he does not become our Commander in Chief once more.
**[Join me in calling upon Generals Mattis, Milley, and any other leaders who have served in close proximity to Trump to speak out, in public, directly to the American people. There is no time to waste.](https://act.votevets.org/signup/241024_vv_em_milley_mattis/?source=em241024-1-30?refcode2=33451.3013755.qMLr7z&akid=33451%2E3013755%2EqMLr7z)**

name: DNC HQ
subject: Find out what you need to vote early in Pennsylvania →
body:
Go to IWillVote.com/PA to learn more about voting early in Pennsylvania.
---
**Derek -- In-person vote by mail is available in Pennsylvania, so get ready to cast your ballot for Kamala Harris, Tim Walz, Eugene DePasquale for Attorney General, Bob Casey Jr. for U.S. Senate, and Matt Cartwright for U.S. Congress.** This race could come down to a handful of votes in Pennsylvania. It is more important than ever to make a plan to vote to elect Vice President Harris, Governor Walz, and Democrats up and down the ballot so that we can chart a new way forward to a future where we protect reproductive freedom, strengthen our democracy, and ensure every person has the opportunity to not just get by but to get ahead. **[To cast your ballot early, you can visit your local county election office or another designated location to request a mail-in ballot and complete it in person. For more information on voting in your county check out IWillVote.com/PA.](https://iwillvote.com?state=pa&refcode=em_20241024_2043_do&utm_source=dnc_organizing&utm_campaign=em_ak_iwv_do_dvc_gotevip_20241024_dnc_pa_na_na_na&utm_medium=em)** _**ID Requirements for Voting in Pennsylvania**_ You do not need to bring anything to vote unless it is your first time voting in your precinct or ward or if you changed your name on your voter registration.

**Questions about voting?**
**Call our Pennsylvania Voter Hotline at 833-728-6837**
**[LEARN MORE](https://iwillvote.com?state=pa&refcode=em_20241024_2043_do&utm_source=dnc_organizing&utm_campaign=em_ak_iwv_do_dvc_gotevip_20241024_dnc_pa_na_na_na&utm_medium=em)** See you at the polls, The Democrats P.S. Already voted? **[Let us know by adding your name here,](https://ak.democrats.org/signup/i-already-voted/&refcode=em_20241024_2043_do&utm_source=dnc_organizing&utm_campaign=em_ak_iwv_do_dvc_gotevip_20241024_dnc_pa_na_na_na&utm_medium=em?t=1&akid=2043%2E22930333%2ETSsn56)** and then make sure your friends and family have plans to vote, too.

_If you gave recently via check or mail, our system may not have yet processed your gift. We are appreciative and thank you greatly for your support._

I’ve run in a lot of races in my life — and no, not the kind you’re thinking of. 😉
I’ve always loved the sport of running. In college, I was on our school’s cross country team – as you can see in the picture above!
Here are some of the best lessons I’ve learned as a runner:
🏃♀️ Even if it’s just you on the course, there’s a whole team behind you that makes every step possible.
💪 It can be hard, but if it’s something you care about, it’s worth it.

Funnily enough, when I ran my first political campaign, I realized a lot of the same lessons were true!
With 12 days until Election Day and one week until our last fundraising deadline, I need the support of my “team” more than ever.

clean_body: A moment like this only happens once in a lifetime. | | | | | | Your Photo in History: Take Part in the Unforgettable Kennedy-Trump Mosaic Dear Peter, A moment like this only happens once in a lifetime. Robert F. Kennedy Jr. has made a historic move — endorsing Donald Trump for President. Together, they represent a unified front to end the bitter divide and put America back on track. And now, you can be a part of this iconic moment. not only will you help elect President Trump as the 47th President of the United States, but you’ll also become a part of a powerful mosaic — capturing the unforgettable handshake between RFK Jr. and President Trump. This mosaic will commemorate the moment two patriots, one Independent, one Republican, joined forces for the greater good of our country. This partnership will work to end the forever wars, protect our civil liberties, get corruption out of our government agencies, and Make America Health Again. Your photo will stand as a symbol of unity and your commitment to restoring America. Don’t miss this opportunity to have your picture featured in this unforgettable mosaic. Join us in celebrating this turning point in our nation’s history. Thank you for standing with us! Team Kennedy | | ©2024 • • • • PAID FOR BY TEAM KENNEDY | | PAID FOR BY TEAM KENNEDY P.O. Friend — by now, with just 12 days until Election Day, I hope you have a good sense of who I am and the issues I believe are so important.
But I thought a little reminder would be helpful, especially contrasted with who Rick Scott is 🤢. Maybe it will even motivate you to **[make your very first online donation](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95753838/507776339/849749119?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2373-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDE1OTliN2MtNWU5Mi1lZjExLTg0NzQtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=v0iYzb28mzHek0HcxJId8tQzWiHadJwExb4IPyioHl0=)** before tonight's fundraising deadline to ensure I can defeat Rick Scott!
First and foremost, I'm everything I am today because of my mother. She brought my sisters and me to America when I was just 14. Mom knew we had to get out of Ecuador, which was transitioning to democracy after suffering under a military dictatorship. She knew America was the key to a better life.

Well, with a whole lot of hard work (including working in a doughnut shop to help my family get by), long hours, and a ton of hope, we were able to win our American dream. My story is what inspires me to give back to this incredible country and state that gave me so much.
After putting myself through college, I worked for several nonprofit organizations across Florida, helping to **protect our wildlife and preserve our coral reefs**.

Rick Scott, on the other hand, banned saying the words "climate change" when he was governor of Florida, and the League of Conservation Voters gave him a whopping 0% score last year.

During my time working at Florida International University, I spearheaded a new program to **expand affordable health care access** to more Floridians. But Rick Scott has voted to repeal the Affordable Care Act more times than I care to count. And who can forget he committed one of the largest Medicare frauds in the history of our country.

Eventually, I had the honor of serving my community in the U.S. House of Representatives, where I became the first South American immigrant to be elected to Congress! In the House, I wrote the bill to **expand seniors’ Medicare Advantage coverage** , worked with Republicans to provide **economic relief** to families and small businesses, and secured $200 million for **Everglades restoration**.
I'm proud of my record — but can Rick Scott say the same, friend? He has used his time in office writing the plan to end Social Security and Medicare, attempting to undermine our elections, attacking our rights, and making it harder for working families to get ahead.

**As a result, Rick Scott's approval ratings with Floridians are underwater. Even a large percentage of Republicans don't approve of him! Now, polling shows me statistically tied with Scott, and in just 12 days, we can defeat him and protect our Democratic Senate majority in the process.**
**[But with Rick Scott outspending me 3-1 on the airwaves, it's going to take a surge in grassroots support from people like you to truly defeat him. So please, rush a donation of $5 or whatever you can to send me to the U.S. Senate and give Floridians the true leader and public servant we deserve!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95753839/507776340/849749119?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2373-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDE1OTliN2MtNWU5Mi1lZjExLTg0NzQtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=v0iYzb28mzHek0HcxJId8tQzWiHadJwExb4IPyioHl0=)**

We made a very difficult decision last week.
We had a campaign team meeting, during which it became clear that if we had a bit more money, we could make a real play for additional votes as voting was underway across the state.
The money wasn’t in the budget. But I gave the green light.
It’s a risk. But this is the moment to take some risks. I’ve had similar moments in prior years. We can’t get caught short when people are already casting their ballots in this election. That'd be a mistake.
But the bet we made was that, as the race tightens, and if we asked, our supporters would come through to help fill the gap. We hope that you will. To keep the Senate in the hands of the Democrats.
So with that in mind: can you make a $10 contribution to Tim Kaine and my campaign to help us fill the budget gap we created going after the voters we need to persuade to help win this race? $10 isn’t much, but at this point it’s the small-dollar donations that are making a difference here at the end.
Like I said, it was a tough call. But if there’s one thing that distinguishes this campaign from every other, it’s our people. You answer the call every single time. $10 is all we need to close the gap. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-slotkin]

Fellow Patriot,

**At West Point, we had a code: cadets don't lie, cheat, steal, or tolerate those who do.**

_First the New York Times lied about my childhood and family, and now CNN is lying about my business record._

And what's worse, they are doing it all because _I 'm within striking distance of an entrenched career politician, Bob Casey, in the #1 swing state in the nation that will determine control of the U.S Senate._

**Bob Casey is getting Leftist news sources to do his dirty work, and I WON 'T TOLERATE IT.

Here's the truth: this is a long message and I hope you will read all the way to the end.**

I grew up in Bloomsburg, Pennsylvania. We lived on campus at Bloomsburg State College and my parents owned a farm ten minutes down the road.

I had summer jobs baling hay and trimming Christmas trees at nearby farms.

My dad started his career teaching history, economics, & democracy at Punxsutawney High. My mom began teaching fourth through sixth graders at a public school near Pittsburgh.

[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=34191fcca34a451a8809a0cac0a93507&_e=sq5sfEvEybQjwtXahW4EK1tEI2rvIrPJoYuWNuX4Utj4EmdMtXdOLnbx4rs_sI6kIa3656fphKuOwuXeCZQR9XhP0cDkcBACW55WMI2vogy8wHPJb1qxhIqrjfAlnYc8_l1PaLEnvke0XHRPfFHSJxcyU7wYwEA2tDx1yfhkPNaNpoiFg_5FAykg16ioeYk3aYXzynrroisUQJVqWnOF5WnSI6BbbiirwZeSQ2uMeGFJ9cMfwwdqKdt0GCe5-JnYD0lDwyJrn0mWxvlEiPhpGPOpL8D5QxSTektqK-0FDGOMUOmUJyvFYnyo0-WaD3ZKq8WVtjXL7hHd09pD_o7ntf5Kr3SmNebotmGON9HzNAkD2sVugiUUcvKUJt0lzfNNGsjVdAUgbHrcfbWgP6MKkem606OP5YjRLKSS2PTib6A%3D)

I'm incredibly proud that my dad was chosen to be president of Bloomsburg State College (now Bloomsburg University) at only 34 years old.

[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=34191fcca34a451a8809a0cac0a93507&_e=sq5sfEvEybQjwtXahW4EK1tEI2rvIrPJoYuWNuX4Utj4EmdMtXdOLnbx4rs_sI6kIa3656fphKuOwuXeCZQR9XhP0cDkcBACW55WMI2vogy8wHPJb1qxhIqrjfAlnYc8_l1PaLEnvke0XHRPfFHSJxcyU7wYwEA2tDx1yfhkPNaNpoiFg_5FAykg16ioeYk3aYXzynrroisUQJVqWnOF5WnSI6BbbiirwZeSQ2uMeGFJ9cMfwwdqKdt0GCe5-JnYD0lDwyJrn0mWxvlEiPhpGJpIZMC_7wfMJGTYCWpqa8xOdmH2WhoXWpEX45MU9Y9uwCITFK8L3pWxStBJEEK6_gxKthN2huLmXORUlcKKoKoei4G03OcJtfHYuHdTfQc_JWj3Wh8LmeBeacAj4CUhFcGYs3Y2qwLFtX4_Xm4omvA%3D)

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: J.D. Vance once called Social Security and Medicare “the biggest roadblocks to any kind of real fiscal sanity.”
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2383%2E4032634%2EVVh2BB)
---
Understand this: Social Security and Medicare are on the ballot. I’m running for re-election to protect and strengthen these bedrock government promises — and I’m not alone. Kamala Harris, Tim Walz, and Democrats in Congress are in this fight too. Let’s start with Social Security. Even though it is a lifeline for millions, seniors are still struggling with rising costs. So we can’t just protect benefits — we should increase them, too. I’ve introduced a bill that would EXPAND Social Security benefits by $2,400 a year and fully fund the program all the way to 2096. How? By making the wealthy pitch in a fair share, so everyone can retire with dignity. Moving over to Medicare: when Democrats had the House, Senate, and White House, we strengthened Medicare by lowering drug costs for seniors — allowing the government to negotiate for lower prices, capping insulin at $35 a month, and limiting out-of-pocket prescription costs to $2,000 a year. Now Kamala Harris has a plan to extend those cost caps to all Americans — including $35/month insulin across the board — while expanding Medicare’s power to negotiate lower drug prices. She also has a proposal to cover home-based care under Medicare, which would be truly life-changing for generations and generations of families. On the other side, we’ve got the GOP. J.D. Vance once called Social Security and Medicare “the biggest roadblocks to any kind of real fiscal sanity.” Donald Trump proposed cutting Social Security and Medicare in every single one of his White House budgets. Project 2025 lays out a plan to end Medicare’s drug-price negotiations and undo the caps on out-of-pocket prescription costs. And Congressional Republicans have kept rolling out new ideas to put Social Security and Medicare on the chopping block, including by raising the Social Security retirement age. You know, I just have to say — here’s what I think whenever someone suggests raising the retirement age: there’s someone who didn’t work construction all their life. Who didn’t carry little kids around as a preschool teacher. Who didn’t help patients in and out of beds as a nurse. There’s someone we can’t trust to have seniors’ best interests at heart. [**If you’re determined to keep Republicans out of power so we can protect and strengthen vital programs like Social Security and Medicare, please chip in any amount to my re-election campaign — every dollar can make a difference in these final days.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2784?t=8&akid=2383%2E4032634%2EVVh2BB)

No matter how many pretty promises Republican politicians make to try to win this election, we can’t trust them to protect Social Security and Medicare. After all, the GOP is hyper-focused on handing more tax breaks to billionaires and giant corporations. That’s the first part of the classic Republican two-step. First, they slash taxes for the rich while playing dumb about the deficit. “Deficit? What deficit? Tax breaks for the wealthy will pay for themselves!” (Oh, please. As if they were sprinkling fairy dust on the yacht economy, or planting magic beans on Wall Street.) Second, after their fairy tale doesn’t come true and — surprise, surprise — they’ve blown up the deficit, they can say, “Oh, we now realize that the deficit exists! It’s time to pay for those tax breaks by cutting Social Security and Medicare.” It’s a scam. And we’re not falling for it. They try to make it seem like we don’t have a choice. But of course we do. Of course we can stick to our values and keep our promises. This all comes down to a basic question: who should our government work for? According to Republican politicians, it’s the rich and powerful. Not if we have anything to say about it, though. We are fighting to put Washington on the side of working people — and make it possible for every American to retire with dignity and get the care they need. But to make our plans a reality, we’ve got to hold the White House, flip the House, and protect our Democratic Senate majority — which means winning our race in Massachusetts. [**I will do everything in my power to prevent Republicans from gutting Social Security and Medicare. Part of that work is keeping our Senate majority. Can you chip in $28 or any amount to fuel our fight in the last critical days of this election season?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2784?amount=28&t=14&akid=2383%2E4032634%2EVVh2BB) Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth
